## How this appendix binds

This appendix is part of the Catalogizer Constitution and binds exactly as the constitution does.
Part 1 states the operative rules of every Helix anchor (every MUST clause, lettered clause, gate
name, no-escape-hatch flag and honest boundary) so that Spec Kit commands, which read only
`.specify/memory`, see the full rule set. Part 2 states every project and module rule. Where a
digest is shorter than the canon text, the canon in `submodules/constitution/Constitution.md` and
`groups/*.md` governs, and a digest MUST NOT be read as weakening it. Digests were written by
reading each canon block in full and were checked by a deterministic comparison (every `CM-*`
gate name and every `--flag` in canon appears in the matching digest) and by independent review.
Result at the pinned canon (`a71b1767`, measured by the tracked tool `scripts/governance/appendix_token_check.py`,
output kept as evidence `pin-fix-token-check-*.txt` under `specs/001-full-project-audit-remediation/evidence/wp07`):
284 digests, each present once (the 283 anchors of the index plus §11.4.276, which the lagging index does not list);
277 canon block-starts compared; 1,808 distinct per-anchor `CM-*` gate and `--flag` tokens checked; 0 gaps after six
exemptions, each a carrier with a recorded reason in `scripts/governance/appendix_token_allow.tsv`:
`CM-COVENANT-114-N-PROPAGATION` (a template placeholder), `CM-COVENANT-114-182-PROPAGATION` and
`CM-TRACK-BRANCH-LABEL` (belong to the §11.4.182 extension that sits beside §11.4.232 in canon), `--skip-item-creation`
(a §11.4.202 flag cited inside §11.4.214), `--rootful` (inside the Podman example `--rootful=false`) and `--help` (a
CLI argument named as the source of a fact in §11.4.78). Independent Opus reviewers compared every anchor's digest
against its canon block and found no BLOCKING defects at the 10b7a06 pin; at the a71b1767 pin the independent review of
2026-10-06 (WF8) found the §11.4.230 digest lacking the six clause-(D) no-escape-hatch flags, which is fixed here, and
that finding is why the comparison is now a tracked tool. Their minor findings are applied as "Review addendum" lines.
When the pin moves, regenerate the generated regions (`scripts/governance/regen_speckit_catalogue.py`) and run
`scripts/governance/appendix_token_check.py` (inside the IMG-TESTUTIL image through `scripts/containers/run_pinned.sh`):
a non-zero exit blocks the pin commit.

## Part 1: Anchor operative digests (284 anchors: 283 from the index plus §11.4.276)

### Anti-bluff and evidence (33 anchors)

#### §7.1 — NO BLUFF: positive-evidence-only validation
- **Source:** anti-bluff-and-evidence.md:3-36
- **Rules:**
  - Every runtime test MUST satisfy ALL FIVE constraints below; a test violating any one is a bluff and is forbidden from being committed.
  - (1) Real ACTION: the test MUST invoke at least one user-visible action via a project anti-bluff helper (e.g. `ab_send_action()`); a test that records PASS without calling such a helper is automatically failed by the summary function.
  - (2) State DELTA: every PASS claiming to verify a feature MUST capture state BEFORE and AFTER the action and assert the delta matches expectation; `before == after` on success is a bluff.
  - (3) POSITIVE EVIDENCE: the PASS condition MUST be positive evidence (value match, state delta, captured frame analysis, captured audio frame analysis), NEVER absence-of-error; a probe that returns nothing is a FAIL, not a SKIP.
  - (4) UNIQUE EVIDENCE TOKEN: tests that interact with mutable framework state MUST embed a per-run UUID into the action AND look for that token in the resulting state (defeats stale-cache false-pass).
  - (5) Audio/video features REQUIRE captured evidence: audio output validated by capturing actual output via a capture pipeline (loopback, hardware capture rig, or equivalent), NOT metadata-only checks; video output validated via frame capture + OCR or pixel-difference analysis.
  - Each consuming project SHOULD ship a shared anti-bluff helper library (typically `tests/lib/anti_bluff.sh` or equivalent); every new runtime test MUST source it and use its assertion helpers.
- **Gates:** none named
- **No escape hatch:** none named
- **Honest boundary:** none stated
- **Composes:** none cited

#### §11.4 — End-user quality guarantee (anti-bluff covenant, forensic anchor 2026-04-28)
- **Source:** anti-bluff-and-evidence.md:80-111
- **Rules:**
  - Canonical motivation (verbatim mandate): tests and Challenges all passing while most features do not work is NOT tolerated; execution of tests and Challenges MUST guarantee quality, completion and full usability by end users.
  - Operative rule: the bar for shipping is not "tests pass" but "users can use the feature"; every PASS MUST carry positive evidence captured during execution that the feature works for the end user.
  - Metadata-only PASS, configuration-only PASS, absence-of-error PASS, and grep-based PASS without runtime evidence are all critical defects regardless of how green the summary line looks.
  - Machine-created evidence at every gate (extension, §11.4.262): every claim that something WORKS, PASSES, IS VERIFIED, or IS PRODUCTION-READY MUST cite MACHINE-CREATED, MACHINE-VERIFIABLE evidence produced by the gate itself; NOT operator narrative, "looks fine", "no error was reported", prediction, guess, or assumption. Applies §11.4.107(10) self-validating analyzers universally. The captured-evidence family (§11.4.5/§11.4.69/§11.4.107) is refined from CAPTURED to CAPTURED-AND-MACHINE-VERIFIABLE; forbidden from the first prompt, at every layer.
  - Propagation requirement: every `CLAUDE.md` and every `AGENTS.md` in the project tree (parent + every submodule recursively) MUST contain a clearly-titled "MANDATORY ANTI-BLUFF COVENANT — END-USER QUALITY GUARANTEE" section quoting the user mandate verbatim and pointing back to this §11.4 as canonical authority; enforced via a pre-build gate (typically `CM-COVENANT-PROPAGATION`).
- **Gates:** CM-COVENANT-PROPAGATION
- **No escape hatch:** none named
- **Honest boundary:** none stated
- **Composes:** §7.1, §8, §11.4.5, §11.4.69, §11.4.107, §11.4.262

#### §11.4.1 — FAIL-bluffs are equally forbidden
- **Source:** anti-bluff-and-evidence.md:113-141
- **Rules:**
  - The covenant is enforced symmetrically: besides the PASS-bluff (green on a broken feature) the FAIL-bluff is forbidden: a red result caused by a script bug (shell crash, missing argument, regex error, malformed assertion) rather than a product defect.
  - Every test MUST fail ONLY for genuine product defects; a test crashing for a script-internal reason (undefined variable under `set -u`, unhandled error, malformed pipe, regex syntax error, division by zero) is a critical defect in the suite itself.
  - Such defects MUST be fixed at the source layer (helper library, shared lib, test source) so the failure mode disappears project-wide, not patched at individual call sites.
  - Examples: `log_pass` called without arguments under `set -eu` crashing on `$1`; an unbounded sed range whose terminator matches a comment so the intended mutation never fires and the audit reports PASS.
- **Gates:** none named
- **No escape hatch:** none named
- **Honest boundary:** none stated
- **Composes:** §11.4

#### §11.4.2 — Recorded-evidence requirement
- **Source:** anti-bluff-and-evidence.md:143-166
- **Rules:**
  - A test emitting PASS without captured visual or audio evidence of the user-visible feature actually working on the screen the user would see is a §11.4 PASS-bluff.
  - Project-wide infrastructure at minimum: (1) Recording wrapper capturing user-visible output to time-synchronized media files (multi-display systems record every output stream in parallel; sync metadata = host wall-clock at spawn written alongside).
  - (2) Action-timeline emitter: every test emits structured timeline events (JSONL or equivalent) at every user-visible transition.
  - (3) Frame/audio analyzer: scans recordings, extracts samples at a configurable interval, feeds recognizers (OCR for text overlays, speech-to-text for audio, pixel-diff for frame health), correlates against the timeline, emits findings.
  - Closure criterion: every PASS for a user-visible feature MUST be cross-checked by the analyzer against the recording + action timeline; a PASS lacking at least one matched timeline event in the analyzer findings is a §11.4 PASS-bluff.
- **Gates:** none named
- **No escape hatch:** none named
- **Honest boundary:** none stated
- **Composes:** §11.4

#### §11.4.3 — Per-environment-topology test dispatch
- **Source:** anti-bluff-and-evidence.md:168-183
- **Rules:**
  - Tests depending on environment topology (secondary displays, microphones, network interfaces, peripherals, cloud services, etc.) MUST detect topology at test entry and dispatch the topology-appropriate variant.
  - A test running the WRONG variant for the actual topology and PASSing is a §11.4 PASS-bluff.
  - A topology-touching test without BOTH a dispatcher AND a per-topology variant is a §11.4 violation regardless of how it passes on any configuration.
  - Single-test-multi-topology scripts MUST gate every topology-dependent assertion behind an explicit topology check emitting SKIP-with-reason if the required topology is absent; never PASS-by-default.
- **Gates:** none named
- **No escape hatch:** none named
- **Honest boundary:** none stated
- **Composes:** §11.4

#### §11.4.4 — Test-interrupt-on-discovery + retest-from-clean-baseline
- **Source:** anti-bluff-and-evidence.md:185-227
- **Rules:**
  - A test cycle continuing past a freshly discovered defect is itself a §11.4 PASS-bluff (contaminated all-green summaries).
  - (1) Interrupt immediately: the moment a defect is re-discovered, re-produced, or newly identified the cycle MUST stop; no "let it finish for the data".
  - (2) Systematic debugging before any fix: identify root cause at source layer (not symptom), blast radius across related tests/features/subsystems, and regression-protection seam; symptom patching forbidden.
  - (3) Fix at root cause per §11.4.1: source-layer fix, not symptom patch at the calling site; the fix MUST be safe (no new failure modes), minimal (no smuggled cleanup), non-regressive.
  - (4) Four-layer test coverage per fix, each with positive evidence: pre-build/pre-merge gate (source-level); post-build/packaging gate (artifact-level); runtime/on-device test (end-user behaviour); meta-test paired mutation (proves the gate is not itself a bluff).
  - (5) Documentation MUST be updated for every fix: Issues -> Fixed migration on closure, Applied Fixes table row, user-facing guides, architecture diagrams, per-version changelog.
  - (6) Rebuild the system via the canonical build script; skipping rebuild even for host-only fixes invites stale-artifact contamination.
  - (7) Re-deploy on every supported target; a target left on the pre-fix build is a confounder.
  - (8) Repeat the full test suite from the beginning on every target, sequentially per host memory cap; partial reruns are a §11.4 violation.
  - (9) No-bluff certification per cycle: before tagging, the meta-test harness returns all gates green AND every gate's paired mutation FAILs.
- **Gates:** none named
- **No escape hatch:** none named
- **Honest boundary:** none stated
- **Composes:** §11.4, §11.4.1

#### §11.4.5 — Captured-evidence quality analysis
- **Source:** anti-bluff-and-evidence.md:229-256
- **Rules:**
  - §11.4.2 mandates captured evidence; §11.4.5 mandates its CONTENT be analyzed for quality, not merely presence.
  - Every audio test that PASSes MUST verify: (1) Presence: non-trivial RMS amplitude in captured output.
  - (2) Channel count: analyzer reports the exact channel count claimed (2.0, 5.1, ...); stereo downmix in a "5.1 PASS" is a PASS-bluff.
  - (3) Sample rate + bit depth match the codec/pipeline under test.
  - (4) Glitch census: underruns, XRUNs, dropouts above tolerance MUST be explicitly classified (PASS within budget, WARN above, FAIL on hard limits); silently ignoring counts is a PASS-bluff.
  - (5) Coexistence-artifact census: radio/IPC/shared-resource contention above tolerance.
  - Every video test that PASSes MUST verify: (1) Presence: recording has non-zero size AND decoded-frame total > 0 (a 0-byte file is the canonical PASS-bluff).
  - (2) Routing target: analyzer confirms video appeared on the intended display/surface.
  - (3) Frame health: drop count, jitter, freeze detection, tearing.
  - (4) Obstruction census: OCR scan for hostile overlays (error dialogs, sign-in dialogs, geo-restriction overlays, paywall, etc).
  - (5) Resolution + codec: captured dimensions match the claim.
- **Gates:** none named
- **No escape hatch:** none named
- **Honest boundary:** none stated
- **Composes:** §11.4.2

#### §11.4.6 — No-guessing mandate
- **Source:** anti-bluff-and-evidence.md:258-277
- **Rules:**
  - Tests, gates, status reports, closure narratives, commit messages, and any operator-facing text MUST NOT use words such as `likely`, `probably`, `maybe`, `might`, `possibly`, `presumably`, `seems`, `appears to`, `guess`, `seemingly`, `apparently`, `perhaps`, `supposedly`, `conjectured`, or synonyms when describing CAUSES of test failures, system behaviour, or fix effectiveness.
  - Either (1) prove the cause with captured forensic evidence (logs, kernel ring buffer, ramoops, structured snapshots, OS journals, strace, etc.) and state it as fact, OR (2) explicitly mark UNCONFIRMED + PENDING_FORENSICS with a tracked-task ID for follow-up.
  - Every "X likely caused Y" sentence, and every "appears to be benign" without a concrete forensic trace, is a §11.4.6 violation.
- **Gates:** none named
- **No escape hatch:** none named
- **Honest boundary:** none stated
- **Composes:** none cited

#### §11.4.7 — Demotion-evidence rule
- **Source:** anti-bluff-and-evidence.md:279-298
- **Rules:**
  - A demotion from any FAIL classification (`OPEN`, `POSSIBLE PRODUCT DEFECT`, `FAIL`) to a lower severity (`INVESTIGATED`, `MITIGATED`, `RESOLVED`, `WORKING-AS-INTENDED`) requires positive evidence captured under the SAME CONDITIONS that originally exposed the defect.
  - (1) Same target: Target-A defect needs Target-A evidence; cross-target claims need every target.
  - (2) Same build: evidence captured BEFORE a relevant fix landed does not validate post-fix behaviour.
  - (3) Same cycle position: a stress-soak FAIL is not refuted by an isolated-test PASS.
  - (4) Same load profile: a contention-mode FAIL is not refuted by a quiescent-mode PASS.
  - "I cannot reproduce in isolation" is a HYPOTHESIS, not a finding; per §11.4.6 it MUST be tagged `UNCONFIRMED:` until a same-conditions retest produces positive evidence.
- **Gates:** none named
- **No escape hatch:** none named
- **Honest boundary:** none stated
- **Composes:** §11.4.6

#### §11.4.13 — Out-of-band sink-side captured-evidence
- **Source:** anti-bluff-and-evidence.md:300-316
- **Rules:**
  - Whenever a downstream consumer (HDMI sink, cloud service, monitoring target, downstream system) provides a network-accessible introspection API reporting what was actually received, the test suite MUST consume that report as captured evidence for every test asserting end-to-end delivery.
  - The on-source-side view ALONE is insufficient (the "tests pass but feature doesn't work" pattern).
  - Sink-side reports MUST be identity-verified (MAC, serial, UUID match) before consumed as evidence.
  - Sink-side reports MUST be topology-dispatched per §11.4.3: sink-probe-unreachable -> SKIP, never FAIL.
  - Sink-side reports MUST be cross-referenced with the on-source state at a matching wall-clock instant.
- **Gates:** none named
- **No escape hatch:** none named
- **Honest boundary:** none stated
- **Composes:** §11.4, §11.4.3

#### §11.4.38 — Installable-Asset Evidence Mandate (User mandate, 2026-05-17)
- **Source:** anti-bluff-and-evidence.md:318-377
- **Rules:**
  - For any user-distributable build artifact (package, bundle, installer, container image), tests and challenges MUST open the artifact and verify each user-visible asset is PRESENT and NON-DEGENERATE.
  - User-visible assets (non-exhaustive): application icons for every density/resolution tier declared in metadata, including platform-specific formats (multi-resolution container, adaptive XML, symbol set) the target OS uses at the minimum supported OS version; splash screens declared in install metadata; application name strings declared in install metadata; any other asset whose absence stops the user identifying, launching, or interacting with the installed app from the launcher/home screen/app drawer.
  - A PASS without opening the artifact and verifying the asset chain end-to-end is a §11.4 PASS-bluff regardless of source files existing; targeted failure mode: source exists -> packaged -> source-layer checks pass -> artifact produced with asset stripped/misconfigured and no gate opens the artifact.
  - Required evidence: per-asset PASS/FAIL lines showing (a) the asset entry exists in the artifact package listing; (b) it is non-empty/non-degenerate (size >= platform-defined minimum OR format-validated); (c) where OS asset resolution involves indirection (alias, XML reference chain, density-qualifier override), the full chain is traced to the final rendered resource.
  - Consuming projects ship one challenge script per artifact type that opens the produced artifact and verifies every declared user-visible asset; it MUST run as part of the standard QA gate (equivalent of `make qa-all`).
  - Classification universal (§11.4.17); no escape hatch; severity-equivalent to a §11.4 PASS-bluff at the artifact-packaging layer.
- **Gates:** none named
- **No escape hatch:** none named (stated: "No escape hatch")
- **Honest boundary:** none stated
- **Composes:** §11.4.1, §11.4.2, §11.4.3, §11.4.4, §11.4.5, §11.4.17, §11.4.25, §11.4.27

#### §11.4.68 — Positive sink-side / downstream evidence mandate (User mandate, 2026-05-20)
- **Source:** anti-bluff-and-evidence.md:379-514
- **Rules:**
  - A test asserting audio or video routing PASS MUST capture and verify positive sink-side or downstream evidence; never config-only, metadata-only, or PCM-open-state-only. Fixes the failure where helpers silently SKIPped the very evidence the assertion depended on.
  - Closed enumeration; at least one MUST be captured for every audio/video routing PASS (none alone sufficient if the canonical sink/downstream is reachable): (1) sink-side codec-state (Arvus/Sonos/Yamaha/Denon/Marantz/WiSA REST API) with NON-EMPTY Codec-In-Use matching the expected codec regex during playback; empty/`<unreachable>`/`<N.E.>`/`<None>` are NOT positive evidence.
  - (2) PCM frames-written delta from `/proc/asound/cardN/pcmMp/sub0/status hw_ptr`: delta over the window MUST be strictly positive AND consistent with expected sample-rate x channel-count x duration; zero/negative = FAIL.
  - (3) ALSA ELD/EDID-Like-Data from `/proc/asound/cardN/eld#X.Y` showing negotiated expected channel count + format; empty ELD is NOT evidence audio was received.
  - (4) ffprobe-on-captured-mp4 for video: non-zero frame count, expected codec, resolution, fps; 0-byte capture is FAIL.
  - (5) Recording-analyzer event match per §11.4.2/§11.4.5 timeline: at least one matched event.
  - (6) Tinycap RMS amplitude for ALSA-loopback recordings: non-trivial RMS in captured WAV (>= -60 dBFS for line-level playback).
  - FORBIDDEN: `arvus_probe_present` returning 1 -> SKIP -> all-green; when sink-side evidence is REQUIRED, missing sink is `OPERATOR-BLOCKED` (an explicit release-blocker, NOT SKIP, NOT PASS).
  - FORBIDDEN: empty codec-state logged ("codec_state: ") and assertion proceeding on HAL metadata; empty codec-state IS a defect signal (audio not arriving, or sink unreachable = operator-blocked); the test cannot PASS.
  - FORBIDDEN: reading `dumpsys media.audio_flinger` output-thread device `0x400 (AUDIO_DEVICE_OUT_HDMI)` as "HDMI routing PASS" (reflects audio POLICY choice, not what the HAL physically opened); sink codec-state or PCM `hw_ptr` delta is the ONLY proof audio arrived.
  - FORBIDDEN as only evidence: asserting `/vendor/etc/audio_policy_configuration.xml` contains the `deep_buffer` route to `HDMI Out` (config-only PASS); MUST be paired with at least one runtime positive evidence from the enumeration.
  - Protection 1 (library contract): sink-side helper libraries (`arvus_probe.sh`, `sonos_probe.sh`, etc.) MUST expose a `*_require_reachable` function returning exit code 2 (OPERATOR-BLOCKED) when the sink cannot be probed; tests asserting sink-side codec-state MUST call it at probe entry; silent skip via `*_probe_present` permitted ONLY for topology-dispatch fan-out that already has an alternative on-SoC + downstream-amplitude probe path.
  - Protection 2 (exit-code propagation): the harness MUST propagate 2 to the suite summary (counted separately from FAIL/SKIP) as `OPERATOR-BLOCKED`; `test_all_fixes.sh` MUST exit non-zero when any test reported OPERATOR-BLOCKED; release tags MUST NOT be cut while any OPERATOR-BLOCKED test exists.
  - Protection 3 (test rewrite): every test asserting `audio output routing PASS` via metadata-only checks (e.g. historical `test_audio_output_routing.sh` config-only invariants) MUST be rewritten to capture at least one positive sink/downstream evidence; the pattern `tinymix says route is on -> PASS` is the closed failure mode.
  - Protection 4 (anti-stickiness post-stop): after stopping playback the test MUST re-probe the sink/downstream and assert codec-state transitioned to N.E./N/A/0-frames-delta; persistent codec-state across test boundaries indicates orphan playback (§11.4.14 violation) and would falsely PASS the next test.
  - Pre-build gate `CM-POSITIVE-SINK-EVIDENCE-PER-AUDIO-TEST` walks every audio-routing on-device test asserting PASS and verifies it cites at least one positive evidence call (one of `arvus_require_reachable` / `arvus_assert_codec_format` / `pcm_hw_ptr_delta_positive` / `tinycap_rms_above_floor` / `ffprobe_frames_nonzero`); paired mutation strips one such call -> gate FAILs. `CM-COVENANT-114-68-PROPAGATION` enforces the anchor literal across canonical files + per-consumer propagation (paired mutation strips literal -> FAILs).
- **Gates:** CM-COVENANT-114-68-PROPAGATION, CM-POSITIVE-SINK-EVIDENCE-PER-AUDIO-TEST
- **No escape hatch:** --skip-sink-evidence, --allow-empty-codec, --sink-unreachable-is-pass, --metadata-only-suffices
- **Honest boundary:** none stated (non-compliance is a release blocker regardless of context)
- **Composes:** §11.4.2, §11.4.5, §11.4.13, §11.4.14, §11.4.46, §11.4.49, §11.4.50, §11.4.52, §11.4

#### §11.4.69 — Universal Sink-Side Positive-Evidence Taxonomy + Mechanical Enforcement (User mandate, 2026-05-20)
- **Source:** anti-bluff-and-evidence.md:518-803
- **Rules:**
  - Generalises §11.4.68 to every user-visible feature of every System component, owned project, and consumer; proper full automation passing MUST mean manual testing is as positive. Root causes (aspirational text without a gate; SKIP-fail-open; PASS-by-default helper; no closed taxonomy; helpers mapping a multi-step probe to one bool; no per-feature evidence ledger) are closed by the elements below.
  - Element 1: closed-set taxonomy. Every user-visible feature class MUST map to exactly one entry; tests annotate `# §11.4.69 FEATURE: <class>` so the pre-build gate can match expected evidence shape. Class -> probe -> evidence: `audio_output`: sink-side codec/channel REST probe + on-device `tinycap` + ffprobe channel assertion -> non-empty `codec_in_use` matching expected AND captured WAV RMS > -60 dBFS AND ffprobe `channels` matches claim.
  - `audio_input`: tinycap from intended device + ffprobe RMS -> WAV RMS > -60 dBFS AND `audio_devices_for_attr` shows the claimed source. `video_display`: `screenrecord` on intended display + `ffprobe -count_frames` + analyzer event-match -> non-zero mp4 AND `nb_read_frames > 0` AND matched event for claimed display.
  - `network_throughput`: `iperf3`/`curl --speed`/`dd` -> throughput >= per-link-type floor AND TCP buffer/congestion-control matches claim. `network_connectivity`: ping + DNS + TCP connect -> captured ping reply AND DNS answer AND TCP handshake to known port.
  - `bluetooth_a2dp`: codec query + sink peer state + A2DP TX queue depth -> `dumpsys bluetooth_manager` reports `CONNECTED+A2DP_PLAYING` AND codec non-empty AND queue depth < overflow threshold. `bluetooth_pair`: `dumpsys bluetooth_manager` + `getBondState()` -> `BOND_BONDED` AND MAC matches.
  - `touch_input`: `getevent -lt` during scripted `input tap` -> >=1 `EV_ABS ABS_MT_*` event per tap AND `dumpsys input` shows touch device active. `sensor`: `dumpsys sensorservice` + `getevent` -> event count > 0 between BEFORE/AFTER snapshots.
  - `gpu_render`: SurfaceFlinger frame-rate dump + `dumpsys gfxinfo <pkg>` -> `Janky frames` < threshold AND `Total frames rendered > 0`. `storage_read`: `dd if=<path> of=/dev/null` + `/proc/diskstats` delta -> throughput >= floor AND `read_sectors` delta on intended device. `storage_write`: `dd of=<path>` + sync + diskstats -> throughput >= floor AND `write_sectors` delta on intended device.
  - `mediacodec_decode`: `media.metrics` + `dumpsys media.codec` -> lifecycle events (`configure`, `start`, >=1 output buffer) AND codec name matches. `mediacodec_encode`: `media.metrics` + non-zero output file -> lifecycle events AND output non-zero AND ffprobe codec matches. `miracast`/`cast`: sink-side WFD/Cast announce + session state -> sink dashboard active session AND session ID in `dumpsys media_session`.
  - `boot_service`: `getprop init.svc.<name>` + log capture -> `running` AND expected boot-time log literal. `package_install`: `pm path <pkg>` + signature -> non-empty path AND APK signature matches platform key. `permission_grant`: `dumpsys package <pkg>` -> `granted: true`. `wifi_link`: `iw dev wlan0 link` + RSSI + frequency -> BSSID AND RSSI in range AND frequency matches. `wifi_throughput`: `iperf3` to LAN server -> >= floor for negotiated PHY rate.
  - `ethernet_link`: `ip link show` + carrier + throughput probe -> `carrier=1` AND `speed` matches AND throughput probe succeeds. `display_topology`: DRM connector dump + display ID enumeration -> connector `connected` AND display ID in `dumpsys SurfaceFlinger`. `drm_playback`: Widevine session + decoded-frame count -> active DRM session AND decoded frames > 0. `subtitle_render`: analyzer + Tesseract OCR on captured frames -> OCR matches expected subtitle text on claimed display.
  - Taxonomy is open to additions via constitution-submodule commits + propagation; removal of a class is forbidden without a tracked work item explaining supersession; consumers MAY extend with project-specific classes but MUST NOT contract it.
  - Element 2: helper contracts (additive during grace; mandatory after 2026-06-19). `ab_pass_with_evidence <description> <evidence_path>`: REQUIRES non-empty evidence_path; verifies path exists AND non-empty (`[ -s "$path" ]`); if missing/empty EXITs the test as FAILed citing the missing path; on success increments PASS and emits `PASS: <description> [evidence: <path>]`; composes with `ab_send_action`.
  - `ab_skip_with_reason <description> <reason_code>`: reason_code from CLOSED set `geo_restricted`, `operator_attended`, `hardware_not_present`, `topology_unsupported`, `network_unreachable_external`, `feature_disabled_by_config`, `artifact_not_yet_built`; REJECTs any ad-hoc string at call time; FORBIDs `network_unreachable_external` for any taxonomy class listing a sink-side probe; SKIP remains mechanically distinct from PASS in cycle math (§11.4.1).
  - `artifact_not_yet_built` (added 2026-07-17) names the NOT-YET-RUNNABLE class (check correct, topology present, precondition artifact not built/deployed) = the legal string for the §11.4.135 REQUIRES-REBUILD PENDING class; reporting it as FAIL is a §11.4.1 FAIL-bluff, as PASS a §11.4 PASS-bluff; seam-dependent per §11.4.135: honest and non-blocking on an intermediate artifact, BLOCKING on the release candidate (absence of verdict blocks as a FAIL does); a flat "always blocks" rule is REJECTED as a §11.4.201 FAIL-bluff. Consumer-migration note (§11.4.164): adding a member to a closed set means existing `ab_skip_with_reason` implementations reject it until updated; update alongside the constitution pull.
  - Bare `ab_pass` deprecation wrapper: legacy `ab_pass` MUST emit a WARNING per call AND a deprecation event to `/data/local/tmp/ab_pass_deprecations.log`; after grace the wrapper MUST FAIL the test outright.
  - Element 3: three pre-build gates + three paired mutations (§1.1). `CM-SINK-EVIDENCE-PER-FEATURE`: walks every `.sh` test in `device/rockchip/rk3588/tests/` (and equivalent), parses `# §11.4.69 FEATURE: <class>`, verifies the test invokes the taxonomy probe AND uses `ab_pass_with_evidence` (or `ab_skip_with_reason` with permitted reason); pre-grace missing annotation WARN, post-grace FAIL.
  - `CM-NO-FAIL-OPEN-SKIP`: audits sink-side probe helpers (`arvus_probe.sh`, `sonos_probe.sh`, equivalents) for any path converting empty/unreachable sink response into a PASS-counting SKIP for a class with a sink-side probe; FAILs if any exists (remediate: FAIL, or OPERATOR-BLOCKED per §11.4.68). `CM-AB-PASS-WITH-EVIDENCE-EVERYWHERE`: pre-grace WARN on bare `ab_pass`, post-grace (2026-06-19) FAIL; tests with no evidence-capable path MUST migrate to `ab_skip_with_reason operator_attended` + tracked work item per §11.4.52 `OPERATOR_ATTENDED_ONLY`.
  - Paired mutations: (1) strip literal `ab_pass_with_evidence` from the anti-bluff library -> `CM-AB-PASS-WITH-EVIDENCE-EVERYWHERE` FAILs; (2) inject a test calling bare `ab_pass` without the annotation -> `CM-SINK-EVIDENCE-PER-FEATURE` FAILs post-grace, WARNs pre-grace; (3) inject a test calling `ab_skip` (no `_with_reason`) or `ab_skip_with_reason network_unreachable_external` for `audio_output` -> `CM-NO-FAIL-OPEN-SKIP` FAILs.
  - Element 4: grace period 30 days, 2026-05-20 through 2026-06-19 inclusive; end date hardcoded in the helper library and the anchor; no env var, flag, or operator override can extend/shorten it. Pre-grace: new helpers usable, gates WARN, cycle math counts WARNs separately from PASS/FAIL/SKIP. Post-grace: WARN->FAIL automatic via `[ "$(date -u +%Y%m%d)" -ge 20260619 ]` in each gate.
  - Element 5: inheritance via HelixConstitution; applies to every subscribing consumer (including Catalogizer); each consumer MUST implement its own equivalent helper library + pre-build gates; Element 1 taxonomy is canonical; consumer extensions only as additions.
  - Propagation gate `CM-COVENANT-114-69-PROPAGATION` verifies the anchor literal across the ~44-file consumer fleet (parent CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md + Containers + 10 owned atmosphere submodules incl. smarttube-player nested set + 7 HelixQA submodules); constitution files are canonical authority.
- **Gates:** CM-SINK-EVIDENCE-PER-FEATURE, CM-NO-FAIL-OPEN-SKIP, CM-AB-PASS-WITH-EVIDENCE-EVERYWHERE, CM-COVENANT-114-69-PROPAGATION
- **No escape hatch:** --skip-evidence, --config-only-pass, --allow-fail-open-skip, --legacy-ab-pass-permitted (post-grace); no taxonomy-bypass shortcut
- **Honest boundary:** none stated (non-compliance is a release blocker regardless of context)
- **Composes:** §11.4.1, §11.4.2, §11.4.5, §11.4.6, §11.4.13, §11.4.27, §11.4.50, §11.4.52, §11.4.68, §11.4.135, §11.4.164, §11.4.201, §1.1

#### §11.4.83 — docs/qa/ end-user evidence mandate (User mandate, 2026-05-22)
- **Source:** anti-bluff-and-evidence.md:805-827
- **Rules:**
  - Every feature that ships MUST carry a recorded end-to-end communication transcript plus attached materials (screenshots, request/response payloads, audio, file uploads) committed under `docs/qa/<run-id>/`, one directory per feature run; a feature with no QA transcript is itself a §11.4/§107 PASS-bluff.
  - (1) Every consuming project MUST maintain a `docs/qa/` tree (no exception); each new feature run lands under `docs/qa/<run-id>/` where run-id is monotonic + greppable (timestamp, HRD-NNN, ATM-NNN, or other workable-item id per §11.4.54).
  - (2) Transcript MUST be full bidirectional: every prompt/command sent + every response + every error message + every state change observed; one-sided is not a transcript.
  - (3) Attached materials MUST be committed alongside (`.png`, `.json`/`.toon`/`.txt`, `.wav`/`.mp3`, etc.); external-only links (Slack URL, Drive URL) are §11.4.13 sink-side violations; evidence MUST live in-repo.
  - (4) Bot/agent-driven automation (e.g. a project's QA bot) MUST preserve the full conversation thread as the proof artefact; storing only the final PASS/FAIL line is a §107 bluff at the QA-automation layer.
  - (5) CI/release gates MUST refuse to tag a version having any feature-shipping commit without its matching non-empty `docs/qa/<run-id>/` directory; the consuming project's `release` script enforces this; constitution `scripts/qa_coverage_audit.sh` (when implemented) is the universal scanner.
  - Classification universal (§11.4.17); single-feature pre-implementation projects exempt until their first user-visible feature lands.
- **Gates:** none named
- **No escape hatch:** --qa-evidence-optional, --qa-transcript-later, --qa-bot-summary-suffices
- **Honest boundary:** Pre-implementation projects with no user-visible feature are exempt until the first lands.
- **Composes:** §11.4.2, §11.4.5, §11.4.13, §11.4.54, §11.4.65, §11.4.69, §107, §1.1
- **Review addendum:** Paired §1.1 mutation: delete a `docs/qa/<run-id>/` directory and the release gate MUST FAIL.

#### §11.4.105 — Natural-language intent recognition & clarification (User mandate, 2026-05-31)
- **Source:** anti-bluff-and-evidence.md:831-874
- **Rules:**
  - Binds natural-language intent recognition on every consumer shipping a messenger/notification-driven command surface (Herald and flavor binaries are the reference implementation; detailed normative spec = Herald design contract `docs/design/INTENT_RECOGNITION.md`; implementations code against the contract).
  - (A) No required command syntax: users MUST NOT be required to know command syntax (no `COMMAND:` prefix, no rigid grammar); the System determines intent; a design forcing users to memorize syntax violates the anchor.
  - (B) Three-tier resolution, first success wins, every inbound message resolved to exactly one action: TIER 1 command recognition (confident deterministic match of the System's existing command set from natural language); TIER 2 intent inference (when no command matches, infer the exact intent, e.g. LLM dispatch; NEVER guessing); TIER 3 clarify (when neither determined: REPLY to the original message, TAG the sender `@username` resolved via the §11.4.104 IdentityResolver, ask a PRECISE clarifying question NAMING candidate intents; no guessing, no silent drop).
  - (C) The System MUST NEVER guess an action (a wrong action is worse than a clarifying question) and MUST NEVER silently drop or ignore an inbound message; only genuine ambiguity reaches Tier 3, which always replies-tags-and-asks.
  - (D) Anti-bluff: every tier ships unit + integration + E2E + full-automation tests with REAL captured evidence; Tier 1 proven by a truth-table of natural-language messages -> expected action+fields PLUS conservative negatives that fall through to "no match"; Tier 3 proven by an E2E ambiguous-message dispatch whose recorded reply body is EXACTLY `@<sender> <specific question>` AND a NEGATIVE proving a clear command does NOT trigger clarify; a paired §1.1 mutation breaking the recognizer's confidence guard (forcing false-match) OR dropping the clarify tag MUST FAIL a test; evidence committed under `docs/qa/<run-id>/`.
  - Classification universal (§11.4.17); projects without a messenger surface inherit latently (binds the moment they ship one, the §11.4.96 pattern).
  - Four-layer coverage per §11.4.4(b); paired §1.1 mutation strips the `11.4.105` literal from a consumer file -> gate FAILs; gate-code is a separate work item.
- **Gates:** CM-COVENANT-114-105-PROPAGATION
- **No escape hatch:** --require-command-syntax, --guess-intent-ok, --skip-clarify, --drop-on-ambiguous
- **Honest boundary:** Gate-code implementation lands as a separate work item; the anchor defines the contract.
- **Composes:** §11.4, §11.4.1, §11.4.4, §11.4.5, §11.4.6, §11.4.16, §11.4.17, §11.4.35, §11.4.69, §11.4.96, §11.4.98, §11.4.104, §1.1

#### §11.4.107 — Anti-bluff AV/test-validation techniques mandate (User-driven research, 2026-06-02)
- **Source:** anti-bluff-and-evidence.md:878-924
- **Rules:**
  - Raises the bar from captured evidence to liveness + correct-routing + self-validated analyzer; every test asserting audio/video output is playing/advancing MUST satisfy ALL 13 points (omission of any is a §11.4 PASS-bluff).
  - (1) A single captured frame is NOT proof of playback: prove LIVE ADVANCING frames over a steady-state window (>= N frames across >= a few seconds) via a freeze-detection oracle (frame-difference/`freezedetect`-class OR perceptual-hash adjacent-frame distance), NOT byte-identical compare (byte-identity only as zero-cost early-out pre-filter); adjacent frames MUST differ above a calibrated threshold; a sustained near-identical interval => FROZEN => FAIL.
  - (2) An independent frame-advance counter from compositor/decoder telemetry (frame-timestamp advance, `framesDecoded`/`framesRendered`) MUST increase across the window; a flat counter => stuck decoder => FAIL even if pixels appear to move; keep both pixel-domain and telemetry-domain oracles (metamorphic redundancy).
  - (3) Loading/buffering is a DISTINCT state: wait for genuine playback-start before judging liveness (never false-FAIL a loading stream, never false-PASS a spinner); poll the decoder counter/first-advancing-frame/buffering flag with a generous per-class timeout; timeout + content endpoint unreachable => SKIP-with-reason per §11.4.3 (`network_unreachable_external`/`geo_restricted`); timeout + reachable => FAIL with captured evidence; only after confirmed playback-start run liveness checks over the steady-state window.
  - (4) Not-stale-from-previous cross-check: before asserting new content N is live, confirm its first frame DIFFERS (perceptual-hash mismatch) from the previous content's last captured frame; identical => leftover frozen frame => FAIL; critical for switch-between-items sequences.
  - (5) Measured FPS / no-lost-frames within tolerance of the source's expected rate (if knowable) or a sane floor; drop ratio above budget => FAIL (§11.4.5 frame-health).
  - (6) No-flash-on-the-wrong-output: when content is meant for ONLY a target output, sample the NON-target output at high frequency (e.g. every ~200 ms) across the transition window; ANY sampled wrong-output frame containing the content => FAIL; where a content-protection regime legitimately forces an output, classify explicitly, never by guessing per §11.4.6.
  - (7) Drive tests through the realistic user path (feed/UI), not deep-link shortcuts; where UI is not introspectable, fall back AND flag operator-attended per §11.4.52, never fake-PASS (§11.4.48 applied).
  - (8) Oracle problem: for content the project does not own (no golden reference) encode metamorphic relations: same content on output-A vs output-B structurally equivalent after resolution normalisation; paused stream's frame-advance counter must STOP; 2x speed roughly doubles frame-advance rate; same clip played twice yields equivalent liveness metrics.
  - (9) Full-reference quality metrics (SSIM/VMAF/Delta-E2000-class) vs the temporally-aligned golden source for owned content, to catch pale/desaturated/wrong-range/soft-scaled renders across motion.
  - (10) Mutation-test every analyzer with a golden-good + golden-bad fixture pair (freeze/motion/color/sharpness/aspect-ratio/FPS/OCR/audio-presence): clean control MUST PASS and a deliberately-degraded fixture (frozen clip, black-gap, desaturated, downscaled, stretched, half-rate, overlay-baked frame, silent track) MUST FAIL; an analyzer passing its golden-bad fixture is a bluff gate (§1.1 applied to analyzers); document behaviourally-equivalent mutants expected NOT to flip.
  - (11) Per-channel audio integrity, not a single aggregate: assert per-channel RMS/loudness (EBU-R128-class integrated/momentary loudness + per-channel level + silence-region census + DC-offset/NaN-Inf check); EVERY declared channel above floor; on-device take an underrun/XRUN census (a starved pipeline is a defect even if the waveform has sound).
  - (12) OCR overlay/subtitle detection needs a per-word confidence floor + region-of-interest (bottom-third for subtitles, centre for dialogs) to avoid false-positive and false-negative; discard sub-confidence words; emit per-finding confidence; where a subtitle must appear on one output and NOT another, assert both sides.
  - (13) Thresholds MUST be calibrated on the project's own fixtures (known-good + known-bad on its own capture path, recorded as captured evidence), never literature constants (§11.4.6); the capture path's re-encode loss is part of the baseline.
  - Four-layer coverage per §11.4.4(b): pre-build gate (e.g. `CM-AV-LIVENESS-NO-FROZEN-FRAME`-class gate asserting every test claiming output-is-playing references the liveness battery, plus an analyzer-self-validation gate wiring golden fixtures into the meta-test) + on-device/runtime test + paired §1.1 mutation (single-frame-only test -> gate FAILs; analyzer passing golden-bad -> self-validation FAILs) + HelixQA Challenge entry; every such PASS emitted via `ab_pass_with_evidence` citing motion/not-stale/frame-advance/fps/per-channel-loudness/metamorphic/self-validation artefacts (classes `video_display`, `audio_output`, `subtitle_render`) - NEVER a single screenshot.
  - Classification universal (§11.4.17); project supplies capture mechanism, sink-introspection API, calibrated thresholds per §11.4.35. Propagation gate enforces literal `11.4.107` across the consumer fleet; gate-code is a separate work item.
- **Gates:** CM-AV-LIVENESS-NO-FROZEN-FRAME, CM-COVENANT-114-107-PROPAGATION
- **No escape hatch:** --single-frame-proves-playback, --skip-liveness, --byte-identical-freeze-OK, --no-frame-advance-counter, --skip-not-stale-check, --allow-wrong-output-flash, --deep-link-shortcut-OK, --unvalidated-analyzer-OK, --aggregate-rms-suffices, --hardcoded-thresholds-OK
- **Honest boundary:** True photon frame rate has no clean software oracle (compositor/decoder counters measure the presentation pipeline); counters catch a stuck/half-rate decoder and MUST be used with the photon-FPS gap flagged, not claimed. Broadcast-QC vendor thresholds are undocumented; adopt open-method analogues and calibrate per point 13.
- **Composes:** §11.4.2, §11.4.3, §11.4.4, §11.4.5, §11.4.6, §11.4.13, §11.4.17, §11.4.35, §11.4.48, §11.4.50, §11.4.52, §11.4.68, §11.4.69, §11.4.85, §1.1

#### §11.4.108 — Four-layer fix-verification + runtime-signature-as-definition-of-done mandate (2026-06-03)
- **Source:** anti-bluff-and-evidence.md:928-960
- **Rules:**
  - A fix must cross FOUR layers; "fixed" at one does NOT imply the next: (1) SOURCE (committed in source); (2) ARTIFACT (change BYTES landed in the produced build artifact: image/bundle/installer/boot artifact/embedded command-line); (3) RUNTIME-ON-CLEAN-TARGET (active on a clean/fresh deployment with no stale overlay shadowing); (4) USER-VISIBLE (feature works for the end user, §11.4.5/§11.4.69). A gate verifying ONLY the source layer is insufficient and is itself a §11.4 bluff surface.
  - Clause 1: a fix is DONE only when its declared runtime signature is verified on a CLEAN/fresh deployment; source-committed != artifact-contains-it != active-on-clean-target != user-visible-working.
  - Clause 2: every fix declares ONE machine-checkable runtime signature (a property read from the running system, a downstream/sink report per §11.4.13, a captured-evidence assertion per §11.4.5/§11.4.69, or a counter/state delta; never a source re-grep); the registry of per-fix runtime signatures is the SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for "fixed" and REPLACES "a gate greps the source".
  - Clause 3: verification gates MUST span all four layers per fix: source (pre-build/pre-merge); artifact (post-build: BYTES landed, not merely source still contains the change); runtime-on-clean-target (post-deploy, signature asserted on a freshly-deployed clean target); user-visible (captured evidence).
  - Clause 4: eliminate the stale-deployment/shadow layer by construction: deployment MUST yield a CLEAN state (wipe mutable overlay/per-user state that can shadow the build) OR a pre-validation assertion MUST prove `running-artifact == built-artifact` BEFORE any validation; validation against possibly-stale deployed state is INVALID and any PASS is a §11.4 PASS-bluff.
  - Clause 5 meta-rule (§11.4.102 Phase 4.5): >= 3 "fixed-but-not-working" discoveries within a single cycle signal an architectural VERIFICATION flaw; on the 3rd the agent MUST STOP patching symptoms (§11.4.4), fix the VERIFICATION pipeline (close whichever layer is unverified), and re-certify EVERY item in the batch through the corrected pipeline on a clean target.
  - Clause 6: a batch is "validated" only after COMPREHENSIVE per-item runtime-signature verification on a clean baseline, NOT after batch-touched items' own tests pass (spot-validating touched items misses the cross-layer gap).
  - Clause 7 (extension 2026-08-15, machine-created evidence at every layer): at each of the four layers the PASS MUST cite MACHINE-CREATED, MACHINE-VERIFIABLE evidence PRODUCED AT THAT LAYER by its own gate (SOURCE: static-analysis JSON + review verdict; ARTIFACT: build log + fingerprint checksum + byte-check; RUNTIME: on-target verdict + runtime-signature + telemetry; USER-VISIBLE: OCR/vision/audio/sink-probe oracle output), cited by path + sha256 + timestamp per §11.4.207; a higher-layer PASS citing only lower-layer evidence is a §11.4.226 wrong-layer violation; every analyzer is §11.4.107(10) golden-good/golden-bad/negative-control validated and one passing its golden-bad voids every verdict it emitted (§11.4.201); operator eyeballing, narrative-only PASS, prediction FORBIDDEN (§11.4.262).
  - Propagation: `CM-COVENANT-114-108-PROPAGATION` (literal `11.4.108` unchanged, stays GREEN); `CM-RUNTIME-SIGNATURE-REGISTRY` EXTENDED with the per-layer machine-evidence-file-schema check, plus a paired mutation forging a runtime PASS whose only evidence is a source-grep transcript -> gate FAILs; recommended per-fix gate asserts every fix declares a runtime signature verified at artifact + runtime-on-clean-target layers; paired mutation downgrading to source-only -> gate FAILs.
  - Classification universal (§11.4.17); consumer supplies artifact format, clean-deployment/equal-artifact mechanism, per-fix runtime-signature observables per §11.4.35.
- **Gates:** CM-COVENANT-114-108-PROPAGATION, CM-RUNTIME-SIGNATURE-REGISTRY
- **No escape hatch:** --source-green-is-done, --skip-artifact-byte-check, --validate-against-running-state, --no-clean-deployment, --skip-runtime-signature, --spot-validate-touched-only
- **Honest boundary:** Gate-code implementation lands as a separate work item; the anchor defines the contract.
- **Composes:** §11.4.1, §11.4.2, §11.4.4, §11.4.5, §11.4.6, §11.4.13, §11.4.17, §11.4.27, §11.4.35, §11.4.40, §11.4.46, §11.4.50, §11.4.52, §11.4.69, §11.4.102, §11.4.107, §11.4.201, §11.4.207, §11.4.226, §11.4.262

#### §11.4.110 — Pre-build build-readiness verdict + change-impact clash detection mandate (operator mandate, 2026-06-03)
- **Source:** anti-bluff-and-evidence.md:964-996
- **Rules:**
  - Clause 1: before any artifact rebuild the project MUST emit ONE deterministic machine-checkable READY-FOR-BUILD verdict (codebase IS / IS NOT ready) backed by a captured-evidence bundle enumerating every gate family's status; the rebuild orchestrator MUST refuse to start unless READY (non-zero exit on NOT-READY); the verdict is the aggregate function and cannot report READY while any family reports FAIL.
  - Clause 2: a diff-driven change-impact + conflict/clash detector is mandatory; for every change, any newly-introduced dependency on a second artifact MUST be satisfied, at minimum: new system-property read <-> typed in the property-context registry AND reading domain has the read-grant; new registered service <-> service-context entry exists; new declared startup/init service <-> its security label present; new/changed stable interface <-> freeze-snapshot/version updated in same change; new native-library dependency <-> named library resolves to a known module or prebuilt; new security-policy rule <-> every type/attribute it uses is defined; two changes in the batch touching the SAME function/resource/configuration seam <-> collision explicitly acknowledged. Each sub-detector independently anti-bluff (clause 5).
  - Clause 3: coverage-completeness is a gate: every changed source file MUST map to >= 1 pre-build gate + >= 1 deployed-target test + >= 1 paired §1.1 mutation (four-layer §11.4.4(b) floor); a baseline file records the legacy tail of known holes; the gate FAILs on any NEW hole; covered-ratio ratchets upward per §11.4.50; a change with no owning gate/test/mutation blocks the verdict.
  - Clause 4: two-speed honesty: separate always-on grep-speed gates (every commit, seconds) from REQUIRES_BUILD heavy gates (build-graph parse-only dry-run; full security-policy neverallow compilation; built-symbol ABI diff); heavy gates run as diff-gated opt-in stages (triggered when change touches build-graph/policy/interface files), bounded per §12.6/§12.7 or inside the containerized build; conflating the two (slow grep path, or claiming grep proves graph/neverallow correctness) is forbidden per §11.4.6.
  - Clause 5: every gate family AND each wired third-party analyzer (exit-code-on-failure semantics included) MUST ship a paired §1.1 mutation planting the exact defect class and asserting FAIL (e.g. property read with no policy -> clash detector FAILs; broken build-graph fragment -> dry-run FAILs; an analyzer exiting 0 on a planted violation is the bluff); an analyzer without its mutation pair is a bluff surface.
  - Clause 6: honest boundary: pre-build catches statically-catchable defects only; READY proves the change is internally consistent and ready to build, NOT that the feature works on the target; the claim is that residual defects found later are runtime/hardware defects, not statically-catchable ones; overclaiming that manual testing will find nothing is a §11.4.6 violation; build-graph, neverallow and ABI correctness are proven ONLY by REQUIRES_BUILD families; the grep tier proves harness-presence + symbol-definedness only.
  - Classification universal (§11.4.17); consumer supplies property/service/policy registries, build-graph parse-only command, interface-freeze mechanism, changed-file-to-gate mapping per §11.4.35. Slot history: drafted as §11.4.109, renumbered to §11.4.110 per §11.4.71.
  - Propagation: `CM-COVENANT-114-110-PROPAGATION` enforces literal `11.4.110` across the fleet; recommended per-family gates each with a paired §1.1 mutation per clause 5; gate-code is a separate work item.
- **Gates:** CM-COVENANT-114-110-PROPAGATION, CM-READY-FOR-BUILD-VERDICT, CM-CHANGE-IMPACT-CLASH-DETECTOR, CM-COVERAGE-COMPLETENESS-GATE, CM-BUILDGRAPH-DRYRUN-WIRED, CM-SEPOLICY-NEVERALLOW-WIRED
- **No escape hatch:** --source-green-is-ready, --skip-clash-detector, --skip-coverage-gate, --no-ready-verdict, --grep-proves-neverallow, --skip-buildgraph-dryrun, --build-without-ready-verdict
- **Honest boundary:** Pre-build makes the PREVENTABLE (statically-catchable) defect class empty, not the all-defects class; runtime/user-visible correctness remains §11.4.108's job. Gate-code is a separate work item.
- **Composes:** §11.4.1, §11.4.4, §11.4.6, §11.4.9, §11.4.17, §11.4.27, §11.4.35, §11.4.50, §11.4.67, §11.4.71, §11.4.75, §11.4.92, §11.4.108, §12.6, §12.7, §1.1

#### §11.4.123 — Rock-solid-proof-or-deep-research mandate (User mandate, 2026-06-03)
- **Source:** anti-bluff-and-evidence.md:998-1018
- **Rules:**
  - Every reported issue, fix, and claimed completion MUST be fully and 100% validated with rock-solid CAPTURED proof per §11.4.5/§11.4.69/§11.4.107 before being marked fixed/implemented/completed (§11.4.33 terminal vocabulary); nothing is fixed or complete without hard evidence.
  - Metadata-only PASS, configuration-only PASS, absence-of-error PASS, and grep-without-runtime PASS are all forbidden (§11.4/§11.4.1); no false results or bluff at any layer.
  - Research-or-don't-bluff rule: when the agent is UNSURE how to fully test/validate/verify something (no obvious evidence-producing method, or the candidate would yield only metadata/config/absence-of-error evidence) it MUST ALWAYS first perform deep web research per §11.4.8 + §11.4.99 (official docs, articles, guides, vendor references, standards, issue trackers, reusable open-source codebases) to DISCOVER or BUILD a method producing rock-solid evidence.
  - Declaring something "untestable"/"not automatable", or accepting a metadata-only PASS, WITHOUT having exhausted this deep-research path is itself a §11.4.123 violation (same severity class as a PASS-bluff).
  - The research output (cited source URLs + the evidence-producing method it yielded, OR the literal "NO external solution found — original work" per §11.4.8) is the captured proof the path was exhausted.
  - Only after research genuinely fails may the item be classified `PENDING_FORENSICS:` / `Operator-blocked` (§11.4.21) / `structurally-impossible` won't-fix (§11.4.112), with the cited research as evidence the classification is earned.
  - Enforcement: `CM-COVENANT-114-123-PROPAGATION` enforces the literal across the fleet (every CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md/QWEN.md); recommended `CM-ROCK-SOLID-PROOF-OR-RESEARCH` flags any item closed `Fixed`/`Implemented`/`Completed` lacking a captured-evidence artefact path per §11.4.69, AND any `PENDING_FORENSICS:`/`Operator-blocked`/`structurally-impossible` classification lacking a cited deep-research trail per §11.4.8/§11.4.99. Paired §1.1 mutations: strip literal -> propagation FAILs; close with metadata-only PASS and no evidence path -> gate FAILs; classify Operator-blocked with no research trail -> gate FAILs. Gate-code is a separate work item.
  - Classification universal (§11.4.17); consumer supplies capture mechanisms + research corpora per §11.4.35. Forensic reason: "unclear how to validate" is a research trigger, never a bluff licence.
- **Gates:** CM-COVENANT-114-123-PROPAGATION, CM-ROCK-SOLID-PROOF-OR-RESEARCH
- **No escape hatch:** --metadata-pass-suffices, --skip-proof, --untestable-without-research, --config-only-closure-OK, --bluff-when-unsure

#### §11.4.139 — Fresh-process clean-artifact runtime-signature mandate (User mandate, 2026-06-08)
- **Source:** anti-bluff-and-evidence.md:1020-1026
- **Rules:**
  - Refines §11.4.108: before any post-deploy validation, ESPECIALLY a non-pixel proxy verification (the subdebug/accessibility-cue channel used for FLAG_SECURE displays), the harness MUST assert running-artifact == built-artifact.
  - The deploy MUST yield a CLEAN target (mutable-overlay/userdata wiped) OR a pre-validation check MUST prove no stale overlay shadows the deployed code (e.g. every guarded package, including the Presenter emitting the subtitle cue, resolves to the system partition with no per-user override).
  - A stale shadow of the cue-emitting component (e.g. a Presenter APK predating the denylist) makes the proxy report on code never deployed; any PASS is a §11.4 PASS-bluff.
  - Each fix declares ONE machine-checkable runtime signature verified on the clean target (the §11.4.108 registry IS the definition of done); for the subtitle class: the shipped Presenter APK contains the denylist literal (case-insensitive) AND the subdebug channel emits `candidate REJECTED reason=chrome-label` for a menu label.
  - Classification universal (§11.4.17); gate-code is a separate work item.
- **Gates:** CM-CLEAN-ARTIFACT-RUNTIME-SIGNATURE, CM-COVENANT-114-139-PROPAGATION
- **No escape hatch:** --validate-against-running-state, --skip-clean-precondition, --shadow-OK
- **Honest boundary:** Gate-code is a separate work item.

#### §11.4.146 — Reproduce-first test + same-test-confirms-fix + mandatory extend-to-all-cases workflow (User mandate, 2026-06-10)
- **Source:** anti-bluff-and-evidence.md:1028-1048
- **Rules:**
  - Names and binds component disciplines into the operator's per-defect sequence: (1) FIRST author a test that confirms + reproduces the problem AND serves as an investigation instrument; (2) after the fix use the SAME test to confirm the problem is gone; (3) THEN extend tests to ALL flows, cases, edge cases; every step produces rock-solid PHYSICAL captured evidence.
  - STEP 1 (reproduce-first + investigate): before any fix author the §11.4.43 RED test as a §11.4.115 RED-baseline-on-the-broken-artifact (reproduce on the CURRENT pre-fix artifact, capture defect-present evidence per §11.4.5/§11.4.69/§11.4.107). NEW EMPHASIS (D1): the RED test is ALSO an investigation instrument per §11.4.102(A): it MUST gather additional forensic data characterising the defect (triggers, boundaries, input/topology scope, adjacent failure modes), feeding BOTH the §11.4.102 root-cause/fix design AND the STEP-3 scope; a RED test used only as a binary gate with no characterisation satisfies §11.4.115 but NOT STEP 1.
  - STEP 2 (same-test-confirms-fix): after the fix the SAME test source (§11.4.115 polarity switch `RED_MODE=1->0`) confirms the defect is ABSENT; RED-on-broken then GREEN-on-fixed both captured, on a clean target per §11.4.108/§11.4.139, validated-first-after-redeploy per §11.4.130, deterministic per §11.4.50; no separate happy-path test substitutes.
  - STEP 3 (extend-to-all-cases, mandatory per-fix; NEW EMPHASIS D2): immediately after STEP 2 the test MUST be fanned out across the full case-space of the SAME functionality: all flows, valid + invalid + boundary (§11.4.85 empty/max/off-by-one) + concurrent + failure-injection (§11.4.85 chaos) + topology variants (§11.4.3), with PROVABLE enumerated coverage per §11.4.118 (a listed case-set with per-case outcome, never "no other issues found"); NOT deferred to a release-cycle sweep, NOT reduced to a single guard; user-visible cases carry evidence per §11.4.123; each registered into the §11.4.135 standing regression-guard suite; a newly discovered defect triggers §11.4.4 test-interrupt + re-enters STEP 1.
  - Anti-bluff, all steps: every PASS is rock-solid captured physical evidence per §11.4.123; metadata-only/config-only/absence-of-error/grep-without-runtime forbidden; unclear validation method -> deep-research per §11.4.123/§11.4.8/§11.4.99; an operator-found defect missed by the green suite triggers §11.4.138 (bluff-audit + permanent guard).
  - (D3) STATUS-CUSTODY mechanical binding: a done-claiming status write is REFUSED without the machine-written evidence chain. ALL hold: (1) custody chain is a file chain a script checks, no prose: `item status in done/ready => guard-registry row keyed by the item's EXACT stable id (legacy keys via checked-in alias map) => executable registered guard => §11.4.115(F) machine-written RED+GREEN verdict pair => evidence files matching the item's feature-class shape`.
  - (2) Seam A: the workable-items engine (§11.4.93) refuses a transition to any done/ready status while the chain is incomplete; engine is project-agnostic per §11.4.28, reads a consumer-owned custody configuration; registry/verdict-store/class-map paths are consumer DATA per §11.4.35.
  - (3) Seam B: a FULL-TABLE sweep gate (not a diff check) on every pre-build run: EVERY done/ready item in the SSoT (minus the ratchet) must hold a complete chain, catching raw-DB bypass of Seam A.
  - (4) Seam C: the release seam per §11.4.135 verdict-coverage extension: ABSENCE of a verdict for the release-candidate artifact blocks exactly as a FAIL does.
  - (5) §11.4.205 construction order: the FIRST artifact to land is the executable sweep + its golden-bad meta-fixture (a temp SSoT overlay with a terminal item holding NO custody chain; the meta-test RUNS the sweep and requires FAIL; grep-only meta-assertions forbidden per §11.4.201/§11.4.107(10)) and ALSO asserts the sweep is WIRED (de-wiring it from the pre-build runner flips the meta-test RED); governance text citing the gate lands only in the same commit as the executable; acceptance check = run the sweep.
  - (6) Adoption ratchet per §11.4.135 extension: the pre-existing done-claiming-unguarded backlog snapshotted once, monotone decrease only.
  - Recommended gate `CM-REPRODUCE-FIRST-THEN-EXTEND`: every closed defect's fix carries a §11.4.115 reproduce-first polarity test with captured defect-characterisation [STEP 1], its `RED_MODE=0` GREEN confirmation [STEP 2], AND an enumerated extend case-set registered into the §11.4.135 suite [STEP 3]; reproduce->confirm pair with no extend case-set FAILs. Recommended gate `CM-STATUS-CUSTODY`: Seam-A refusal present + Seam-B sweep wired + ratchet monotone-decreasing. Paired §1.1 mutations: strip literal -> propagation FAILs; close with only reproduce->confirm -> `CM-REPRODUCE-FIRST-THEN-EXTEND` FAILs; mark a chain-less item done via raw DB write -> sweep FAILs; de-wire sweep -> its meta-test FAILs. Gate-code is a separate work item.
  - Classification universal (§11.4.17); consumer supplies reproduction/polarity harness, case-space enumeration, capture mechanism per §11.4.35.
- **Gates:** CM-COVENANT-114-146-PROPAGATION, CM-REPRODUCE-FIRST-THEN-EXTEND, CM-STATUS-CUSTODY
- **No escape hatch:** --skip-reproduce-first, --fix-without-red, --skip-extend-to-all-cases, --reproduce-confirm-suffices, --defer-extend-to-release-sweep, --single-guard-suffices, --no-defect-characterisation, --status-without-custody, --prose-closure-suffices, --skip-custody-sweep, --raw-db-status-write-OK
- **Honest boundary:** STEP 3 reduces the unknown-unknown surface but does not prove zero remaining defects (no finite case-set can, per §11.4.118); un-exercised cases are stated honest gaps. D3 binding proves no status outruns its evidence and the REPORTED defect cannot silently return under the guard's conditions; it does NOT prove the feature bug-free (§11.4.186 family dedup), does NOT make a miscalibrated oracle honest (§11.4.107(10) goldens necessary not sufficient), does NOT replace §11.4.185 manual QA, and makes target availability a HARD dependency of status progress BY DESIGN.
- **Composes:** §11.4.3, §11.4.4, §11.4.5, §11.4.8, §11.4.15, §11.4.17, §11.4.28, §11.4.33, §11.4.35, §11.4.43, §11.4.50, §11.4.54, §11.4.69, §11.4.85, §11.4.93, §11.4.95, §11.4.99, §11.4.102, §11.4.106, §11.4.107, §11.4.108, §11.4.115, §11.4.118, §11.4.123, §11.4.130, §11.4.135, §11.4.138, §11.4.139, §11.4.185, §11.4.186, §11.4.201, §11.4.205, §107, §1.1

#### §11.4.158 — Intensive all-feature/flow/edge-case video-recording + read-the-screen content-verification mandate (User mandate, 2026-06-16)
- **Source:** anti-bluff-and-evidence.md:1050-1074
- **Rules:**
  - Strict intensification of §11.4.153 + §11.4.107 + §11.4.117 + §11.4.137 + §11.4.27/§11.4.52, binding them into ONE record-and-read mandate; ALL hold. A recording is proof ONLY when its shown content is machine-read and verified as a genuine working result (e.g. a sweep caught `streaming generation failed` on screen from a stale binary).
  - (A) Intensive total coverage: every project MUST be covered by intensive automated testing that EXERCISES + RECORDS every feature, flow, use case, and edge case (valid/invalid/boundary/empty/max/concurrent/failure-injection per §11.4.85), not a happy-path sample; a feature/flow/edge-case with no recorded read-verified evidence is a §11.4 PASS-bluff at the coverage layer.
  - (B) Real results, rock-solid physical proof, zero bluff: every recording MUST show the feature GENUINELY WORKING with REAL results (real prompts -> real LLM/service responses -> real outputs per §11.4.153); NO false/simulated/stale/frozen result may appear (§11.4.2/.5/.107); a recording showing an error, bluff response, frozen/stale frame, or non-working feature is a FINDING (-> §11.4.153(4)/§11.4.4 fix->retest->re-record), NEVER a confirmation.
  - (C) Read-the-screen content verification (HelixQA-driven): the testing System MUST ACTUALLY READ every printed log line, message, UI label, dialog, toast, status text in each recording and VERIFY it (OCR/ROI per §11.4.117/§11.4.137(12) with a confidence floor for pixel surfaces; direct text capture for terminal/log surfaces; §11.4.107(10) golden-good/golden-bad self-validated analyzer); "a video was produced" is NOT evidence; HelixQA (§11.4.27) MUST be the driver/orchestrator of the exercise->record->read->score pass and score PASS only on a read-confirmed genuine result with captured artefact path (§11.4.69).
  - (D) Default save path = `$HOME/Downloads` (resolved from the running user's home at runtime, NEVER hardcoded) unless a project declares an override per §11.4.35 (recorded in the project layer); filenames carry the §11.4.155 project-name prefix; window-scoped capture + fresh-corpus rotation per §11.4.154; raw corpus git-ignored + code-intelligence-excluded per §11.4.128; only curated evidence committed under `docs/qa/<run-id>/` (§11.4.83) at release prep.
  - (E) No false results survive: a recording-confirmed PASS contradicted by the operator (or a later re-read) is a §11.4.138 operator-escape -> mandatory bluff-audit + permanent guard; the read-and-verify analyzer is itself anti-bluff (golden-good PASSes, golden-bad FAILs, §1.1).
  - (F) Vision analysis MANDATORY for every recording: after every recording the agent MUST read terminal output/screenshot frames/video and verify (i) the feature ACTUALLY WORKS (real output, not errors, not empty); (ii) LLM responses are REAL (not simulated/placeholder/"for now"); (iii) all tests show PASS with captured evidence; (iv) no "TODO implement", "simulate", "for now", or "in production this would" patterns; (v) the output demonstrates the feature working for the end user; vision validation MUST produce a PASS/FAIL verdict with cited evidence path (§11.4.69); a recording without vision validation is a §11.4.158 violation.
  - Classification universal (§11.4.17); consumer supplies capture mechanism, OCR/read tooling, HelixQA banks, optional recording-path override per §11.4.35.
- **Gates:** CM-COVENANT-114-158-PROPAGATION, CM-INTENSIVE-RECORDING-COVERAGE, CM-RECORDING-CONTENT-READ-VERIFIED
- **No escape hatch:** --skip-recording-coverage, --video-without-content-read, --happy-path-recording-suffices, --recording-path-anywhere, --unread-recording-OK, --skip-helixqa-read
- **Honest boundary:** Reading + verifying shown content proves the recorded run produced a genuine working result for the cases exercised; it does NOT prove zero remaining defects (§11.4.118) and does NOT replace §11.4.108 runtime-signature verification or §11.4.40 full-suite retest.
- **Composes:** §11.4.2, §11.4.4, §11.4.5, §11.4.17, §11.4.25, §11.4.27, §11.4.35, §11.4.40, §11.4.52, §11.4.69, §11.4.83, §11.4.85, §11.4.107, §11.4.108, §11.4.117, §11.4.118, §11.4.128, §11.4.137, §11.4.138, §11.4.153, §11.4.154, §11.4.155, §1.1

#### §11.4.159 — Window-specific video recording + vision validation
- **Source:** anti-bluff-and-evidence.md:1076-1123
- **Rules:**
  - (A) Every video MUST record ONLY the target application window (terminal pane, TUI app, browser tab, emulator frame), NEVER the whole desktop/monitor; use window-targeted capture (macOS `screencapture -l<window_id>`, Linux `xdotool` + `ffmpeg -video_size WxH -f x11grab -i :0.0+X,Y`, or equivalent). If the platform cannot capture below whole-screen: honest §11.4.3 SKIP + tracked migration item, never a whole-screen pass-off.
  - (B) Every recording MUST be `.mp4` (H.264, `movflags +faststart`, `pix_fmt yuv420p`); `.cast` (asciinema) is supplementary only and MUST be auto-converted via `agg` + `ffmpeg` immediately after capture per §11.4.154(C).
  - (C) Filename MUST start with the project name in snake_case (from `HELIX_RELEASE_PREFIX` in `.env` per §11.4.151, else lowercased project root dir per §11.4.29): `<project_name>-<feature>-<YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS>.mp4`. Unprefixed = violation.
  - (D) After EVERY recording the agent MUST perform vision analysis and verify: (i) feature ACTUALLY WORKS (real output, not errors/empty); (ii) LLM responses are REAL (not simulated/placeholder/"for now"); (iii) all tests show PASS with captured evidence; (iv) no "TODO implement", "simulate", "for now", "in production this would" patterns; (v) output demonstrates the feature working for the end user. Must produce PASS/FAIL verdict with evidence path (§11.4.69). A video never read is NOT evidence.
  - (E) After each recording, close ONLY the Terminal window used (window-specific close via `osascript` with window id, `xdotool`, or equivalent); MUST NOT close other processes' windows; orphan Terminal windows = violation.
  - (F) Recordings MUST show REAL working features (real API calls, real LLM responses, real test results); errors/empty/simulated/placeholder content = violation and MUST trigger fix -> retest -> re-record before acceptance.
  - (G) Every recording MUST be reproducible: the command shown MUST be re-runnable with same results; one-time manual interactions that cannot be automated = violation.
  - (H) When a new recording run for a scope begins, the agent's own prior in-scope stale recordings at the recording path MUST be removed FIRST (per §11.4.154); committed `docs/qa/<run-id>/` evidence is durable and NOT rotated.
  - (I) Content verification MANDATORY, not duration-based. Before accepting ANY recording verify: expected output patterns ARE present; feature ACTUALLY WORKS; LLM responses are REAL content; every "working" claim is backed by visible evidence. Duration is not a proxy for quality.
  - (J) Before recording, the agent MUST specify expected content (patterns, test results, API responses); after recording, verify they ARE present; missing expected content = recording REJECTED regardless of duration.
  - (K) Mandated workflow: 1 SPECIFY expected patterns; 2 RECORD; 3 EXTRACT all text; 4 VERIFY patterns present; 5 CHECK for simulated/placeholder content; 6 ACCEPT only if ALL patterns found AND zero bluffs; 7 REJECT and re-record if ANY pattern missing or bluff detected.
  - (L) A rejected recording (missing content, bluff, empty capture) REQUIRES root cause analysis per §11.4.102 (timing, wrong command, tool failure...) and fix before re-recording; re-recording without understanding WHY = violation.
  - (M) Real-time monitoring that analyzes output DURING recording is RECOMMENDED for complex features.
  - Classification universal (§11.4.17); consuming project supplies capture mechanism per surface class, recording path, prefix, vision tooling per §11.4.35. Whole-desktop capture leaks private content (§11.4.10) and breaks §11.4.107/§11.4.137 oracles.
- **Gates:** CM-COVENANT-114-159-PROPAGATION, CM-WINDOW-VIDEO-VALIDATED (every video window-specific MP4 with vision-confirmed verdict + terminal cleanup + project prefix; paired §1.1 mutation: whole-screen recording where window-scoped is feasible, or no vision validation, FAILs; gate-code = separate work item)
- **No escape hatch:** --whole-screen-ok, --cast-only, --skip-vision-validation, --no-cleanup, --simulated-recording-ok, --unprefixed-recording
- **Honest boundary:** none stated beyond the platform-cannot-capture honest SKIP rule.
- **Composes:** §11.4.2, §11.4.3, §11.4.5, §11.4.10, §11.4.29, §11.4.69, §11.4.83, §11.4.102, §11.4.107, §11.4.111, §11.4.128, §11.4.137, §11.4.151, §11.4.153, §11.4.154, §11.4.155, §11.4.158, §11.4.17, §11.4.35, §1.1

#### §11.4.160 — Vision-verified recording + HelixQA bridge
- **Source:** anti-bluff-and-evidence.md:1125-1145
- **Rules:**
  - Every feature/QA video recording MUST be processed through a vision/OCR pipeline that reads on-screen content and confirms expected results BEFORE acceptance as evidence; accepting a recording without automated read-the-screen verification is a PASS-bluff at the evidence-integrity layer.
  - The recording system MUST provide a real-time or post-recording bridge feeding captured frames/pixels to HelixQA's test infrastructure (or equivalent automated framework) for content verification against expected patterns specified BEFORE recording (§11.4.159(J)).
  - The bridge MUST: (1) capture frames at <=5 s intervals during the recording window; (2) run OCR/vision analysis on each frame with a self-validated golden-good/golden-bad analyzer per §11.4.107(10), the analyzer itself mutation-tested so it cannot bluff a PASS on empty/degraded content; (3) compare extracted text against SPECIFY-phase expected patterns - every §11.4.159(J) pattern MUST be checked; (4) produce a per-frame PASS/FAIL verdict with evidence path (raw frame image + OCR output + comparison result linked from verdict); (5) surface failures immediately for re-do per §11.4.159(L) root-cause analysis, not queued for batch review.
  - Frame-capture interval, OCR confidence floor, and pattern-matching thresholds are project-configured (§11.4.35), calibrated on the project's own fixtures per §11.4.6 (no hardcoded industry defaults).
  - If the surface is FLAG_SECURE / DRM-protected / sink-blanked per §11.4.112, the test documents the gap and uses the §11.4.117 proxy oracle (accessibility cue / subdebug channel) - never a faked pixel-verified PASS.
  - Classification universal (§11.4.17); consumer supplies capture mechanism, OCR/vision tooling, interval, confidence floor, HelixQA bridge integration.
- **Gates:** CM-COVENANT-114-160-PROPAGATION, CM-VISION-VERIFIED-RECORDING-BRIDGE (every recording has a self-validated OCR/vision pass against SPECIFY-phase patterns with per-frame PASS/FAIL; paired §1.1 mutation: strip the bridge/accept recording without vision verification FAILs; gate-code = separate work item)
- **No escape hatch:** --skip-vision-verification, --manual-review-suffices, --no-bridge, --single-frame-suffices, --hardcoded-thresholds-OK, --unvalidated-analyzer-OK
- **Honest boundary:** Vision verification confirms expected on-screen output; it does NOT replace §11.4.5 captured-evidence quality analysis (audio RMS/XRUN, video freeze/jitter census) nor §11.4.108 runtime-signature verification.
- **Composes:** §11.4.5, §11.4.27, §11.4.69, §11.4.107(10), §11.4.112, §11.4.117, §11.4.153, §11.4.158, §11.4.159(J), §11.4.159(L), §11.4.6, §11.4.35, §11.4.108, §11.4.17, §1.1

#### §11.4.163 — Universal Media Validation & Verification Mandate
- **Source:** anti-bluff-and-evidence.md:1147-1169
- **Rules:**
  - Every recorded artifact (video MP4, audio WAV, screenshots PNG, asciinema cast, text output) MUST pass a MEDIA VALIDATION pipeline before being accepted as evidence; an unvalidated recording is a PASS-bluff at the evidence layer.
  - (a) Content extraction: OCR for video/screenshots (per §11.4.117, with confidence floor per §11.4.107(12)), transcription for audio, text parsing for asciicast/text output. Extraction tooling is self-validated per §11.4.107(10): golden-good MUST PASS, golden-bad MUST FAIL; an extractor that passes golden-bad is a bluff gate.
  - (b) Pattern matching: extracted content MUST be compared against SPECIFY-phase expected patterns per §11.4.159(J); every specified pattern must match at least one extracted line/frame; any unmatched pattern yields FAIL with exact pinpoint (which pattern, what content was found instead). The pattern set is the closed set the test author declares before recording; an un-patterned PASS is inadmissible.
  - (c) The pipeline as a whole (extraction + matching + verdict) MUST be mutation-tested with a golden-good/golden-bad pair (§11.4.107(10)); a pipeline passing its golden-bad MUST NOT be used for any evidence until restored.
  - (d) Structured verdict per artifact MUST contain: PASS/FAIL, exact evidence path (file + frame/line/timestamp), matched patterns list (pattern -> extracted text -> frame/line), unmatched patterns list (pattern -> expected -> actual), analyzer version and calibration hash; committed alongside the artifact under `docs/qa/<run-id>/` (§11.4.83).
  - (e) On FAIL the pipeline MUST give exact pinpoint data: which artifact, which frame/line/timestamp, which OCR region or audio segment, which expected pattern, what was extracted instead; this is the §11.4.102 entry point before re-recording per §11.4.159(L).
  - (f) Dual trigger mode: triggerable both post-recording (§11.4.159(K)) AND as real-time monitoring during recording (§11.4.159(M)).
  - (g) Paired §1.1 meta-test mutation: a golden-bad fixture the validator MUST reject; if it returns PASS the mutation test FAILs and the validator is inadmissible until fixed.
  - The pipeline is mandatory for every recorded artifact, never optional; a bypassable pipeline (recording accepted without validation) is a violation.
  - Classification universal (§11.4.17); consumer supplies extractors, golden fixture pair, expected-pattern declaration mechanism, verdict template per §11.4.35.
- **Gates:** CM-COVENANT-114-163-PROPAGATION, CM-MEDIA-VALIDATION-PIPELINE (every recorded artifact crosses a self-validated media validation pipeline; golden-bad produces FAIL; paired §1.1 mutation: bypass pipeline and accept raw recording FAILs; gate-code = separate work item)
- **No escape hatch:** none named
- **Honest boundary:** The pipeline confirms the artifact contains the content it claims and matches patterns; it does NOT prove the feature is correct for the end user (rests on §11.4.5, §11.4.107 liveness, §11.4.108 runtime-signature) and does NOT replace §11.4.40 full-suite retest.
- **Composes:** §11.4.107(10), §11.4.112, §11.4.117, §11.4.159(J), §11.4.159(K), §11.4.159(M), §11.4.83, §11.4.5, §11.4.69, §11.4.102, §11.4.134, §11.4.107(12), §11.4.159(L), §11.4.35, §11.4.17, §11.4.108, §11.4.40, §1.1

#### §11.4.193 — Anti-blind-typing: every UI interaction seen and understood via OCR/vision/screenshot
- **Source:** anti-bluff-and-evidence.md:1171-1191
- **Rules:**
  - Blind typing (sending keystrokes/text/input events to a UI surface WITHOUT first capturing AND understanding what is on screen AND confirming the result after each interaction) is STRICTLY FORBIDDEN everywhere and always, for every agent, tool, automation, platform, context. Claiming "credentials entered"/"login completed" without visual proof is a PASS-bluff at the UI-interaction layer.
  - (1) SEE-BEFORE-YOU-TYPE: before ANY `input text`, `input keyevent`, `adb shell input`, uiautomator gesture or equivalent, capture current screen state (screencap + OCR, uiautomator dump, accessibility-tree dump, or vision-model frame) AND confirm the target element is visible AND focused. The capture IS the §11.4.5/§11.4.69 evidence, feature class `touch_input`.
  - (2) VERIFY-AFTER-YOU-TYPE: after EVERY interaction step capture a NEW screen state and confirm the intended change; 5 `input text` commands with one final screenshot is blind typing - each step needs its own verification.
  - (3) OCR/VISION ORACLE MANDATORY: use at least ONE of: Tesseract OCR on a screencap at 150+ DPI, uiautomator dump with grep for expected text, HelixQA VisionEngine frame analysis per §11.4.159/§11.4.160, or accessibility-tree dumpsys confirming element state.
  - (4) WEBVIEW surfaces: when uiautomator returns near-empty hierarchy, fall back to OCR via screencap then tesseract per §11.4.117; if even OCR is infeasible (secure/DRM-blanked surface), login is operator_attended only - SKIP-with-reason per §11.4.3, NEVER blind-type-and-claim-success.
