  - (5) CREDENTIAL-SAFE OCR: redact credential characters from OCR output and logs per §11.4.10; evidence paths cited via `ab_pass_with_evidence`; evidence file is the redacted screenshot/OCR text.
  - (6) ANTI-BLUFF: every login/interaction PASS MUST cite a captured-evidence artefact path with pre-interaction state, post-interaction state, and OCR/vision verification of the expected change; a PASS without them is a PASS-bluff regardless of exit code; the OCR/vision oracle MUST ship golden-good and golden-bad fixtures per §11.4.107(10).
  - Classification universal (§11.4.17).
- **Gates:** CM-COVENANT-114-193-PROPAGATION, CM-NO-BLIND-TYPING (paired §1.1 mutation: strip OCR verification before an input text FAILs; gate-code = separate work item)
- **No escape hatch:** blind-typing-ok, skip-ocr-verification, assume-input-landed, login-without-proof, type-without-seeing (stated as flags without leading dashes in the source)
- **Honest boundary:** none stated.
- **Composes:** §11.4, §11.4.5, §11.4.6, §11.4.69, §11.4.107, §11.4.117, §11.4.159, §11.4.160, §11.4.10, §11.4.52, §11.4.3, §11.4.17

#### §11.4.201 — Every guard/gate MUST assert the REAL condition; false-positive refusal is a FAIL-bluff, false-negative pass a PASS-bluff
- **Source:** anti-bluff-and-evidence.md:1193-1231
- **Rules:**
  - Every GUARD / GATE / PRE-FLIGHT (host-safety, resource-budget, readiness, lock, capability, availability) MUST assert the REAL condition it claims, resolved from the AUTHORITATIVE source (real `/proc/<pid>/cmdline`, real cgroup/meminfo pressure metric, real lock-holder liveness via `kill -0`, real device identity), NEVER a proxy signal that something not the condition can satisfy (reason: a bare `pgrep -f` carrier match refused every spawn with zero real builds; a "swap full" reading refused a build on a non-real condition).
  - (1) A FALSE-POSITIVE REFUSAL is a FAIL-bluff (§11.4.1): blocking when the condition is ABSENT halts real work and teaches bypassing guards.
  - (2) A FALSE-NEGATIVE PASS is a PASS-bluff (§11.4).
  - (3) SELF-VALIDATED (§11.4.107(10)): every guard MUST ship a golden-TRUE fixture (condition PRESENT -> fires) AND a golden-FALSE fixture INCLUDING the known CARRIER/decoy case (condition ABSENT, proxy present -> MUST NOT fire), both wired into the meta-test; a guard firing on golden-FALSE is itself the defect; shipping without both fixtures is a bluff.
  - (4) CONSERVATIVE-SAFE DEFAULT on unresolvable signal (§11.4.101/§12): take the safe reversible default (refuse destructive/high-blast-radius action; safe side for host/hardware guards) and SAY SO HONESTLY; a refusal that claims a condition never verified is a false positive (§11.4.6).
  - (5) Every refusal MUST print its resolved evidence (real pid+cmdline, real metric+threshold, real lock holder+liveness result).
  - (6) SCOPE widened (2026-07-17) to EVERY load-bearing measurement (grep, count, parse, exit-code check, scan, burn-down metric, artifact inspection), not only guards. Taxonomy is measurement-shaped: FALSE-NULL (zero/empty/no-match read as absence when the instrument could not see) and FALSE-MATCH (hit on something that MENTIONS the thing) are both bluffs; the null is more dangerous.
  - (7)(a) MATCH STRUCTURE, NOT SUBSTRING: distinguish the THING from a CARRIER that mentions it (audit-trail comments, governance text documenting X, process quoting the pattern, the scanner's own command line).
  - (7)(b) A NULL IS NOT EVIDENCE UNTIL A CONTROL NEEDLE proves the instrument can see: the SAME instrument, SAME path, SAME artifact MUST return non-null for a needle KNOWN present; needle not found => instrument blind, report the blindness not the absence (§11.4.6). The needle MUST be expressed through the SAME load-bearing query features (dialect constructs alternation/char class/quantifier/escape, anchoring, quoting, encoding) as the query it certifies; a bare-literal needle certifies only layers a bare literal crosses. Earned inference is bounded: needle found => path can see the needle's QUERY CLASS => a zero from the same class is evidence; a zero using features the needle did not exercise needs a needle of its own class. Generalises §11.4.115(F) per-query; golden fixtures cannot substitute (§11.4.146(D3)). The needle proves the path sees its query class, NOT that the query asks the right question.
  - (7)(c) THE PATH IS PART OF THE INSTRUMENT: tool PLUS every layer the query crosses - wrapper-shell quoting eating escapes, `\|` as literal pipe under ERE, pipeline exit status of the last stage (`check | head`), line-start anchoring missing indented/colour-escaped lines, encoding-sensitive extractors splitting multi-byte chars; each returns clean confident wrong answers without crashing, so only a class-matched control needle catches them.
  - (8) A METRIC MUST BE VALIDATED AGAINST THE DEFINITION OF DONE: before a progress/burn-down/coverage/ratchet metric may gate, rank, or report work, construct the correct end-state and evaluate the metric there; if the correct end-state does not move the metric to target, the metric is INVALID and MUST NOT gate work. §11.4.135's adoption ratchet is such a metric whose validation is OWED (not claimed) and MUST be tracked as a §11.4.197 item by every consuming project operating a ratchet (no claim that any project has filed it). Interim precedence: the §11.4.135(5) ratchet KEEPS GATING; clause (8) does not disarm it and a project MUST NOT cite it to switch its ratchet off; clause (8) binds every NEW metric from now on and the ratchet's validation as owed work.
  - Gate contract (6)-(8): (i) every load-bearing null/zero/absence reported as a finding cites a class-matched control-needle result captured alongside (else FAIL); (ii) needle's query class asserted to match the certified query's load-bearing features (bare-literal needle certifying alternation/anchored/encoded query -> FAIL); (iii) every gating/ranking/reporting metric carries a recorded definition-of-done evaluation reaching target.
  - (9) FIELD-IDENTITY + UNITS + SEMANTICS (capacity is not occupancy): before any metric read from a summary/diagnostic/dashboard may gate a decision, rank work, or propagate into a brief/report/tracker, verify its field identity, units, and semantic class (capacity/limit, occupancy/backlog, rate, cumulative counter, high-water mark) against the authoritative source's definition (§11.4.99). Limit-vs-current, cumulative-vs-delta, advertised-vs-measured are the same defect. A metric carried between agents without field-identity verification is a rumour with units; re-derive from raw source before re-publishing.
  - (10) OBSERVER DECONTAMINATION: any measurement whose instrument contributes to the measured population (probe sockets in a socket census, sampler CPU/IO, probe processes, trace overhead) MUST identify and EXCLUDE its own footprint before reporting AND prove via a (7)(b)-class control needle that the decontaminated instrument still sees genuine signal (over-broad exclusion is a self-inflicted false-null). Composes §11.4.128(1) and §11.4.119.
  - (11) ARTIFACT-USABILITY, NOT PREREQUISITE-PRESENCE: a readiness/install/health/build gate whose claim is about an ARTIFACT MUST probe the ARTIFACT through its real invocation path (§11.4.224(A); §11.4.200 sibling), asserting observable behaviour - NEVER presence of a prerequisite for one of several ways of producing it (compiler, SDK, package manager); the proxy fails in both directions.
  - (12) SHELL-INSTRUMENT FOOTGUN CHECKLIST: standing reference `docs/guides/shell_instrument_footguns.md` (inherited by reference per §11.4.28/§11.4.177, never copied). Founding demonstrated classes: `timeout`/`nice`/`env` exec wrappers cannot run shell functions/aliases (rc=127); `pgrep -f`/`pkill -f` matching the probing script's own command line; structural-delimiter extractors (e.g. column-0 `}` awk) truncating the unit under test into a FALSE PASS; `bash -x` xtrace blinded by code-under-test `exec ... 2>/dev/null` (countermeasure: route trace via `BASH_XTRACEFD` to a dedicated fd). Every §11.4.142/§11.4.209 review of a shell test/gate/guard/measurement MUST consult it; every shell-instrument zero/absence/PASS remains bound by (7)(b). It is a LIVING document: a newly-measured footgun class is APPENDED with captured demonstration (§11.4.5) in the same change-window (§11.4.215).
  - Gate contract (9)-(12): (iv) every load-bearing metric cited in gating/ranking/report carries verified field-identity + units + semantic class traced to authoritative definition; (v) every census/profile whose instrument contributes to the population records observer-exclusion AND a post-exclusion control-needle result; (vi) every artifact-readiness verdict cites a probe of the artifact's own invocation path; (vii) every review record touching a shell instrument cites the §11.4.201(12) checklist consultation.
  - GENERALISES §11.4.196(D) (resource detection by real identity) and §11.4.180 (liveness proven via `kill -0` before reaping) to every guard. Classification universal (§11.4.17); consumer supplies guards, authoritative sources, carrier/decoy fixtures per §11.4.35.
- **Gates:** CM-COVENANT-114-201-PROPAGATION, CM-GUARD-ASSERTS-REAL-CONDITION (guard resolves condition from authoritative source, ships golden-TRUE + golden-FALSE-with-carrier fixtures in meta-test, prints resolved evidence on refusal; extended with measurement-layer invariants (i)-(ii) and (iv)-(vii)), CM-METRIC-VALIDATED-AGAINST-DONE; paired §1.1 mutations: replace authoritative resolution with bare substring/proxy -> golden-FALSE makes gate FAIL; swap class-matched needle for bare literal on dialect-dependent query -> (ii) FAILs; strip needle from a reported absence -> (i) FAILs; register metric whose correct end-state moves away from target -> (iii) FAILs; relabel capacity as occupancy -> (iv) FAILs; strip observer-exclusion -> (v) FAILs; swap artifact probe for bare `command -v <compiler>` on a host with working prebuilt -> (vi) FAILs; gate-code = separate work item, not claimed shipped
- **No escape hatch:** --proxy-signal-OK, --substring-match-guard, --false-positive-refusal-acceptable, --unvalidated-guard, --refuse-without-evidence, --zero-proves-absence, --skip-control-needle, --substring-is-good-enough, --carrier-match-OK, --trust-the-null, --metric-without-done-check, --gate-on-unvalidated-metric, --capacity-is-occupancy-OK, --skip-field-identity-check, --observer-footprint-included-OK, --prerequisite-presence-proves-artifact, --skip-shell-footgun-checklist
- **Honest boundary:** (7)(b) the needle proves the path can see its own query class, NOT that the query is the right question (that stays (8) and §11.4.201(1)); the gate contracts are contracts, not claims that code has shipped (§11.4.6).
- **Composes:** §11.4.1, §11.4.6, §11.4.101, §11.4.107(10), §11.4.109, §11.4.111, §11.4.180, §11.4.196(D), §12, §12.6, §12.8, §12.12, §11.4.115(F), §11.4.146(D3), §11.4.135, §11.4.197, §11.4.99, §11.4.224(A), §11.4.200, §11.4.128(1), §11.4.119, §11.4.142, §11.4.209, §11.4.215, §11.4.28, §11.4.177, §11.4.122, §11.4.17, §11.4.35

#### §11.4.226 — Evidence-class-at-closure + standing detection pressure
- **Source:** anti-bluff-and-evidence.md:1233-1261
- **Rules:**
  - Law: machinery presence (trackers, guards, gates, anchors) is signal and custody, NOT prevention; what predicts whether a fix holds is the EVIDENCE CLASS AT CLOSURE (runtime vs source) under real DETECTION PRESSURE. Prose does not bind - seams do. (Measured: every fix preceded by an on-target RED->GREEN flip held with zero reopens; every fix confirmed only at source-green bounced.) STRICT FORMALIZATION of §11.4.115(F) + §11.4.146(D3) + §11.4.108.
  - (1) Closed evidence-class ranking with per-defect-layer floor at every closure seam: defect layers are the closed set {user-visible, runtime, artifact, source} (§11.4.108); evidence classes are the closed RANKED set {runtime > artifact > source}. Every terminal or ready-class status write carries evidence whose class meets its layer's floor: a user-visible or runtime defect can NEVER close on artifact- or source-class evidence; source-on-source stays legal (§11.4.201(1) false-refusal guard).
  - (2) Class proven by MACHINE FIELDS, never a label: `runtime` requires a target fingerprint read FROM the target at run time (§11.4.115(F)) plus a runtime observable; `artifact` requires artifact path plus content hash; `source` requires the source ref. A class label without its fields is SHAPE-INCOMPLETE and refused; unreadable evidence is BLIND, never accepted.
  - (3) ANTI-ECHO: a "runtime observable" that IS a grep/source-scan transcript is WRONG-LAYER and refused.
  - (4) Per-status evidence preconditions: every status in the §11.4.15/§11.4.33 lifecycle carries a CHECKED evidence precondition, not only the terminal write (a penultimate "ready"-class status parked 79 items, 42% of the done-claiming population, as design-complete-but-UNVERIFIED).
  - (5) Fix-kind honesty: every closure classifies its fix-kind; a STATE-ONLY repair (restart/cache-clear/re-deploy/manual re-run) or a mitigation CANNOT close a defect item as fixed - recorded as mitigation, item stays open or is reclassified (composes §11.4.102 Iron Law, §11.4.146).
  - (6) STANDING DETECTION PRESSURE: a reopen/defect/quality figure reported without its detection-pressure regime is incomparable and misleading (§11.4.6). Every registered, topology-present guard carries a FRESHNESS CONTRACT: a verdict on the CURRENT artifact fingerprint no older than a declared staleness budget. The never-executed/stale-fingerprint/over-budget set feeds a STANDING, risk-ordered re-run queue (most-reopened-first per §11.4.189, then stalest-first) drained by the zero-idle loop (§11.4.94/§11.4.97) as regular development-cycle work; the §11.4.135 release seam remains the blocking BACKSTOP, never the only executor. Topology-absent guards are enumerated, never queued (§11.4.201(1)); an empty registry is BLIND, never "all fresh"; staleness budgets are consumer data (§11.4.35) bounded by alarm-fatigue trade-off; the queue is a work FEED, only the release seam blocks.
  - Regular-cycle + review + pull binding: applies during EVERY regular development cycle; CHECKED through every code-review per §11.4.194(6); on every constitution fetch/pull the §11.4.32 post-pull sweep + §11.4.164 hook analyze additions and run gates against the post-pull tree, violations tracked (§11.4.15) and cleared - no parallel mechanism.
  - Reference mechanisms (SOL-01 status-custody, SOL-02 verdict-coverage, SOL-04 evidence-class, SOL-09 detection-pressure under `docs/research/quality/solutions/`) are proven but NOT wired and carry no force until wired by tracked §11.4.197 work items (§11.4.205); §11.4.227(A) ledger keeps the debt visible.
  - Classification universal (§11.4.17); consumer supplies defect-layer bindings, evidence-store paths, verdict registries, staleness budgets as DATA per §11.4.35.
- **Gates:** CM-COVENANT-114-226-PROPAGATION, CM-EVIDENCE-CLASS-AT-CLOSURE (every terminal/ready status write carries class-matched machine-field-proven evidence meeting the floor; grep-transcript "runtime observable" FAILs; state-only repair closing defect FAILs), CM-GUARD-FRESHNESS-SCHEDULER (every registered topology-present guard fresh on current fingerprint or in the visible risk-ordered queue; empty registry = BLIND); paired §1.1 mutations (runtime-layer item closed on source evidence, runtime label with no machine fields, stale guard with no queue entry, stripped literal); gate-code = separate work item, not claimed shipped
- **No escape hatch:** --source-green-closes-runtime-defect, --label-is-class, --echo-observable-OK, --registration-is-coverage, --rate-without-pressure-regime, --mitigation-closes-defect, --skip-freshness-queue
- **Honest boundary:** (i) discriminator is a measured correlation with stated mechanism, NOT a randomized trial; (ii) fabricated machine fields not fully closed here (stays with §11.4.115(F) harness-written verdicts + §11.4.135 candidate-fingerprint join); (iii) oracle calibration stays §11.4.107(10); (iv) the defect-layer taxonomy is authored data - mislabelling lowers the floor (§11.4.194(6)(a) review is the detective counter); (v) re-running a weak guard proves little - oracle strength stays §1.1/§11.4.115(F); orthogonal discovery (§11.4.85, §11.4.118) is a different feed.
- **Composes:** §11.4.1, §11.4.5, §11.4.6, §11.4.15, §11.4.33, §11.4.69, §11.4.94, §11.4.97, §11.4.102, §11.4.107(10), §11.4.108, §11.4.115(F), §11.4.118, §11.4.123, §11.4.132, §11.4.135, §11.4.146(D3), §11.4.185, §11.4.189, §11.4.194(6), §11.4.201, §11.4.205, §11.4.214, §11.4.227(A), §11.4.32, §11.4.164, §11.4.197, §11.4.35, §11.4.17

#### §11.4.262 — Machine-created evidence at every gate
- **Source:** anti-bluff-and-evidence.md:1263-1285
- **Rules:**
  - Every claim that something WORKS / PASSES / IS VERIFIED / IS PRODUCTION-READY MUST be backed by MACHINE-CREATED, MACHINE-VERIFIABLE evidence produced by the gate itself, cited by path + content-hash (sha256) + timestamp, with a schema an independent verifier can parse. Operator eyeballing, human narrative, "I checked it works", "looks fine", "no error was reported", prediction, guessing, assumption are FORBIDDEN at the evidence layer. Strengthens the §11.4 covenant from "captured evidence" to MACHINE-CREATED evidence; §11.4.107(10) golden-good/golden-bad self-validating analyzer applies UNIVERSALLY.
  - (A) THREE-GATE COVERAGE, each producing machine-created evidence: (1) CONFIRMATION (change lands correctly: source review, static analysis, format/lint, dependency clash check per §11.4.110); (2) VALIDATION (behaves as designed at each of the §11.4.108 four layers SOURCE/ARTIFACT/RUNTIME/USER-VISIBLE, each with its own machine verdict + evidence artifact); (3) VERIFICATION (satisfies acceptance contract: §11.4.185 manual QA = human sufficiency gate, §11.4.236 QA-deploy-readiness = machine sufficiency gate, each with its own captured evidence).
  - (B) Four properties of every evidence artifact: (i) PRODUCED BY THE GATE, not authored by the tester; (ii) MACHINE-VERIFIABLE (schema-parseable JSON verdict, JSONL event stream, structured log, image with OCR/vision oracle per §11.4.107(11)/§11.4.117, audio with RMS/loudness) re-checkable by an independent verifier; (iii) CONTENT-ADDRESSED (path + sha256 + timestamp, §11.4.207); (iv) SEMANTIC-CLASS-MATCHED to the claim layer (§11.4.226 wrong-layer echo forbidden).
  - (C) NO NARRATIVE-ONLY PASS: a PASS whose evidence is natural-language narrative by an operator/subagent is a violation; narrative may accompany but MUST NEVER substitute. §11.4.185 manual QA remains a human gate whose OWN evidence is machine-created (QA session recording per §11.4.128, checklist file with per-item PASS/FAIL + evidence path, §11.4.238 escape-log).
  - (D) Every evidence analyzer is itself golden-good + golden-bad + negative-control validated per §11.4.107(10); an analyzer that PASSes golden-bad is the bluff and a release-blocker. Every "works" claim cites the analyzer verdict + raw evidence so an independent re-run reproduces it.
  - (E) At each of the four §11.4.108 layers the PASS cites machine evidence PRODUCED AT THAT LAYER (source: static-analysis JSON + review artifact; artifact: build log + fingerprint checksum + byte-check of landed bytes; runtime: on-target verdict + runtime signature + telemetry; user-visible: OCR/vision oracle output or sink-side probe report per §11.4.13/§11.4.69/§11.4.107). A higher-layer PASS citing only lower-layer evidence is a §11.4.226 wrong-layer violation; the chain runs THROUGH the layers, never skips.
  - (F) STANDING DEFAULT (§11.4.126/§11.4.198) from the first prompt: every subagent dispatch, review, test run, gate emits its evidence artifact into the project's content-addressed evidence store (§11.4.207), machine-searchable; a status report that predicts "should pass" without citing a run's evidence is a bluff at the reporting layer.
  - Classification universal (§11.4.17).
- **Gates:** CM-COVENANT-114-262-PROPAGATION, CM-MACHINE-EVIDENCE-AT-EVERY-GATE, CM-EVIDENCE-ANALYZER-SELF-VALIDATED, CM-NO-NARRATIVE-ONLY-PASS, CM-EVIDENCE-LAYER-MATCH-108 (paired §1.1 mutations)
- **No escape hatch:** --narrative-pass-OK, --operator-eyeball, --should-pass-suffices, --skip-evidence-analyzer-validation, --evidence-optional, --pass-without-machine-artifact, --predict-success
- **Honest boundary:** Mandates every PASS is backed by machine evidence and the analyzer self-validated; does NOT claim machine evidence proves human satisfaction (§11.4.185 remains); does NOT license shipping when machine evidence disagrees with reality (an automation-missed bug is a §11.4.238 escape triggering coverage audit + vocabulary extension per §11.4.261). "Machine-created" is bounded to the artifact - the decision whether a gate passed remains human-authored policy.
- **Composes:** §11.4, §11.4.1, §11.4.5, §11.4.6, §11.4.13, §11.4.15, §11.4.20, §11.4.27, §11.4.50, §11.4.66, §11.4.69, §11.4.85, §11.4.98, §11.4.107(10)(11)(12), §11.4.108, §11.4.110, §11.4.115(F), §11.4.116, §11.4.117, §11.4.126, §11.4.128, §11.4.135, §11.4.169, §11.4.185, §11.4.198, §11.4.201, §11.4.207, §11.4.226, §11.4.236, §11.4.238, §11.4.259, §11.4.260, §11.4.261, §11.4.17

#### §11.4.268 — Tamper-evident evidence chain + periodic anchor record
- **Source:** anti-bluff-and-evidence.md:1287-1297
- **Rules:**
  - Every accepted evidence record (the §11.4.115(F) verdict store, the §11.4.116 event stream, or equivalent ledger) MUST be tamper-evident against THREE attacks: (1) deleting an entry, (2) reordering two entries, (3) truncating the tail; the mechanism detecting each MUST be named. A forward-hash-chain alone does NOT detect delete-then-recompute-forward (0.43 s for 100k entries per spec FR-029); closing that gap requires a SEPARATE periodic anchor record the producer can append to but never rewrite.
  - (A) Scope: binds the declared COVERED-CALL SET (consumer-declared as DATA per §11.4.35) - not a fleet-wide every-write obligation. A state-changing call within the set (write, exec, deploy) MUST produce a matching chain entry. An UNCITED read (result backs no claim) MUST NOT be required to produce an entry; a read result CITED in support of a claim MUST have a chain entry. Distinction is CITED-vs-UNCITED, never present-vs-absent-in-storage.
  - (B) Integrity check MUST report a deleted entry or two reordered entries when the chain after them is NOT reconstructed; content-mutation detection alone does not satisfy; the check walks the FULL forward chain recomputing every link, not spot-checking. A recomputed chain defeats (B) alone.
  - (C) The ANCHOR is the only mechanism catching recomputed-forward deletion or tail truncation: a periodic anchor entry (chain head digest AND entry count) recorded to a location the producer can APPEND to but NOT REWRITE, written on a declared interval. Strength recorded honestly as `mechanism` (cryptographically/append-only enforced: git commit history, write-once object store, or consumer-declared equivalent) or `policy` (procedural only); `mechanism` MUST NOT be claimed without evidence that rewriting is mechanically prevented, else `policy`. Anchor verification detects tail truncation that chain-alone PASSES; a tamper-free verdict MUST name BOTH the chain-walk result AND the anchor cross-check result - "chain verified clean" is never sufficient alone.
  - (D) Verification that cannot complete (chain truncated mid-verification, anchor location unreachable) MUST yield REFUSAL (UNVERIFIED status, per §11.4.201 conservative-safe default), never a clean pass by default; "could not verify" and "verified clean" are never the same state.
  - Where a content-addressed atomic store already exists (§11.4.207 continuum), REUSE its chaining primitive; MUST NOT stand up a parallel divergent chain implementation (§11.4.227 applied to mechanism reuse).
  - Classification universal (§11.4.17); consumer supplies chain implementation, anchor location, anchor interval, covered-call set as DATA.
- **Gates:** CM-COVENANT-114-268-PROPAGATION (literal as block-start, exactly-once per governance file, lockstep content-hash equality per §11.4.227(B)), CM-EVIDENCE-CHAIN-DELETE-REORDER-DETECTED, CM-EVIDENCE-CHAIN-ANCHOR-CATCHES-RECOMPUTE-AND-TRUNCATION (anchor on declared interval with head-digest + entry-count + honest strength; cross-check detects recomputed-forward deletion and tail truncation), CM-EVIDENCE-CHAIN-INCOMPLETE-VERIFICATION-REFUSES; paired §1.1 mutations (delete middle entry + recompute forward: chain-alone PASS, anchor cross-check FAIL; truncate tail: chain-alone PASS, anchor FAIL; unreachable anchor -> UNVERIFIED never PASS; golden-FALSE: untampered chain with fresh reachable anchor fires none); gate-code = separate work item, not claimed shipped
- **No escape hatch:** --content-mutation-detection-suffices, --skip-anchor-record, --claim-mechanism-strength-unverified, --chain-truncation-passes-by-default, --reconstructed-chain-is-clean
- **Honest boundary:** Detects deletion/reordering/tail-truncation of ALREADY-RECORDED entries; does NOT prove the first entry was truthful (content only as trustworthy as the harness: §11.4.115(F), §11.4.240) and does not make evidence CORRECT, only tamper-EVIDENT.
- **Composes:** §11.4.5, §11.4.6, §11.4.69, §11.4.115(F), §11.4.116, §11.4.201, §11.4.205, §11.4.207, §11.4.226, §11.4.262, §11.4.240, §11.4.227, §11.4.35, §11.4.17, §9.2, §1.1

#### §11.4.269 — Critic/consensus advisory-only ban at the evidence-acceptance seam
- **Source:** anti-bluff-and-evidence.md:1301-1313
- **Rules:**
  - At the evidence-acceptance / claim-adjudication seam (where a producer's DONE/PASS claim is accepted/refused and producer-verifier DISAGREEMENT is adjudicated), an UNGOVERNED second opinion (confidence score, LLM-judge output, or consensus aggregation, none produced under the constitution's own independent-review discipline) MUST be admitted ADVISORY-ONLY, never as the mechanism deciding accept/refuse. Disagreement is adjudicated on the recorded receipt, never on confidence or argument quality; an LLM judge is barred from being the gate.
  - This anchor is NARROWER than "no second model may review": it does NOT weaken, override, or substitute for the mandatory independent-review-verdict family §11.4.125, §11.4.134, §11.4.142, §11.4.165, §11.4.209 (Opus `xhigh`), §11.4.237, §11.4.256 - those remain fully in force, receipt-generating, gating (NO-GO blocks build per §11.4.125 and re-arms iterate-to-GO per §11.4.134).
  - (A) `critic` = second/Nth model instance, confidence score, or LLM-judge offering an OPINION WITHOUT itself being a structurally-separated receipt-generating review under the seven anchors above; `consensus` = aggregation (voting, averaging, LLM-judge score) of such ungoverned opinions. Both are adoptable; only misuse as a gate at this seam is forbidden. A verdict from the mandatory review family is NOT a critic.
  - (B) A claim whose ONLY support is an ungoverned critic/consensus/confidence signal MUST be REFUSED, naming the missing receipt. A receipt (machine-written §11.4.115(F) verdict, §11.4.268 evidence-chain entry, or a mandatory independent review's own recorded GO/NO-GO under the seven anchors) is the ONLY basis for adjudicating producer-verifier disagreement.
  - (C) The SAME claim evaluated with and without the ungoverned critic step MUST produce the IDENTICAL accept/refuse outcome; a pipeline where disabling it changes the verdict uses it as a gate. This test is scoped to the OPTIONAL ungoverned critic only - skipping a REQUIRED review is itself a violation of those anchors.
  - (D) Ungoverned critic output MUST be recorded with role `advisory` in a SEPARATE store and MUST NOT appear in any §11.4.268/§11.4.115(F) evidence chain. A mandatory review's own GO/NO-GO continues to be entered into the evidence record (§11.4.125 review-completed marker, §11.4.134 clean-GO record) and is not downgraded to advisory.
  - (E) Rationale: an ungoverned critic wired into the acceptance gate collapses ORACLE and GATE into one mechanism not independent of the producer's failure surface (correlated model errors), the maximum-severity collapse §11.4.240/§11.4.249 name; the mandatory family avoids it by structural separation per §11.4.240.
  - (F) The ban is scoped to the evidence-acceptance/claim-adjudication seam and does NOT weaken the seven mandatory reviews. Forbidden: (i) treating an ungoverned opinion as a substitute receipt; (ii) letting an ungoverned signal, rather than a recorded receipt (including one from the seven-anchor family), adjudicate producer-verifier disagreement. A project MUST NOT cite §11.4.269 to skip, weaken, downgrade-to-advisory, or make optional any of the seven mandatory reviews - that is itself a §11.4.269(F) violation.
  - Classification universal (§11.4.17); consumer supplies critic implementation, advisory-record location, and its own fixed list of mandatory review-verdict anchors per §11.4.35.
- **Gates:** CM-COVENANT-114-269-PROPAGATION (literal as block-start, exactly-once per governance file, lockstep content-hash equality per §11.4.227(B)), CM-CRITIC-CONSENSUS-ADVISORY-ONLY (claim supported only by ungoverned signal refused; outcome identical with/without critic; stored critic output has role `advisory` and is in no evidence chain; mandatory reviews never downgraded or excluded); paired §1.1 mutations (wire critic approve/reject into pass/fail; store critic output with no role or role `verdict` or in chain; downgrade a mandatory review to advisory citing §11.4.269; golden-FALSE: advisory-recorded critic with unchanged outcome fires none, and a §11.4.125 NO-GO blocking the build fires none); gate-code = separate work item, not claimed shipped
- **No escape hatch:** --critic-may-gate, --consensus-score-is-a-receipt, --llm-judge-is-the-gate, --critic-output-in-evidence-chain-OK, --outcome-may-differ-with-critic, --269-overrides-mandatory-review, --downgrade-mandatory-review-to-advisory
- **Honest boundary:** Does not forbid using an ungoverned critic to prioritise human review, surface candidate defects for §11.4.102, or as one input an independent verifier weighs when authoring a gate; forbids only automated GATING substituting for a receipt-backed oracle/gate/verifier chain. Critic output is advisory unless produced under the mandatory review family, in which case it is a receipt.
- **Composes:** §11.4.6, §11.4.69, §11.4.115(F), §11.4.125, §11.4.134, §11.4.142, §11.4.165, §11.4.209, §11.4.237, §11.4.256, §11.4.240, §11.4.249, §11.4.268, §11.4.102, §11.4.201, §11.4.227, §11.4.35, §11.4.17, §1.1

#### §11.4.270 — Dependency-existence-verdict register
- **Source:** anti-bluff-and-evidence.md:1317-1328
- **Rules:**
  - A project adopting an external (or cross-module) dependency to close a coverage gap MUST first record a closed-set EXISTENCE verdict {VERIFIED, AMBIGUOUS, UNVERIFIED} with a citable artifact or an explicit statement that none was found. Existence verification is NECESSARY but NOT SUFFICIENT for adoption ("existing is not the same as working"): VERIFIED is the floor, never a fitness claim.
  - (A) One register row per claimed dependency, keyed by stable identifier (name + version + source per §11.4.111), carrying the verdict + evidence field.
  - (B) Verdict semantics, evidence-based, never promoted by omission: UNVERIFIED is the honest default (no independent confirmation attempted MUST NOT be treated as VERIFIED); AMBIGUOUS when evidence conflicts or a name collides with an unrelated project (never VERIFIED), with the specific conflicting evidence recorded; VERIFIED requires an independently-reproducible check (real resolve + checksum/hash match, real successful call/import, or control-needle-proven presence per §11.4.201(7)(b)).
  - (C) Adoption MUST be REFUSED while the verdict is UNVERIFIED or AMBIGUOUS; admitted only after the row resolves to VERIFIED (or the AMBIGUOUS conflict is investigated and re-verdicted).
  - (D) Adoption is refused unless the dependency maps to one of the project's own recorded uncovered capability gaps (adopting for an already-covered capability is refused, naming the covering rule - §11.4.227 duplicate-coverage discipline). Adoption MUST NOT be accepted before the wiring step reports its sweep result (§11.4.124/§11.4.196(F) investigate-before-adopt).
  - (E) The count of external dependencies adopted without a VERIFIED verdict is ZERO, monotonic, checked at the same seam that refuses unwired-gate names per §11.4.227(A).
  - Classification universal (§11.4.17); consumer supplies register location, recorded uncovered-gap set, wiring-sweep mechanism as DATA per §11.4.35.
- **Gates:** CM-COVENANT-114-270-PROPAGATION (literal as block-start, exactly-once per governance file, lockstep content-hash equality per §11.4.227(B)), CM-DEPENDENCY-EXISTENCE-VERDICT-REGISTER (every claimed dependency has a row with closed-set verdict + evidence; name collision resolves AMBIGUOUS; shipped change relying on UNVERIFIED/AMBIGUOUS row refused; adoption refused when already-covered or precedes wiring-sweep result); paired §1.1 mutations (adopt with no row; UNVERIFIED row adopted anyway; name-collision fixture resolving VERIFIED; golden-FALSE: genuinely verified, uncovered-gap-mapped, post-sweep adoption fires none); gate-code = separate work item, not claimed shipped
- **No escape hatch:** --unverified-adoption-OK, --ambiguous-treated-as-verified, --skip-wiring-sweep-before-adopt, --adopt-already-covered-capability, --existence-proves-fitness
- **Honest boundary:** Proves EXISTENCE/RESOLVABILITY was checked and recorded; does NOT prove correct behaviour for the adopted purpose (§11.4.244 integration/contract testing) nor security/maintenance (§11.4.246 supply-chain). Deliberately narrow: closes the existence-claim bluff only.
- **Composes:** §11.4.6, §11.4.69, §11.4.111, §11.4.124, §11.4.196(F), §11.4.201(7)(b), §11.4.227(A), §11.4.244, §11.4.246, §11.4.74, §11.4.31, §11.4.150, §11.4.35, §11.4.17, §1.1

#### §11.4.271 — Waiver mechanism: strict formalization of allow-with-tracked-debt
- **Source:** anti-bluff-and-evidence.md:1332-1343
- **Rules:**
  - A waiver is a tracked, expiring, human-authorised exception that ALLOWS a change to proceed despite a normally-blocking missing-evidence condition - never silent, never permanent. It FORMALIZES (does not discover) the existing precedents: §11.4.234(D) recorded deferral flag, §11.4.236(4) explicit recorded override, §11.4.248(A) deadline-bound quarantine; it adds one strict cross-gate schema (rostered non-producer authoriser + mandatory unelapsed expiry + mandatory tracked item). Distinct from refusal vocabulary (§11.4.21) and closure vocabulary (§11.4.90).
  - (A) A waiver exists at a seam that would otherwise refuse (missing receipt, unresolved dependency verdict, unmet acceptance scenario, any normally-blocking condition); invoked explicitly, never inferred; never disables the gate permanently - grants a bounded exception to ONE candidate. A gate already implementing an allow-with-debt path under §11.4.234/.236/.248 satisfies this by conforming that mechanism to the roster + expiry + tracked-item schema (B)-(D); no reimplementation required.
  - (B) Authorisation MUST resolve to an identity in the declared authoriser roster (consumer DATA per §11.4.35); free-text authorisation ("looks fine") is refused as an absent one is; a genuinely rostered identity is accepted (false-positive guard). The producer of the change under waiver MUST NOT be its own waiver's authoriser (§11.4.240).
  - (C) Expiry is REQUIRED and MUST NOT have elapsed: a waiver with NO expiry or an elapsed expiry is refused; a future expiry is accepted. Absent expiry is NOT "valid forever". An elapsed waiver's gate reverts to blocking automatically - no grace period, no silent auto-renewal.
  - (D) A waiver MUST name a tracked item (stable §11.4.54 id, bound to §11.4.15/§11.4.16/§11.4.33/§11.4.197 lifecycle) for the blocker that remains open; a waiver naming none MUST be refused. An unresolved waiver is surfaced by the §11.4.261 standing audit as a finding, never silently forgotten.
  - (E) Composition, not substitution: a waiver whose expiry lapses UNRESOLVED re-enters the §11.4.21 Operator-blocked class; its tracked item CAN close via §11.4.90 Obsolete if the requirement genuinely changed; neither §11.4.21 nor §11.4.90 substitutes for the waiver mechanism (misuse). §11.4.234(D), §11.4.236(4), §11.4.248(A) are NOT replaced - each remains the correct narrower mechanism for its seam class; §11.4.271 is the schema they conform to when carrying roster + expiry + tracked item.
  - Classification universal (§11.4.17); consumer supplies authoriser roster, expiry mechanism, tracked-item store as DATA per §11.4.35.
- **Gates:** CM-COVENANT-114-271-PROPAGATION (literal as block-start, exactly-once per governance file, lockstep content-hash equality per §11.4.227(B)), CM-WAIVER-ROSTERED-EXPIRY-TRACKED (every active waiver has a rostered non-producer authoriser, future unelapsed expiry, named §11.4.54 tracked item; missing any one invalidates it and the gate reverts to blocking); paired §1.1 mutations (free-text/absent authorisation, no/elapsed expiry, no tracked item, authoriser == producer each FAIL; golden-FALSE: valid waiver fires none); gate-code = separate work item, not claimed shipped
- **No escape hatch:** --free-text-authorisation-OK, --waiver-without-expiry, --elapsed-waiver-still-valid, --waiver-without-tracked-item, --producer-may-self-waive, --permanent-waiver-renewal
- **Honest boundary:** Formalizes, does not discover, the allow-with-tracked-debt category; deliberately strict because a waiver is the one path that lets a defect ship unfixed. Does not weaken the bypassed gate for other candidates and does not authorise indefinite or permanently-renewed waivers - an expiry pushed forward without the debt closing is itself a §11.4.261 finding.
- **Composes:** §11.4.6, §11.4.15, §11.4.16, §11.4.21, §11.4.33, §11.4.35, §11.4.54, §11.4.90, §11.4.146(D3), §11.4.197, §11.4.234(D), §11.4.236(4), §11.4.248(A), §11.4.240, §11.4.261, §11.4.115(F), §11.4.17, §1.1


### Code review and quality (12 anchors: 11 from the index plus §11.4.276, which the lagging index does not list)

#### §11.4.124 — Dead/unwired-code investigate-before-remove mandate
- **Source:** code-review-and-quality.md:3-27
- **Rules:**
  - "Zero importers / never called / unwired, so delete it" is a guess (§11.4.6), not a finding; a grep/static "no references" result proves only current non-reference. Apparent-deadness has distinct causes: call-site deleted by mistake (regression), wiring never finished, reflective/dynamic/build-tag/plugin/DI reference the tool cannot see, or genuinely obsolete.
  - Before removing ANY seemingly-dead element (function, method, type, file, module, package, asset, config, build target) the agent MUST FIRST investigate git history (`git log --follow`, `git log -S<symbol>` / `-G<regex>` pickaxe across all history, `git log --diff-filter`, blame on the former call-site deletion) and capture as FACT: (1) where/how it was originally used or wired; (2) when/how it became dead (deliberate, mistaken, never completed, refactor-unreachable); (3) whether "no references" is real or hidden (reflection, dynamic dispatch, build-tags, codegen, DI, plugin registry, FFI, config-driven wiring). The cited commits + determination are the captured evidence.
  - Removal is permitted ONLY with captured PROOF the element is genuinely unneeded (purpose superseded, former caller intentionally and permanently gone, no hidden reference).
  - With proof, removal MUST be its OWN SEPARATE COMMIT (not bundled with unrelated work) with a descriptive message citing the git-history evidence and, for end-user-facing capability, the §11.4.122 operator confirmation; track via §11.4.90 as `Obsolete (-> Fixed.md)` with the appropriate reason.
  - Without proof the element MUST NOT be removed: investigate where/how it should be wired (restore the deleted call-site if a regression per §11.4.114; finish intended wiring) AND add any missing/unwired tests (composes §11.4.27, §11.4.43, §11.4.115). Apparent-deadness without removal-proof is a wiring/coverage gap, never delete-on-sight.
  - Extra-caution default: when uncertain, do NOT remove (investigate + wire + test); "probably dead" is never sufficient; an irreversible possibly-needed removal whose safety cannot be proven blocks to the operator (§11.4.101, §11.4.122).
  - Classification universal (§11.4.17); consumer supplies static-analysis/importer-graph tooling and hidden-reference mechanisms per §11.4.35.
- **Gates:** CM-COVENANT-114-124-PROPAGATION, CM-DEAD-CODE-INVESTIGATE-BEFORE-REMOVE (any net-deletion commit of a code element MUST be a removal-only commit citing git-history evidence, or part of a tracked Obsolete item per §11.4.90; bundled or uncited FAILs; paired §1.1 mutations: strip literal, add uncited net-deletion commit; gate-code is a separate work item)
- **No escape hatch:** --zero-importers-means-dead, --delete-unwired-on-sight, --skip-git-history-investigation, --remove-without-proof, --bundle-removal-with-other-work
- **Honest boundary:** none stated beyond: non-compliance is a release blocker; gate implementation lands as a follow-up work item.
- **Composes:** §11.4.6, §11.4.8, §11.4.84, §11.4.92, §11.4.90, §11.4.101, §11.4.114, §11.4.122, §11.4.27, §11.4.43, §11.4.115, §11.4.35

#### §11.4.125 — Code-review-agent gate before pre-build + main build
- **Source:** code-review-and-quality.md:29-51
- **Rules:**
  - Pre-build gates and the build prove consistency/buildability, not that the work is correct, safe, will-really-work, or that its tests catch its negation; that is an independent-review responsibility that MUST run BEFORE the build.
  - After all fixes/changes/implementations of a batch are done, and BEFORE the pre-build test sweep and main (artifact) build (any project), the agent MUST dispatch one or more dedicated code-review agents (subagent-driven by default, §11.4.70/§11.4.20) performing a multi-layer review.
  - The review MUST: (1) analyze ALL work in the batch (source diff and stated intent); (2) analyze ALL existing data and facts (captured evidence per §11.4.5/§11.4.69/§11.4.107, tracker entries, prior findings, §11.4.108 runtime-signature registry); (3) analyze the existing codebase (blast radius, cross-feature interaction, contract integrity of dependencies); (4) analyze current git history (what each change touched, composition with concurrent work, repetition of a known-broken pattern, §11.4.114/§11.4.124); (5) determine quality, safety and will-it-REALLY-work (robust, not solve-A-create-B, no host/data/security regression, genuinely delivers claimed end-user behaviour); (6) validate and verify that every covering test genuinely exercises the work and catches its negation with ZERO chance of false result or bluff (a test that PASSes on broken-for-user work, metadata-only/config-only/absence-of-error/grep-without-runtime assertions, or a gate whose paired §1.1 mutation does not make it FAIL is a finding, per §11.4.1/§11.4.6/§11.4.107/§1.1).
  - Any finding (defect, error-prone change, safety risk, will-not-work, bluff-capable test, coverage gap) BLOCKS the build: it MUST be fixed, polished, improved and covered with additional tests (four-layer per §11.4.4(b), TDD-RED-first per §11.4.43/§11.4.115) BEFORE the pre-build sweep and main build proceed.
  - The review MUST iterate (re-review after each remediation) until no blocking findings remain; only then does the build proceed.
  - The review is itself anti-bluff: conclusions are captured evidence (§11.4.5/§11.4.69); a rubber-stamp of a defective batch is the same severity as a PASS-bluff.
  - It is one of multiple strong layers complementing, never replacing, the pre-build sweep, §11.4.92 multi-pass, §11.4.108, §11.4.110, and post-build/runtime layers; it adds the structurally-separated reviewer seam (§11.4.92 is author-side self-review).
  - Classification universal (§11.4.17); consumer supplies review-marker mechanism and build-orchestrator integration per §11.4.35.
- **Gates:** CM-COVENANT-114-125-PROPAGATION, CM-CODE-REVIEW-GATE-BEFORE-BUILD (build orchestrator records a code-review-completed marker with findings and remediation-or-no-blocking determination, produced AFTER the batch's last fix and BEFORE pre-build sweep + main build; a build without a fresh marker FAILs; paired §1.1 mutations: strip literal, start build with no marker; gate-code is a separate work item)
- **No escape hatch:** --skip-code-review, --build-without-review, --no-review-gate, --review-optional, --trust-the-author
- **Honest boundary:** Review is one of multiple layers; it does not replace pre-build sweep, §11.4.92, §11.4.108, §11.4.110 or runtime layers.
- **Composes:** §11.4, §11.4.1, §11.4.4, §11.4.5, §11.4.6, §11.4.40, §11.4.43, §11.4.50, §11.4.70, §11.4.20, §11.4.92, §11.4.102, §11.4.107, §11.4.108, §11.4.110, §11.4.114, §11.4.124, §11.4.115, §11.4.69, §11.4.35, §1.1

#### §11.4.134 — Code-review iterate-until-GO + rock-solid-evidence mandate
- **Source:** code-review-and-quality.md:55-67 (the 2026-10-05 EXTENSION bullet: Constitution.md (constitution tip a71b1767) lines 9110-9111; groups/ at this tip does not carry it, see the evidence note pin-upstream-findings.md)
- **Rules:**
  - When the §11.4.125 code-review returns ANY finding (BLOCKING, nit, or warning) and the author fixes the batch, the review MUST BE RE-RUN, and KEEP being re-run after each remediation round, until it returns a clean GO with ZERO new issues AND ZERO warnings of any kind.
  - A single pass that "addressed the findings" is NOT sufficient: the corrected batch MUST pass a FRESH adversarial review (fixes can introduce new findings, fix-A-creates-B). A residual warning is itself a finding that re-arms the loop; the loop terminates ONLY on a clean GO.
  - Every round's verdict AND every fix's validation MUST carry rock-solid PHYSICAL captured evidence per §11.4.5/§11.4.69/§11.4.107 (captured audio/video/sysfs/dumpsys/sink-side/runtime-signature) proving the fixed codebase really works on the target; never metadata-only/configuration-only/absence-of-error/grep-without-runtime. No false results, no bluff at any round. A GO unbacked by captured physical evidence is a §11.4 PASS-bluff at the review-loop layer.
  - Refines/strengthens §11.4.125: makes the loop explicit (re-run after every round), raises the termination bar to zero findings AND zero warnings, binds physical evidence to every round.
  - EXTENSION (2026-10-05): the re-run obligation ("MUST KEEP being re-run after each remediation round, until it returns a clean GO") is bounded PER APPROACH by §11.4.276's declared round budget; at that ceiling the item is escalated per §11.4.276(E)(3) to a recorded operator decision, never closed, never continued round-by-round indefinitely under the same approach, and never silently relaxed to "good enough".
  - Classification universal (§11.4.17).
- **Gates:** CM-COVENANT-114-134-PROPAGATION, CM-CODE-REVIEW-ITERATE-UNTIL-GO (plus paired §1.1 meta-test mutation; gate-code is a separate work item)
- **No escape hatch:** --skip-rereview, --single-review-pass, --warnings-ok, --evidence-optional
- **Honest boundary:** none stated.
- **Composes:** §11.4.125, §11.4.1, §11.4.4, §11.4.5, §11.4.6, §11.4.69, §11.4.107, §11.4.50, §11.4.108, §11.4.123

#### §11.4.142 — Universal code-review mandate: every change reviewed, always, no exception
- **Source:** code-review-and-quality.md:69-87
- **Rules:**
  - EVERY change to ANY repository governed by this Constitution MUST pass an INDEPENDENT code-review step BEFORE it is accepted, committed, or built. No change class is exempt: source, fixes, tests, gates, meta-test mutations, documentation, doc-tooling, build/CI scripts, configuration, governance files (Constitution/CLAUDE/AGENTS/QWEN), conductor main-stream edits, sub-agent output, refactors, single-line edits. If a diff exists, it gets an independent review.
  - This is the ABSOLUTE form of §11.4.125: no "just a doc edit", "just a one-liner", "author already self-reviewed (§11.4.92)", or "trivial change" exemption.
  - Independence is load-bearing: reviewer MUST be structurally separated from the author (dedicated code-review agent, subagent-driven default per §11.4.70/§11.4.20, or distinct human); §11.4.92 self-evaluation remains required but does NOT satisfy §11.4.142; a self-review labelled as the review step is a violation (PASS-bluff class at the review layer).
  - The review is itself anti-bluff: a rubber-stamp "looks good" with no examined findings is not a review; it MUST analyse correctness, safety (host §12, data §9, target-hardware §11.4.133), will-it-really-work (no solve-A-create-B), end-user behaviour (§11.4/§107), and test-genuineness (every covering test exercises the work and catches its negation per §1.1); conclusions are captured evidence (§11.4.5/§11.4.69).
  - The review iterates to a clean GO per §11.4.134: any finding (BLOCKING/nit/warning) re-arms the loop; accept only after a re-run returns ZERO new findings AND ZERO warnings with rock-solid physical evidence.
  - Review comes BEFORE commit/push; a post-hoc review that catches a Blocking issue proves the mandate and is not a substitute; remediation is fix-forward per §11.4.113, never a history rewrite. (Teaching fact: a change pushed to main pre-review later got NO-GO with a BLOCKING security-default finding already public on mirrors.)
  - Composition: §11.4.125 supplies review content and build-gate marker; §11.4.134 supplies iterate-until-GO loop; §11.4.92 supplies preceding author-side self-review; §11.4.70/§11.4.20 supply the subagent execution model. The review is a precondition on ACCEPTANCE of any diff.
  - Classification universal (§11.4.17); consumer supplies reviewer-dispatch mechanism and change-acceptance seam (commit wrapper / merge queue / PR gate) per §11.4.35.
- **Gates:** CM-COVENANT-114-142-PROPAGATION, CM-EVERY-CHANGE-REVIEWED (every accepted change carries a fresh independent-review-completed marker for its diff, by a reviewer distinct from the author, before acceptance/commit/build; paired §1.1 mutations: strip literal, accept diff with no marker; gate-code is a separate work item)
- **No escape hatch:** --skip-review, --no-review, --trivial-change-exempt, --doc-edit-exempt, --self-review-suffices, --review-after-commit
- **Honest boundary:** A passing review proves independent examination to the reviewer's evidence; it does NOT replace §11.4.108 four-layer runtime-signature verification or §11.4.40 full-suite retest; it is the FIRST of multiple strong layers.
- **Composes:** §11.4.1, §11.4.4, §11.4.5, §11.4.6, §11.4.20, §11.4.40, §11.4.69, §11.4.70, §11.4.92, §11.4.108, §11.4.110, §11.4.125, §11.4.134, §11.4.113, §11.4.133, §11.4.209, §11.4.35, §107, §1.1
- **Gates (completeness patch):** CM-CODE-REVIEW-GATE-BEFORE-BUILD (recommended mechanism gate shared with §11.4.125)

#### §11.4.145 — Independent multi-angle impact-research per change
- **Source:** code-review-and-quality.md:89-103
- **Rules:**
  - For EVERY fix/change/new feature, INDEPENDENT impact-research agents (subagent-driven §11.4.70/§11.4.20, structurally separate from the author; §11.4.92 self-eval precedes, never satisfies; adversarial "refute-the-change" stance against reviewer confirmation bias) MUST research the change AND connected/dependent features across a CLOSED SET OF EIGHT ANGLES: (1) correctness/logic; (2) regression (call-graph impact enumerating every direct+transitive caller and contract-dependent feature, each mapped to its test); (3) latent/dangerous code - the "recents class" (runtime-only failure, interface/ABI/contract mismatch, concurrency/data-race, resource lifecycle); (4) security (taint/injection/secret/unsafe-API); (5) performance (latency/memory/thermal under load vs baseline); (6) host/data/target-hardware safety per §12/§9/§11.4.133; (7) cross-feature interaction (shared state/timing/hardware contention); (8) business-logic conformance (spec AND connected features' contracts, not merely compiles).
  - Each angle MUST name the TOOL(S) used, obtain the required DEPTH (read the diff, the full changed unit, its declared contract, the spec section and every connected feature, never diff lines alone), and emit a captured-evidence conclusion per §11.4.5/§11.4.69 (tool findings/impact/diff artefact path; "looks fine" forbidden, §11.4.1).
  - A genuinely N/A angle is recorded `NOT_APPLICABLE: <reason>` per §11.4.6, never silently skipped.
  - Output: a per-change impact-research REPORT (section per angle: tool + evidence path + verdict) and a single GO/NO-GO that BLOCKS acceptance/commit/build on ANY unmitigated risk in ANY angle; fix/mitigate and re-research affected angles, iterating to CLEAN GO (zero unmitigated risk and zero warning, rock-solid physical evidence) per §11.4.134 before the §11.4.125 review gate.
  - Consumer supplies its toolkit (static analyzer, call-graph engine, interface-freeze mechanism, behavioral harness) and per-angle depth per §11.4.35. Classification universal (§11.4.17).
  - Rationale fact: a recents/3-button-nav AIDL contract mismatch passed code review and failed only at runtime (ANR) because no angle interrogated contract/concurrency/connected feature.
- **Gates:** CM-COVENANT-114-145-PROPAGATION, CM-IMPACT-RESEARCH-PER-CHANGE (every accepted change carries a fresh independent report covering all eight angles with clean GO by agents distinct from author; paired §1.1 mutations: strip literal, accept report missing an angle or with unmitigated NO-GO; gate-code is a separate work item)
- **No escape hatch:** --skip-impact-research, --single-angle-suffices, --author-researches-own-change, --diff-skim-OK, --no-go-overridable, --trivial-change-no-research
- **Honest boundary:** A GO proves cross-angle internal consistency and bounded blast radius; it does NOT replace §11.4.108 four-layer runtime-signature verification or §11.4.40 full-suite retest; it is the FIRST research pass among multiple layers.
- **Composes:** §11.4.92, §11.4.125, §11.4.108, §11.4.110, §11.4.134, §11.4.78, §11.4.79, §11.4.107, §11.4.85, §11.4.133, §12, §9, §11.4.99, §11.4.6, §11.4.5, §11.4.69, §11.4.70, §11.4.20, §11.4.35, §1.1

#### §11.4.165 — Universal Independent Verification Agent Mandate
- **Source:** code-review-and-quality.md:107-129
- **Rules:**
  - Every code change OR recorded media artifact MUST pass an INDEPENDENT verification agent structurally separate from the author (§11.4.70/§11.4.20; dedicated subagent or distinct human, never the author; §11.4.92 self-evaluation precedes, never satisfies). It is the FIRST verification layer, complementing (never replacing) §11.4.108, §11.4.125/§11.4.142 and §11.4.40.
  - (a) CODE changes: the verifier MUST (i) run the §11.4.142 code-review discipline (adversarial analysis, blast radius, contract integrity, test genuineness); (ii) build and test changed packages (project's `pre_build_verification.sh` on the diff scope); (iii) run paired §1.1 meta-test mutations for every touched gate (mutated gate still FAILs, restoration still PASSes); (iv) verify the §11.4.108 runtime-signature registry entry declares one machine-checkable observable. Passing only one of (i)-(iv) is NOT verified.
  - (b) MEDIA artifacts (video/audio/screenshots/asciicast/text): (i) run the §11.4.163 media validation pipeline on every artifact; (ii) confirm content is genuine (real LLM/service responses, not mocked/stub/simulated/placeholder, per §11.4.159(I)); (iii) confirm format (MP4 H.264 video, WAV/FLAC audio, PNG screenshots, cast+mp4 asciicast per §11.4.159(B)); (iv) cross-check evidence path (exists, non-empty, content matches expected output). Correct format with simulated/placeholder content is a finding.
  - (c) DOCS changes: (i) HTML + PDF + DOCX exports exist and are current per §11.4.65 (mtime parity); (ii) §11.4.44 revision header present and integer incremented from previous commit; (iii) for docs with a §11.4.86 fingerprint, it matches the sorted roster/keyset. Stale export or missing header is NOT verified.
  - (d) CONFIG changes: (i) validate YAML/JSON/TOML syntax with the language's own parser (yq, jq, python -m json.tool, etc.); (ii) cross-reference a schema where available (JSON Schema for .settings.json, YAML Schema for helix-deps.yaml); (iii) confirm no credential/secret leak per §11.4.10. Syntax error, schema violation or leak is a finding.
  - (e) The verifier MUST produce a structured findings report; per finding: item, verification class (a-d), tool/command used, evidence path (log, build output, mutation result, validator verdict), PASS/FAIL. "Looks good" without evidence is not a finding; a rubber-stamp verifier is a PASS-bluff at the verification layer.
  - (f) Iterate to GO per §11.4.134: any finding (indeterminate, BLOCKING, or warning) -> author fixes, verifier RE-VERIFIES, until GO with ZERO findings and ZERO warnings; accepting GO because findings were "minor" is a violation.
  - (g) Verifier self-validation: its meta-test is a paired §1.1 mutation introducing a deliberately broken change (e.g. gate with stripped assertion) that the verifier MUST catch; a verifier passing a known-broken change is a bluff gate to be investigated per §11.4.102 before further use.
  - Classification universal (§11.4.17); consumer supplies build+test command per diff scope, mutation runner, media validator invocation, doc export checker, config parser and verifier-dispatch agent per §11.4.35.
- **Gates:** CM-COVENANT-114-165-PROPAGATION, CM-INDEPENDENT-VERIFICATION-AGENT (every output passes an independent verifier with structured findings and evidence paths, iterates to zero-finding GO, verifier self-validated by paired §1.1 mutation; mutations: strip literal, accept output without verifier GO, verifier GO on known-broken fixture; gate-code is a separate work item)
- **No escape hatch:** none named
- **Honest boundary:** The verifier confirms integrity at source/artifact layer only; it does NOT prove the feature works for the end user on the deployed target (that rests on §11.4.108, §11.4.130, §11.4.40) nor replace §11.4.40 or §11.4.118. A verifier GO on an artifact whose downstream deployment is broken is not a verifier failure; a GO without having run any tool IS a violation.
- **Composes:** §11.4.142, §11.4.163, §11.4.44, §11.4.65, §11.4.86, §11.4.108, §11.4.125, §11.4.134, §11.4.10, §11.4.40, §11.4.92, §11.4.70, §11.4.20, §11.4.102, §11.4.159, §11.4.130, §11.4.118, §11.4.6, §11.4.35, §1.1

#### §11.4.194 — Exhaustive all-scenario, all-angle code-review + verify-against-captured-runtime-evidence
- **Source:** code-review-and-quality.md:131-157
- **Rules:**
  - Strengthens §11.4.125/§11.4.134/§11.4.142: before returning GO every code-review MUST do the following (reason: a clean zero-finding GO dismissed a clamp branch as "effectively unreachable" without proof, and a boundary product A x B with two independent zero-triggers had only one factor verified, so the target still crash-looped).
  - (1) Enumerate the FULL input/scenario space of BOTH the change AND the defect: every dimension, code path, interacting feature and input domain, not only the happy path. For a MULTI-FACTOR failure mode (product of N terms, any degenerate term - zero, empty, null, default-initialised, out-of-range - triggers it), enumerate AND INDEPENDENTLY VERIFY the fix covers EACH factor; verifying one and assuming the rest is the forbidden gap.
  - (2) Prove every assumption: "can't happen"/"unreachable"/"always valid"/"caller never sends X"/"always in range" MUST be PROVEN from code + spec + captured evidence, never on faith (§11.4.6). An unproven assumption proven false is a review-layer bluff of PASS-bluff severity. A NIT dismissing a path as unreachable/dead/defensive-only MUST carry proof (callers enumerated, input domain bounded, degenerate value shown impossible); a bare "effectively unreachable" NIT is itself a finding.
  - (3) Verify the fix against ANY captured runtime evidence (crash log, tombstone, stack trace, core dump, sink-probe report, §11.4.108 runtime-signature, reproducer): confirm the fix prevents the CAPTURED failure under the EXACT captured conditions, not a hypothetical. GO on a fix that fails at runtime on a scenario present in the evidence (or one the review chose not to consider) is a bluff.
  - (4) Cover ALL angles: correctness against stated goal; full input domain (every factor, boundary, degenerate value); every downstream/interacting feature, especially must-not-break constraints (§11.4.133 target/hardware safety, features sharing state/timing/resource, e.g. audio/multichannel/passthrough integrity); the tests' OWN coverage of every dimension (a test checking only one factor of a multi-factor bug is a coverage gap to be closed); the §1.1 paired mutation covering EACH dimension (a mutation flipping one factor leaves others unguarded).
  - (5) Exhaustive = enumerated + evidence-grounded, not omniscience; a dimension that cannot be analysed MUST be an explicit gap (`UNCONFIRMED:` / `UNKNOWN:` / `PENDING_FORENSICS:` with tracked follow-up), never silently assumed safe; a silently-assumed-safe un-analysed dimension is the violation.
  - (6) Quality-harvest review classes (extension 2026-07-23): every review MUST also CHECK per change: (a) closure-evidence class vs defect layer (§11.4.226) - no terminal/ready-class status moves on evidence ranking below the defect layer's floor; a user-visible property "verified" by file-existence + greps, an echo-assertion, or a state-only repair closing a defect as fixed is a FINDING; (b) needled measurements - every load-bearing measurement satisfies §11.4.201(6)-(12) (reported absence cites its class-matched control needle) and NO count is converted into a finding without reading the underlying lines (a COUNT IS A LEAD, THE LINES ARE THE FINDING); (c) governance-and-gate integrity (§11.4.227) - a change that NAMES a gate lands its implementation or a registered deferral in the same change, and a governance edit preserves anchor-block integrity (exactly-once per mirror, lockstep-identical, no anchor-number collision); (d) reviewer-authored adversarial mutations - author's self-authored mutation set is NECESSARY but NOT SUFFICIENT (author's six all caught while reviewer's first three different mutations all sailed through); reviewer MUST attempt at least one mutation the author did not write (or record honest infeasibility per §11.4.3); a guard whose reviewer-authored mutation survives is unvalidated instrumentation per §11.4.115(F) and a FINDING.
  - Classification universal (§11.4.17); consumer supplies input registries, must-not-break constraint set and captured-runtime-evidence sources per §11.4.35.
- **Gates:** CM-COVENANT-114-194-PROPAGATION, CM-EXHAUSTIVE-REVIEW-ALL-SCENARIOS (a GO must record the enumerated scenario/factor space, proof of every dismissed-as-unreachable branch, and cross-check against captured runtime evidence where it exists; paired §1.1 mutations: strip enumeration/assumption-proof/evidence cross-check, strip literal; gate-code is a separate work item)
- **No escape hatch:** --partial-scenario-review, --assume-unreachable-OK, --skip-captured-evidence-crosscheck, --single-factor-review-suffices, --dismiss-branch-without-proof
- **Honest boundary:** "Exhaustive" means the enumerated, evidence-grounded scenario space, not omniscience; un-analysable dimensions must be stated as explicit gaps.
- **Composes:** §11.4.125, §11.4.134, §11.4.142, §11.4.6, §11.4.108, §11.4.130, §11.4.107, §11.4.133, §11.4.226, §11.4.201, §11.4.227, §11.4.115, §11.4.3, §1.1, §11.4.35

#### §11.4.209 — Code-review MUST run on Opus at xhigh effort as PRIMARY substrate, with a genuine-unavailability Sonnet fallback; no Fable, no escalation tier (amended 2026-10-04)
- **Source:** Constitution.md (constitution tip a71b1767) lines 10576-10596 (groups/code-review-and-quality.md:159-173 holds the pre-amendment text, see pin-upstream-findings.md)
- **Rules:**
  - Operator mandate 2026-10-04 (CRITICAL), AMENDING clause (A), verbatim in canon: if Opus is not available but Sonnet is, "we MUST USE what we have! Reviews MUST BE done. Ideally with Opus model, however Sonet MUST BE used if Opus for any reason cannot be used!"; nothing is blocked with a review not performed; "We MUST BE maximally efficient!". It does not change the primary substrate. Operator mandate 2026-09-26 (CRITICAL): reviews and other heavy work are done by Opus instead of Fable; it supersedes the 2026-09-15 mandate (Opus-xhigh default with Fable-xhigh escalation) and the 2026-07-15 mandate (Fable first, Opus fallback); both withdrawn, kept as lineage only.
  - Every mandatory independent code-review (§11.4.125 gate before pre-build + main build, §11.4.142 universal every-change review, §11.4.194 exhaustive review, iterated to zero-finding GO per §11.4.134) MUST be dispatched on the Opus model at `xhigh` effort as PRIMARY substrate, whatever the size or complexity of the change.
  - (A) PRIMARY substrate Opus-xhigh plus a genuine-unavailability SONNET FALLBACK (amended 2026-10-04), no escalation tier, no Fable, no other fallback model: Opus at `xhigh` is the PRIMARY and preferred substrate; Fable is NOT permitted in any role (default, escalation, fallback), ever; no model other than Opus or the sanctioned Sonnet fallback, and no lower tier for Opus itself, substitutes. When Opus-xhigh is genuinely unavailable (not configured, rate-limited or unreachable, established as a captured FACT per §11.4.6, never guessed) the review MUST be dispatched on Sonnet (at the highest effort the dispatch path can set) rather than blocked. The Opus-unavailability FACT and the Sonnet substitution MUST both be recorded in the review's captured evidence (§11.4.5/§11.4.69); a Sonnet review is NEVER presented as if it ran on Opus. A review is NEVER left undone solely because Opus is unavailable while Sonnet is reachable (§11.4.183). ONLY when BOTH Opus and Sonnet are genuinely unavailable (each its own captured FACT) is the review BLOCKED and deferred: record the facts, track the owed review (§11.4.197; §11.4.21 once the self-resolution audit is exhausted); the change does NOT pass the review gate unreviewed.
  - (B) Independence preserved (§11.4.70/§11.4.20): the reviewing model (Opus or the sanctioned Sonnet fallback) runs as the structurally-separated reviewer, never the author; §11.4.209 sets MODEL + EFFORT only and does not weaken independence, the iterate-until-GO loop (§11.4.134), or rock-solid captured evidence (§11.4.5/§11.4.69/§11.4.107).
  - (C) A review claimed done on Fable, Haiku or any model other than Opus or the sanctioned Sonnet fallback, or below `xhigh`, or on Sonnet with no recorded Opus-unavailability fact, is a §11.4 bluff at the review-substrate layer; the review's captured evidence MUST record which model + effort actually performed it; where the dispatch path cannot set/report effort (§11.4.231(F.2) harness gap) the evidence records that gap honestly and the review is never claimed `xhigh` on an unverified basis.
  - (D) Values already burned in a public repository (§11.4.10): any plaintext credential value that appeared in documentation, spec, or commit history (including as a worked example) is compromised from the moment of commit; a document illustrating this or any credential-adjacent mandate MUST NOT embed a real-looking username/password pair, even as an example, without stating it is compromised-by-disclosure and MUST NOT be relied on as a secret.
  - Strengthens, does not replace, §11.4.125/§11.4.142/§11.4.194/§11.4.134; pins execution substrate, now a primary-plus-sanctioned-fallback pin. Classification universal (§11.4.17).
- **Gates:** CM-COVENANT-114-209-PROPAGATION, CM-CODE-REVIEW-OPUS-XHIGH (captured evidence records model=Opus + effort=xhigh, or on a path that cannot set effort that §11.4.231(F.2) gap honestly recorded, OR model=Sonnet carrying a captured Opus-unavailability FACT under the same effort-or-honest-gap rule; a review on Fable/Haiku/any other model, recorded xhigh when the path could not set it, or on Sonnet with no recorded Opus-unavailability fact FAILs; a review recorded BLOCKED with a captured fact that BOTH Opus and Sonnet were unavailable is honest and MUST NOT fire the gate, the §11.4.201(1) false-positive guard; paired §1.1 mutations: non-Opus/non-Sonnet review, xhigh claimed where unsettable, Sonnet with no recorded fact, strip literal; gate-code is a separate work item)
- **No escape hatch:** beyond the sanctioned (A) Sonnet fallback (which itself requires a captured Opus-unavailability FACT): --review-any-model, --review-lower-effort-OK, --skip-opus, --non-xhigh-review, --escalate-to-fable-or-haiku, --sonnet-fallback-without-recorded-fact, --leave-review-blocked-while-sonnet-reachable
- **Honest boundary:** Pins review model + effort only; independence, iterate-until-GO and evidence requirements remain as in their own anchors; where effort cannot be set/reported that gap is recorded, never claimed as xhigh.
- **Project note (Catalogizer, recorded 2026-10-06 in WP-07, corrected by the WF8 fix pass):** canon REQUIRES the (A) Sonnet fallback (MUST be dispatched on Sonnet rather than blocked) and names `--leave-review-blocked-while-sonnet-reachable` a forbidden escape hatch. The project's earlier text ("blocked, never substituted") digested the pre-amendment canon; it was never an owner mandate (ODG-19 reads "Opus xhigh as pinned (§11.4.209)"). OPEN canon conflict, owner question OD-WP07-SONNET-FALLBACK (decisions/owner-request-list.md, default: follow canon); interim practice, an agent's interim choice and not an owner decision: follow canon (Opus `xhigh` first, Sonnet fallback only on a captured Opus-unavailability fact, recorded with model and effort).
- **Composes:** §11.4.125, §11.4.134, §11.4.142, §11.4.194, §11.4.6, §11.4.10, §11.4.20, §11.4.21, §11.4.70, §11.4.183, §11.4.196, §11.4.197, §11.4.231, §11.4.201

#### §11.4.240 — Producer != Verifier scope separation: least privilege over cleverness
- **Source:** code-review-and-quality.md:175-193
- **Rules:**
  - Every project MUST enforce STRUCTURAL SEPARATION between the actor that PRODUCES a change/artifact/verdict and the actor that GATES it: the producer cannot write, weaken, delete or edit the acceptance tests, oracle, gate configuration, verdict store, paired §1.1 mutation, or any check whose green result is a precondition for certifying the producer's own work done. Enforcement is by CAPABILITY (producer structurally cannot reach the gate), NOT by INSTRUCTION; mechanism is least privilege over cleverness (reason: a producer that can edit tests/oracle/gate config/verdict store will, under optimization pressure, hardcode expected values, weaken assertions, mock the unit under test, delete the failing test, or write "verified: true" on itself).
  - (A) Four SCOPES MUST be distinct actors: (i) PRODUCER (source diff, config change, migration, artifact-generation code); (ii) ORACLE (decides correct output: test author, spec writer, characterization-baseline capturer, reference-implementation author per §11.4.245); (iii) GATE (decides PASS: CI config, gate scripts, custody-chain enforcer §11.4.146(D3), release-verdict-coverage machinery §11.4.135); (iv) VERIFIER (re-runs the gate from a clean checkout and attaches receipts: independent verifier §11.4.165, §11.4.209 Opus-xhigh for code review, §11.4.194 exhaustive review). The producer cannot also be oracle, gate or verifier of the same change. A four-scope collapse is maximum severity; any two-scope collapse involving the producer is a finding of §11.4/§11.4.1 severity at the certification layer.
  - (B) Separation MUST be enforced by structural capability limits, not prompts/policy documents/social contracts; "the agent will not do that" is never acceptable enforcement. Consumer MUST supply per §11.4.35: (1) FILESYSTEM SCOPE - producer's write scope excludes `tests/`, `oracle/`, `.github/workflows/`, `scripts/gates/`, `verdicts/` (or consumer equivalents); (2) BRANCH/REVIEW PROTECTION - protected paths (§11.4.248 PROTECTED-SPEC + CODEOWNERS) require a non-author approver; (3) VERDICT-STORE ISOLATION - RED/GREEN verdicts per §11.4.115(F) written only by the harness that ran the test, never the producer's code path; (4) EXECUTION ISOLATION - verifier runs in a CLEAN CHECKOUT with FRESH CONTEXT, not inheriting the producer's dirty worktree, cached artifacts or in-flight session state.
  - (C) Three forbidden collapses: (1) PRODUCER=ORACLE (same actor writes the diff and the test asserting it; tautological testing) - countermeasure: oracle authored from the specification, from a characterization baseline captured BEFORE the change (§11.4.243), or a reference implementation (§11.4.245 derived oracle); (2) PRODUCER=GATE (producer has write access to gate config/CI/mutation thresholds/paired §1.1 mutations) - countermeasure: gate config in a §11.4.248-protected path, changes need non-producer approver; (3) PRODUCER=VERIFIER / self-certification (same actor produces the change and writes "verified: true"/"PASS") - countermeasure: verdicts MACHINE-WRITTEN by the harness per §11.4.115(F), keyed to the target artifact fingerprint read at run time, and the §11.4.135 release-verdict-coverage seam REFUSES a release tag while any producer-asserted (not harness-written) verdict is in scope.
  - (D) Composition (no new mechanism, articulates the property): §11.4.115(F) machine-written verdicts; §11.4.125 review gate = VERIFIER at review layer; §11.4.142 + §11.4.209 independence and substrate; §11.4.135 GATE at release seam; §11.4.146(D3) status custody refuses producer-asserted terminal-status writes; §11.4.165 verifier generalised; §11.4.194 depth. It forbids the collapses (C) that would make those mechanisms decoration.
  - (F) Independence-tier vocabulary + Tier-C triggers (extension 2026-08-26): (1) every accepted verdict's recorded independence basis MUST name its tier from the CLOSED SET {instance, model, capability} (instance = separate agent/process instance sharing no in-flight state with the producer; model = a different model; capability = genuine host-level access-control boundary separating producer write scope from verifier's). (2) Model diversity is PERMITTED, NEVER REQUIRED: a verdict from an independent instance running the SAME model as the producer MUST be ACCEPTED on that basis alone; refusing same-model independent verdicts is a §11.4.201 false-positive refusal; this does not weaken §11.4.256 (translation review on a different model/provider than translator) or §11.4.209 (code review on Opus at xhigh as PRIMARY substrate, with a genuine-unavailability Sonnet fallback, amended 2026-10-04; Fable and Haiku remain forbidden in every role), which remain in force for their own domains. (3) Tier-C trigger 1: where the producer holds write access to the evidence/verdict store, a verdict MUST be written through the MOST RESTRICTIVE separation genuinely available on the host and the ACHIEVED (not aspired) separation reported. (4) Tier-C trigger 2: at the `release-tag`, `qa-deploy` or `manual-qa-handoff` seams (or consumer-declared equivalents per §11.4.35) a producer-authored verdict is REFUSED regardless of write-access analysis and achieved separation reported. (5) At a seam matching NEITHER trigger a separate agent INSTANCE MUST SUFFICE and capability separation MUST NOT be demanded (over-applying Tier-C everywhere is itself a violation of the false-positive-refusal class).
  - Classification universal (§11.4.17).
- **Gates:** CM-COVENANT-114-240-PROPAGATION, CM-PRODUCER-NOT-VERIFIER-SCOPE-SPLIT, CM-LEAST-PRIVILEGE-CAPABILITY-NOT-INSTRUCTION, CM-INDEPENDENCE-TIER-HONESTLY-RECORDED (field present, within closed set, never `capability` at a Tier-C seam without a mechanically verified host boundary, same-model independent verdict accepted at ordinary seams; mutations: record capability with no verified boundary, refuse same-model verdict at ordinary seam, accept producer-authored verdict at release-tag/qa-deploy/manual-qa-handoff; golden-FALSE: honest instance-tier verdict at a Tier-C seam with no host boundary MUST NOT fire; plus mutations for producer editing tests/* without non-producer approver, producer-set "verified: true" with no harness verdict pair, producer write access to gate config, strip literal; gate-code is a separate work item)
- **No escape hatch:** --producer-may-write-tests, --self-certification-OK, --exhortation-suffices-as-enforcement, --producer-authored-verdict-accepted, --capability-limit-optional, --policy-document-is-enforcement, --single-actor-for-all-scopes
- **Honest boundary:** Separation forbids the CLASS of self-certification; it does NOT prove the verifier is correct (§11.4.107(10) golden fixtures), does NOT prove the oracle correct (§11.4.245), and does not prevent other gaming vectors (hardcoding to visible inputs, over-fitting) which §11.4.245 held-out/property/metamorphic/differential coverage counters. On a single-uid host capability separation cannot be established by any mechanism an agent can set up (ownership defeats ACLs, append-only attribute needs privilege the agent lacks, any key the producer can use it can read), so such a host reports `instance` honestly, NEVER `capability`, until the operator establishes a host boundary (a host-safety-adjacent operator action, never autonomous); the field records what was ACHIEVED.
- **Composes:** §11.4.6, §11.4.20, §11.4.70, §11.4.92, §11.4.107, §11.4.115, §11.4.125, §11.4.134, §11.4.135, §11.4.142, §11.4.146, §11.4.165, §11.4.194, §11.4.201, §11.4.205, §11.4.209, §11.4.243, §11.4.245, §11.4.248, §11.4.249, §11.4.256, §11.4.227, §11.4.35, §12

#### §11.4.241 — Illegal-state-unrepresentability preference ladder
- **Source:** code-review-and-quality.md:197-201
- **Rules:**
  - Every load-bearing invariant MUST be enforced at the STRONGEST rung the language/toolchain supports on the closed ordered ladder: (1) TYPE SYSTEM -> (2) API SHAPE -> (3) LINT -> (4) PROPERTY-BASED TEST -> (5) RUNTIME ASSERTION. A defect preventable at rung N but caught only at rung > N is a finding.
  - Rung-by-language capability baseline: strongly-typed languages rungs 1-5; dynamically-typed with gradual typing rung 1 conditional; untyped scripting rungs 3-5 unconditional.
  - Genuinely limited environment (e.g. POSIX sh with only rung 5) SATISFIES the anchor IFF the runtime assertion genuinely catches the invariant AND is paired with its §1.1 meta-test mutation per §11.4.107(10) self-validation.
  - Full canonical text is in the `curriculum_anchors_241_254_full_drafts.md` §11.4.241 block (Part A). Classification universal (§11.4.17).
- **Gates:** CM-COVENANT-114-241-PROPAGATION, CM-ILLEGAL-STATE-LADDER-PREFERENCE (plus paired §1.1 mutation; gate-code is a separate work item, not claimed shipped)
- **No escape hatch:** --runtime-assert-suffices, --skip-type-preference, --dynamic-language-exempts-all-rungs, --property-test-in-lieu-of-type, --decorative-type-annotation-OK
- **Honest boundary:** Gate code not claimed shipped; limited-environment clarification above.
- **Composes:** §11.4.108, §11.4.115, §11.4.142, §11.4.194, §11.4.201, §11.4.224, §1.1, §11.4.6, §11.4.35, §11.4.107, §11.4.209

#### §11.4.251 — Byte-identical-fork prohibition + role-as-data-pack
- **Source:** code-review-and-quality.md:205-209
- **Rules:**
  - When project needs would be met by TWO NEAR-IDENTICAL CODE COPIES differing only in configuration/data/role-specific parameters (e.g. prod+staging with hardcoded hostnames; reader+writer with different flag values; web+mobile with different feature flags), copies MUST NOT be maintained as parallel forks.
