  - (A) Per-OS implementation REQUIRED: every feature whose Linux implementation uses a cgroup/systemd//proc primitive MUST have a documented per-OS equivalent (POSIX `setrlimit`/`ulimit`, macOS launchd plist `HardResourceLimits`, BSD `rctl`, Windows Job Object) chosen by runtime detection with NO operator awareness required (same invocation works everywhere; e.g. `tmx new -s NAME` dispatches to `systemd-run --user --scope` on Linux and `scripts/tmx-rlimit-wrapper.sh` on Darwin).
  - (B) Per-OS tests REQUIRED: every gate test of platform-dependent behaviour MUST have a per-OS branch under `case "$(uname -s)" in`, each exercising the platform's native primitive with positive captured evidence per §11.4.2 + §11.4.5 (e.g. `ulimit -t` read in-session via send-keys + capture-pane on Darwin; `/sys/fs/cgroup/.../memory.max` on Linux). Platform-conditional SKIP-with-reason is acceptable ONLY when the platform genuinely cannot enforce the invariant (kernel limit), AND the SKIP message MUST cite the precise limitation with a reproducer + a link to the project's honest-gap section in its operator guide.
  - (C) Honest kernel-gap citation + adjacent equivalent test REQUIRED where a Linux primitive has NO equivalent (e.g. XNU does not enforce RLIMIT_AS/RLIMIT_DATA/RLIMIT_RSS for unprivileged processes): the test MUST (1) detect the gap at runtime, (2) SKIP with the exact kernel reason + reproducer + link to the honest-gap doc, (3) provide an ADJACENT test exercising the closest invariant the platform CAN enforce (e.g. RLIMIT_CPU + SIGXCPU as the macOS proxy); the adjacent test MUST itself be anti-bluff with positive captured evidence and a paired §1.1 mutation.
  - Operational discipline: when a new feature's Linux path lands first, the SAME pull request MUST add per-OS branches for every other platform in the manifest (or classify per (C)); "for later" is a violation.
  - Equivalence catalogue (canonical, non-exhaustive): `systemd-run --user --scope` -> Darwin rlimit wrapper using `ulimit -t`/`ulimit -u`, BSD `rctl process:0:deny:vmemoryuse` (root)/`ulimit -v`, Windows Job Object via `CreateJobObjectW`+`SetInformationJobObject`; cgroup `MemoryMax` -> Darwin XNU GAP (unprivileged RLIMIT_AS returns EINVAL; root-only via launchd HardResourceLimits; adjacent RLIMIT_CPU+SIGXCPU), BSD `rctl process:0:deny:memoryuse`, Windows `JOB_OBJECT_LIMIT_PROCESS_MEMORY`; cgroup `TasksMax` -> `RLIMIT_NPROC` via `ulimit -u`, BSD `rctl user:NN:deny:maxproc`, Windows `JOB_OBJECT_LIMIT_ACTIVE_PROCESS`; `/proc/<pid>/oom_score_adj` -> no equivalent on Darwin/BSD (SKIP-with-reason; adjacent: rlimit bounds rogue reach), none at Windows OS level; `/sys/fs/cgroup/...` introspection -> `ulimit -a` readback + `ps` ancestry, BSD `procstat -r <pid>`, Windows `QueryInformationJobObject`; `kill -KILL` on cgroup process -> `kill -KILL` on tmux server pid directly with sibling-survival check via socket query, Windows `TerminateProcess` + per-job survival check.
  - Pre-build gate `CM-CROSS-PLATFORM-PARITY` (when implemented in the consuming project): scans every gate test for `case "$(uname -s)"` blocks and asserts a non-SKIP branch (or honest-gap citation per C) per supported platform; paired §1.1 mutation strips the Darwin branch -> FAILs.
  - Classification universal; single-platform projects unaffected. Non-compliance is a release blocker on multi-platform projects.
- **Gates:** CM-CROSS-PLATFORM-PARITY
- **No escape hatch:** --linux-only-acceptable, --no-platform-parity-required, --platform-gap-just-skip
- **Honest boundary:** Single-platform projects are unaffected; where the OS genuinely cannot enforce an invariant, honest SKIP plus adjacent test is the compliant path. "Platform X probably can't do Y" without reproducer is a §11.4.6 violation (mark UNCONFIRMED).
- **Composes:** §11.4.1, §11.4.2, §11.4.3, §11.4.4, §11.4.5, §11.4.6, §11.4.17, §11.4.20, §11.4.27, §11.4.69, §11.4.70, §1.1, §107

#### §11.4.85 — Stress + Chaos Test Mandate (User mandate, 2026-05-24)
- **Source:** testing-and-tdd.md:1097-1150
- **Rules:**
  - Short tag `stress-chaos-mandate`. Every fix or improvement MUST ship with full-automation STRESS AND CHAOS test suites exercising edge cases, sustained load, concurrent contention and failure injection; a fix with only a happy-path PASS is a PASS-bluff at the resilience layer.
  - Stress test definition (at MINIMUM one of): Sustained load (N >= 100 sequential iterations OR >= 30 s wall-clock continuous load; per-iteration latency recorded; p50/p95/p99 reported); Concurrent contention (N >= 10 parallel invocations, all MUST complete, no deadlock, no resource leak in fd count / process-table count / RSS, no data race); Boundary conditions (empty min input, provider/codec/protocol-limit max input, off-by-one at every size threshold; each yields a categorised result: success, categorised-error or deterministic-skip, NEVER an uncaught exception or silent corruption).
  - Chaos test definition per §11.4.69 closed-set taxonomy (at MINIMUM one category appropriate to fix class): Process-death injection (kill primary/dependency/upstream mid-operation; recovery deterministic and categorised: clean error, automatic restart, circuit-breaker open); Network-fault injection (drop/delay/reorder packets mid-call; categorised error e.g. `category=network`/`category=upstream`); Input-corruption injection (corrupt input file/config/.env mid-test; MUST detect and report, NEVER silently consume); Resource-exhaustion injection (disk 99%, OOM-injection memory pressure, fd exhaustion, socket exhaustion; fix MUST refuse new work cleanly or degrade gracefully, NEVER crash with uncaught error); State-corruption injection (mid-flight DB lock loss, partial-write FS error, cache invalidation; recovery MUST restore consistent state).
  - Anti-bluff 1: every stress/chaos PASS MUST cite a captured-evidence artefact path per §11.4.5 + §11.4.69 (per-iteration `latency.json` / `throughput.csv` / `categorised_errors.txt` / `state_delta_snapshot.json` / `process_lifecycle.log` / `recovery_trace.log`); metadata-only PASS ("all iterations exited 0") is itself a PASS-bluff.
  - Anti-bluff 2: helper library: projects SHOULD ship `stress_chaos.sh` (or language-binding equivalent) exposing `ab_stress_run`, `ab_stress_concurrent`, `ab_chaos_kill_pid_during`, `ab_chaos_drop_network_during`, `ab_chaos_corrupt_file_during`, `ab_chaos_oom_pressure_during`, `ab_chaos_disk_full_during`, each composing with `ab_pass_with_evidence` / `ab_skip_with_reason` per §11.4.69.
  - Anti-bluff 3: chaos-injection cleanup is non-negotiable: a test corrupting a `.env` MUST restore it in `trap '...' EXIT`; a disk-filler MUST be `rm`'d in EXIT; a killed process MUST be verified restarted (or deliberately left down with operator-visible reason); cleanup failure is a §11.4.14 violation.
  - 4-layer coverage per §11.4.4(b): pre-build gate (stress+chaos files exist, executable, parse under `sh -n` + `bash -n` per §11.4.67; helper exists; fix's pre-build gate cites the stress+chaos test path); paired meta-test mutation per §1.1 (remove the chaos-injection step or per-iteration evidence capture -> gate FAILs); on-device test if LIVE_ADB_TESTABLE per §11.4.51 with evidence under `qa-results/<run-id>/stress_chaos/`; HelixQA Challenge entry if the fix is a user-visible feature.
  - The stress test's N iterations MUST produce identical exit codes AND identical evidence-hashes (volatile prefixes stripped) per §11.4.50; stress/chaos MUST run end-to-end without operator presence (§11.4.52); a stress test crashing under `set -u` due to unset variable is a FAIL-bluff (§11.4.1).
  - Classification universal; non-compliance is a release blocker.
- **Gates:** none named
- **No escape hatch:** --skip-stress, --no-chaos, --happy-path-suffices, --stress-test-later
- **Honest boundary:** none stated
- **Composes:** §11.4, §11.4.1, §11.4.4, §11.4.5, §11.4.6, §11.4.14, §11.4.17, §11.4.43, §11.4.50, §11.4.51, §11.4.52, §11.4.67, §11.4.69, §11.4.83, §107, §1.1

#### §11.4.98 — Full-Automation Anti-Bluff Mandate: live tests MUST be re-runnable end-to-end without manual intervention (User mandate, 2026-05-28)
- **Source:** testing-and-tdd.md:1154-1183
- **Rules:**
  - Closes the manual-intervention gap: a live/integration/e2e/Challenge test requiring any human action during execution (typing a chat message, clicking a UI, hand-triggering a webhook, manually attaching a file) is by definition a PASS-bluff at the automation layer.
  - (A) Every governed test (unit / integration / e2e / Challenge / stress / chaos / live) MUST be fully self-driving end-to-end: inputs from configuration alone, exercises the load-bearing path autonomously, reports PASS/FAIL/SKIP-with-reason with no further human action.
  - (B) Single exception: one-time credential bootstrap performed OUTSIDE test execution (populating `.env` from a vault, exporting shell env vars, OAuth approval at first install, MTProto session activation at first run); once credentials exist the test MUST run end-to-end unattended. The bootstrap is a §11.4.10 concern, not §11.4.98.
  - (C)1 No "operator MUST type a message" prompts; inbound messages MUST be driven programmatically (separate user account via MTProto for Telegram, real-user-token API for Slack, IMAP-test-account for email, webhook fixture, or in-process loopback).
  - (C)2 No hard-coded session UUIDs colliding with the active dev session; test runs MUST use a dedicated test-only session (`claude --resume <UUID>` against the dev session's own ID returns exit -1 with no output).
  - (C)3 No 60-second human-response windows (they are §11.4.50 determinism violations).
  - (C)4 Re-runnability proof: every live test MUST PASS at least 3 consecutive automated invocations (`-count=3` for Go, `repeat 3` equivalent elsewhere) with no state cleanup between runs; persistent side effects (chats, files, DB rows, attached objects, queued events) MUST be cleaned by the test itself in `defer`/teardown.
  - (C)5 Obsolescence audit: every existing test MUST be classified "self-driving" (COMPLIANT) or "manual-dependency" (NON-COMPLIANT: rewrite or mark §11.4.90 Obsolete); a release shipping a NON-COMPLIANT test still pretending to PASS is blocked.
  - (C)6 No false-positive PASS: a "live" test skipping silently on missing env vars yet reporting PASS, or using captured evidence from a prior cached run, is a PASS-bluff; SKIP-with-reason is the correct posture (§11.4.3); SKIP-reported-as-PASS or stale-evidence-reported-as-fresh is forbidden.
  - (D) Composition: §11.4.85 + §11.4.89 + §11.4.87 + §11.4.94 + §11.4.98 together make the testing surface continuously validated, fully automated, non-flake, anti-bluff.
  - (E) Inheritance per §11.4.35: each consumer's CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md / QWEN.md MUST carry a short-form restatement citing literal `11.4.98`; propagation gate enforces it with paired §1.1 mutations stripping the literal.
  - (F) Enforcement: a commit adding/modifying a test requiring manual human action is blocked at release-gate; a manual-dependency test not rewritten within 30 days of classification graduates to §11.4.90 Obsolete and is removed from the active suite (preserved with `Obsolete-Details:` per §11.4.90 citing §11.4.98).
  - Non-compliance is a release blocker.
- **Gates:** CM-COVENANT-114-98-PROPAGATION (when implemented)
- **No escape hatch:** --manual-test-OK, --skip-114-98-audit, --bluff-tolerance-temporary
- **Honest boundary:** none stated
- **Composes:** §11.4, §11.4.2, §11.4.3, §11.4.5, §11.4.10, §11.4.35, §11.4.50, §11.4.85, §11.4.87, §11.4.89, §11.4.90, §11.4.94

#### §11.4.114 — Last-known-good-tag regression isolation mandate (1.1.8-dev remediation, 2026-06-03)
- **Source:** testing-and-tdd.md:1187-1207
- **Rules:**
  - Short tag `last-known-good-tag-isolation`. When a previously-working feature is observed broken, the FIRST diagnostic action MUST be to identify the last release tag (or commit/build/deployment) at which it was KNOWN-GOOD and diff/bisect the broken state against it, BEFORE any open-ended root-cause investigation or speculative fix.
  - The known-good revision is the regression oracle: (1) it bounds the search to commits between known-good and now (`git diff <good-tag>..HEAD --stat` of the feature's files is the captured evidence); (2) it tells you the fix is a regression REPAIR not a from-scratch design; (3) each suspect file is compared to its known-good version as behavioural oracle.
  - An operator-volunteered known-good tag is load-bearing and MUST be acted on first. Where the bisect surface is large, `git bisect` against the feature's autonomous RED test (§11.4.115) mechanises the search.
  - Forward-fix vs wholesale-revert: default is a SURGICAL forward-fix (keep the post-good-tag batch's other features, revert ONLY the broken sub-part) unless the operator prefers wholesale revert (a last resort losing working features). Every forward-fix MUST prove via the §11.4.115 RED->GREEN test that the feature now matches known-good behaviour.
  - Propagation gate `CM-COVENANT-114-114-PROPAGATION` enforces the literal across the consumer fleet; paired §1.1 mutation strips it -> FAILs. Recommended gate `CM-REGRESSION-ISOLATED-AGAINST-KNOWN-GOOD` (every regression-classified tracker entry cites the last-known-good tag + diff range); paired mutation strips the citation -> FAILs. Gate-code is a separate work item.
  - Classification universal; consumer supplies tag-naming convention and per-feature known-good oracle per §11.4.35. Non-compliance is a release blocker.
- **Gates:** CM-COVENANT-114-114-PROPAGATION, CM-REGRESSION-ISOLATED-AGAINST-KNOWN-GOOD
- **No escape hatch:** --skip-known-good-diff, --root-cause-from-scratch, --assume-regression-source, --wholesale-revert-without-isolation
- **Honest boundary:** "It worked before" is a HYPOTHESIS until the known-good tag is identified AND the feature confirmed working there (re-run its test against the known-good build or cite captured evidence from when the tag shipped). A feature that NEVER worked is not a regression and this oracle does not apply; "probably regressed in the last batch" without the diff is a §11.4.6 guess.
- **Composes:** §11.4.4, §11.4.6, §11.4.7, §11.4.17, §11.4.35, §11.4.40, §11.4.43, §11.4.102, §11.4.108, §11.4.115

#### §11.4.115 — RED-baseline-on-the-broken-artifact + polarity-switch mandate (1.1.8-dev remediation, 2026-06-03)
- **Source:** testing-and-tdd.md:1211-1237
- **Rules:**
  - Short tag `red-baseline-polarity-switch`. Every §11.4.43 RED test MUST be authored to reproduce the defect on the CURRENT pre-fix artifact (the actual broken build/deployment), capturing positive evidence per §11.4.5/§11.4.69/§11.4.107 that the defect is genuinely present, never a synthetic/hypothetical failure the fix is written to agree with.
  - The SAME test source MUST carry a single polarity switch (env flag/parameter, canonical `RED_MODE`, default `1` = reproduce-and-assert-defect-present) which, set to `0` post-fix, converts it into the GREEN regression-guard asserting the defect is ABSENT.
  - Both runs MUST be captured as evidence: RED against the broken artifact and GREEN against the fixed artifact (per §11.4.108 on a clean target). A separate happy-path test that never failed on the broken artifact is forbidden as the primary guard.
  - (F) Machine-written verdict pairs + guard-viability (2026-07-17), ALL hold: (1) RED and GREEN are machine-written verdict artifacts, never prose: the guard HARNESS (not a human, §11.4.205(4)) writes a per-run verdict file carrying at minimum item id, guard identity, polarity, exit code, the target's artifact/build fingerprint READ FROM THE TARGET AT RUN TIME, iteration count, evidence-file list (path + hash + feature-class); a hand-authored verdict is detectable because fingerprint/target identity must re-verify against cited artifacts. (2) The pair must cross-validate: GREEN acceptable only with a prior RED whose exit != 0 on the PRE-fix artifact; GREEN's fingerprint != RED's fingerprint (identical proves fix never deployed); GREEN runs on a clean target per §11.4.108/§11.4.139 with iterations >= 3 per §11.4.50. (3) Guard viability: a guard never observed FAILing on the genuinely-broken artifact is unvalidated instrumentation and mints no verdicts; its RED run on the real defect IS its §1.1 mutation evidence; a guard structurally unable to FAIL or to PASS (e.g. pass-floor above input population size) satisfies nothing. (4) Mutation = revert + anti-tautology: the canonical §1.1 mutation for a landed fix is the fix-commit's revert (restoring ALL enable-paths of the defect per §11.4.194); a mutation whose diff only deletes/renames the literal strings the gate greps for is a refused tautology. (5) Oracle-class: verdict evidence files MUST match the defect's feature-class evidence shape (pixel-class defect needs pixel/capture artifacts; audio needs sink-side/captured-audio; runtime needs runtime observables per §11.4.69); a source-grep transcript can never satisfy a user-visible class.
  - (G) Defect-identity binding for CONSTRUCTED reproductions (2026-07-23), ALL hold: (1) a RED test's PRECONDITION MUST be TRACEABLE to the reported defect's real evidence (reporter's reproduction sequence §11.4.199, a captured failure log/trace, or a probe showing the precondition occurs in the reported environment), recorded WITH the RED verdict as a precondition-provenance field `observed` vs `constructed` (plus clause-(F) fields). (2) When NO working reproduction exists and the precondition is CONSTRUCTED, the fix mints AT MOST "defensive hardening", labelled as such in commit AND tracker, and NEVER closes the reported defect's item; it stays OPEN (§11.4.197) until a RED with `observed` precondition lands, or the item is closed with §11.4.7-grade non-reproduction evidence or a §11.4.90/§11.4.112 evidence-backed reason. (3) When systematic debugging REFUTES every mechanism a pending fix addresses, its done-claim for the reported defect is REVOKED on the spot (the change may land re-labelled as hardening after §11.4.142/§11.4.194 review); claiming it fixes the reported defect after refutation is a bluff at the investigation layer. Strengthens (A)'s "never synthetic" from artifact-synthetic to MECHANISM-synthetic.
  - (H) Evidence-record full field set + stream-digest-before-truncation + recorder reconciliation (2026-08-26): (1) every command-execution evidence entry MUST carry START TIMESTAMP, WORKING DIRECTORY, ARGUMENT LIST as a genuine list (never a shell-joined string), EXIT STATUS and DURATION (wall-clock); an entry missing or with unparseable value for any of the five is REFUSED at the write seam. (2) When a captured stdout/stderr stream is truncated/redacted for storage, the entry MUST record a content digest computed over the FULL stream BEFORE truncation, the full stream's byte count, and a reference to where the full stream is retained OUTSIDE version control (§11.4.11); truncation/redaction are recorded facts (a flag + truncation point), never silent. (3) Any evidence-bearing claim citing a specific command's output MUST have a MATCHING recorder entry for the EXACT command cited; a citation with none is REFUSED at the same status-write seam §11.4.146(D3) enforces, AUTOMATICALLY, never as a manual audit.
  - Propagation gate `CM-COVENANT-114-115-PROPAGATION`; recommended gate `CM-RED-POLARITY-SWITCH-PRESENT` (every regression-fix RED test carries a single polarity switch + a captured RED-on-broken-artifact run before the fix; paired mutation removes the switch -> FAILs). Gate-code is a separate work item.
  - Recommended `CM-GUARD-VERDICT-MACHINE-WRITTEN` (verdict pairs harness-written, fingerprint-cross-validated, class-matched; forged verdict or string-deletion mutation -> FAILs); `CM-RED-PRECONDITION-DEFECT-TRACEABLE` (every defect-closing claim's RED carries provenance `observed` + evidence path; `constructed` on a defect-closing claim FAILs, same provenance on an honestly-labelled hardening item PASSES as the §11.4.201(1) false-positive guard; paired mutation flips a constructed item from hardening to defect-closing -> FAILs); `CM-EVIDENCE-RECORD-FIELD-SET-COMPLETE`, `CM-EVIDENCE-STREAM-DIGEST-PRE-TRUNCATION`, `CM-EVIDENCE-RECORDER-RECONCILED` with paired mutations (argv stored as joined string -> field-set gate FAILs; digest after truncation -> digest gate FAILs; cite command with no recorder entry -> reconciliation gate FAILs; golden-FALSE fully-fielded entry fires none). Gate-code separate work item.
  - Classification universal; strict refinement of §11.4.43 RED. Non-compliance is a release blocker.
- **Gates:** CM-COVENANT-114-115-PROPAGATION, CM-RED-POLARITY-SWITCH-PRESENT, CM-GUARD-VERDICT-MACHINE-WRITTEN, CM-RED-PRECONDITION-DEFECT-TRACEABLE, CM-EVIDENCE-RECORD-FIELD-SET-COMPLETE, CM-EVIDENCE-STREAM-DIGEST-PRE-TRUNCATION, CM-EVIDENCE-RECORDER-RECONCILED
- **No escape hatch:** --green-only-test, --skip-red-reproduction, --separate-happy-path-suffices, --synthetic-red-OK
- **Honest boundary:** If the defect cannot be reproduced on the current artifact that is a finding, not a license for a GREEN-only test: either the defect is absent (close per §11.4.7 with negative evidence) or the test does not exercise the real condition (fix the test); a RED that "passes" on the known-broken artifact is blind. Clause (H) specifies schema and disciplines only; clause (F) cross-validation rules remain unmodified; gate-code NOT claimed shipped.
- **Composes:** §11.4.1, §11.4.2, §11.4.4, §11.4.5, §11.4.6, §11.4.7, §11.4.11, §11.4.43, §11.4.50, §11.4.69, §11.4.90, §11.4.102, §11.4.107, §11.4.108, §11.4.112, §11.4.114, §11.4.135, §11.4.139, §11.4.142, §11.4.146, §11.4.194, §11.4.197, §11.4.199, §11.4.201, §11.4.205, §11.4.227

#### §11.4.116 — Real-time conductor<->autonomous-test-framework sync channel mandate (1.1.8-dev remediation, 2026-06-03)
- **Source:** testing-and-tdd.md:1241-1261
- **Rules:**
  - Short tag `conductor-test-sync-channel`. Any autonomous long-running test/QA/validation framework an external orchestrator (conductor agent or operator) depends on for real-time decisions MUST expose a real-time sync channel in two parts.
  - Part 1: a structured append-only event stream (JSONL or equivalent, one event per line, never rewritten, e.g. `conduit.events.jsonl`) emitting at minimum session-start, phase-transition, per-test-or-challenge-start, captured-evidence-path, external-call (LLM/vision/sink-probe), error, and per-item-verdict events.
  - Part 2: an atomically-rewritten status snapshot (single small JSON file, e.g. `conduit.status.json`, written via write-temp-then-rename so a reader never sees a torn write) carrying current session/phase/item, running counters and last verdict.
  - Verdicts MUST use the closed vocabulary PASS / FAIL / SKIP / OPERATOR-BLOCKED (§11.4.45). The conductor tails the stream/snapshot live (`tail -f` or monitor) so it stays in sync, can §11.4.4-interrupt on a fresh defect, and never idles blindly (§11.4.94/§11.4.97). The channel is the framework's contract with the orchestrator, not an afterthought log.
  - Anti-bluff for the channel: a verdict event MUST carry the evidence path backing it (per §11.4.69 `ab_pass_with_evidence`); a PASS event with no evidence path is a PASS-bluff at the channel layer; a status snapshot reporting PASS while the event stream shows no captured-evidence event for that item is a contradiction the conductor MUST treat as FAIL; the channel never invents progress (an item with no start-event cannot have a verdict-event).
  - Decoupling (§11.4.28): when the framework is an owned project-agnostic submodule the channel MUST stay project-neutral; the consuming project registers its own data (endpoints, app/package ids, sink hosts) at runtime via the framework's public API, never hardcoded; format generic, payloads consumer-supplied.
  - Propagation gate `CM-COVENANT-114-116-PROPAGATION`; recommended gate `CM-AUTONOMOUS-FRAMEWORK-SYNC-CHANNEL` (append-only event stream + atomically-rewritten snapshot, every verdict event carries an evidence path; paired mutation strips the evidence-path field -> FAILs). Gate-code is a separate work item.
  - Classification universal; consumer supplies channel paths and payload schema per §11.4.35. Non-compliance is a release blocker.
- **Gates:** CM-COVENANT-114-116-PROPAGATION, CM-AUTONOMOUS-FRAMEWORK-SYNC-CHANNEL
- **No escape hatch:** --no-sync-channel, --end-of-session-report-suffices, --verdict-without-evidence-path, --torn-status-write-OK
- **Honest boundary:** none stated
- **Composes:** §11.4.4, §11.4.5, §11.4.17, §11.4.27, §11.4.28, §11.4.35, §11.4.45, §11.4.52, §11.4.69, §11.4.89, §11.4.94, §11.4.97

#### §11.4.117 — Computer-vision / OCR pixel-oracle fallback for non-introspectable UIs mandate (1.1.8-dev remediation, 2026-06-03)
- **Source:** testing-and-tdd.md:1265-1285
- **Rules:**
  - Short tag `cv-ocr-pixel-oracle-fallback`. Any test that drives a UI control or asserts on-screen content MUST NOT assume the accessibility/semantic/DOM hierarchy is the source of truth for what the user sees.
  - When the hierarchy is blank, partial or known-unreliable (TV-Compose, leanback, canvas/SurfaceView/GL, games, custom-rendered UIs; `uiautomator dump` with zero clickable nodes), the test MUST fall back to a pixel oracle: (1) DRIVE input by computer-vision template-match (locate a control by rendered appearance, tap its screen coordinates) not by hierarchy node id; (2) ASSERT on-screen content by ROI OCR (read rendered text in the region the user reads: caption strip, title, error overlay) with a per-word confidence floor + region-of-interest per §11.4.107(12), never a hierarchy text attribute.
  - The test tool MUST be chosen for ability to BOTH drive input AND read pixels; a hierarchy-only tool cannot serve as a content oracle. This is the §11.4.52 "near-empty hierarchy proves UI-driven INFEASIBLE" SKIP made constructive: pixel-drive, not only SKIP.
  - Anti-bluff (§11.4.107): the CV/OCR analyzer MUST be self-validated per §11.4.107(10): a golden-good fixture (control present / expected caption rendered) MUST PASS and a golden-bad fixture (control absent / wrong-or-empty caption) MUST FAIL, wired into the meta-test. Thresholds (match confidence, OCR confidence floor) MUST be calibrated on the project's own captured frames, not hardcoded from literature (§11.4.107(13)/§11.4.6). An OCR PASS that cannot also FAIL its golden-bad fixture is a bluff gate.
  - Propagation gate `CM-COVENANT-114-117-PROPAGATION`; recommended gate `CM-CV-OCR-PIXEL-ORACLE-FALLBACK` (test targeting a known-blank-hierarchy app drives + asserts via a self-validated CV/OCR pixel oracle; paired mutation making the analyzer PASS its golden-bad fixture -> FAILs). Gate-code is a separate work item.
  - Classification universal; consumer supplies its CV/OCR toolchain, capture mechanism and calibrated thresholds per §11.4.35. Non-compliance is a release blocker.
- **Gates:** CM-COVENANT-114-117-PROPAGATION, CM-CV-OCR-PIXEL-ORACLE-FALLBACK
- **No escape hatch:** --hierarchy-is-content-oracle, --skip-pixel-fallback, --unvalidated-ocr-OK, --hardcoded-ocr-threshold-OK
- **Honest boundary:** When BOTH hierarchy is blank AND the pixel oracle is infeasible (protected/secure surface capturing black per §11.4.112, or geo-unreachable content), the test SKIPs-with-reason per §11.4.3 (`topology_unsupported` / `operator_attended` / `geo_restricted`), never a fake PASS; the operator-attended path is a tracked migration item per §11.4.52, not the permanent answer.
- **Composes:** §11.4.3, §11.4.5, §11.4.6, §11.4.17, §11.4.35, §11.4.48, §11.4.49, §11.4.52, §11.4.107, §11.4.112

#### §11.4.118 — Discovery-pressure to confirm known-issue-set completeness
- **Source:** testing-and-tdd.md:1289-1309
- **Rules:**
  - A remediation/release cycle MUST NOT treat "every reported defect is fixed" as "the build is good"; the reported set is biased by what the operator happened to test.
  - After (or in parallel with) fixing the reported set, the cycle MUST run a discovery + stress pass across ALL target devices/environments that deliberately exercises subsystems, journeys and edge cases BEYOND the reported defects.
  - The discovery pass MUST produce PROVABLE coverage: an enumerated list of subsystems / user-journeys / stress scenarios actually exercised, each with its outcome (no-new-issue, or a new tracker entry filed per §11.4.15/§11.4.16).
  - "We found no other issues" without the enumerated exercised set is a §11.4 bluff.
  - Newly discovered defects trigger §11.4.4 test-interrupt and the §11.4.114/§11.4.115 isolation -> RED -> fix loop.
  - Discovery runs autonomously per §11.4.52 using everyday-user journeys + chaos/stress per §11.4.85 across every device per §11.4.119 (single-resource-owner partition).
  - Subsystems NOT exercised MUST be stated as an honest coverage gap (§11.4.3), never implied clean.
  - Universal (§11.4.17); consumer supplies subsystem inventory, journey set, stress scenarios, target matrix per §11.4.35.
  - Propagation gate enforces literal `11.4.118` across the consumer fleet; paired §1.1 mutation strips the literal -> gate FAILs. Per-family gate: cycle records an enumerated discovery-coverage list with per-item outcome, not a bare no-issues claim; mutation replaces list with bare claim -> FAILs. Gate code is a separate work item.
  - Non-compliance is a release blocker.
- **Gates:** CM-COVENANT-114-118-PROPAGATION, CM-DISCOVERY-COVERAGE-ENUMERATED
- **No escape hatch:** --reported-set-suffices, --skip-discovery-pass, --no-issues-without-coverage-list, --assume-complete
- **Honest boundary:**
  - Discovery pressure reduces the unknown-unknown surface; it does not prove zero remaining defects. The earned claim is "reported set + enumerated discovery set are addressed", never "bug-free".
- **Composes:** §11.4.3, §11.4.4, §11.4.5, §11.4.69, §11.4.25, §11.4.40, §11.4.42, §11.4.52, §11.4.85, §11.4.114, §11.4.115, §11.4.119, §11.4.15, §11.4.16, §11.4.17, §11.4.35, §11.4.6, §1.1

#### §11.4.120 — Fix-breaks-its-own-gate reconciliation + gate seam-placement
- **Source:** testing-and-tdd.md:1313-1337
- **Rules:**
  - When a correct fix makes a pre-existing gate/test FAIL because it asserted the OLD (now removed/changed) behaviour, the FAIL is the CORRECT signal the fix landed and MUST NOT be suppressed.
  - FORBIDDEN response 1: fake-passing the gate (editing to always pass, weakening to a tautology, deleting it).
  - FORBIDDEN response 2: reverting the correct fix to satisfy the stale gate.
  - REQUIRED response is RECONCILIATION: rewrite the gate to assert the NEW mechanism the fix introduced, backed by captured evidence of the new behaviour.
  - After reconciliation the gate's paired §1.1 mutation MUST be updated to break the NEW invariant (mutate new invariant -> gate FAILs); a bluffed gate's mutation no longer makes it FAIL.
  - Reconciliation MUST be a visible, evidence-cited change ("rewrote gate X to assert <new mechanism> because fix Y removed <old behaviour>; new captured evidence: <path>"), never a silent assertion-weakening.
  - Before reconciling, the FAIL MUST be investigated per §11.4.102: it may be the gate correctly catching a regression the fix introduced (then the FIX is wrong). Reconcile ONLY when investigation proves the gate asserted old-correct-now-removed behaviour AND the new behaviour is the intended evidence-confirmed mechanism.
  - SEAM-PLACEMENT (a) Executability is checked BEFORE a gate is imposed: if gate G requires artifact A and A is produced by the very work G gates, G is unsatisfiable at that seam and belongs at a LATER one (activation/enablement/release), NEVER at authorship.
  - SEAM-PLACEMENT (b) Re-read the source of truth before re-seating; the gate's own text names its real seam and governs over any restatement (a restatement moving the gate from "enabling" to "writing" is a §11.4.6 misstatement; obey the source, do not weaken the gate).
  - SEAM-PLACEMENT (c) An unsatisfiable gate MUST NOT be fake-passed, deleted, weakened, improvised past by building the artifact and retro-declaring the gate met; the gated work MUST NOT be abandoned as "blocked" when the gate sits on the wrong seam.
  - An unrunnable gate is NOT automatically mis-seated: investigate per §11.4.102 first; it may be correctly seated with its precondition genuinely missing (the §11.4.69 `artifact_not_yet_built` NOT-YET-RUNNABLE state).
  - Gate contract: CM-GATE-RECONCILED-NOT-FAKE-PASSED is extended: an imposed gate whose precondition artifact is produced by the work it gates -> FAIL naming the circularity, MUST be re-seated at activation/enablement/release. Golden-FALSE fixture MUST include a correctly-seated gate whose precondition is merely not-yet-built; the gate MUST NOT fire on it (§11.4.201(1)). Paired mutation: impose authorship-seam gate whose precondition only the gated work can produce -> FAIL; re-seat at activation -> PASS.
  - Gate: propagation literal `11.4.120` across fleet, paired mutation strips literal -> FAILs; meta-gate mutation weakens a reconciled gate to always-pass and asserts its mutation no longer FAILs it -> meta-gate FAILs. Gate code is a separate work item (contract, not shipped).
  - Universal (§11.4.17); consumer supplies gate framework and paired-mutation mechanism per §11.4.35. Non-compliance is a release blocker.
- **Gates:** CM-COVENANT-114-120-PROPAGATION, CM-GATE-RECONCILED-NOT-FAKE-PASSED
- **No escape hatch:** --fake-pass-stale-gate, --revert-fix-for-gate, --weaken-assertion-to-pass, --delete-failing-gate, --impose-unsatisfiable-gate, --improvise-past-circular-order, --gate-authorship-on-its-own-output
- **Honest boundary:**
  - A gate FAIL after a fix is NOT automatically "stale gate"; "just stale" without §11.4.102 investigation is a §11.4.6 guess that can mask a real regression. An unrunnable gate is not automatically mis-seated.
  - §11.4.110 clash detector cannot catch the seam class (its input is a diff, an ordering instruction is not).
- **Composes:** §11.4.1, §11.4.4, §11.4.6, §11.4.84, §11.4.102, §11.4.108, §11.4.69, §11.4.66, §11.4.101, §11.4.201, §11.4.110, §11.4.17, §11.4.35, §1.1

#### §11.4.135 — Standing regression-guard suite + every fixed defect gets a permanent regression test
- **Source:** testing-and-tdd.md:1341-1351
- **Rules:**
  - Every project MUST maintain a STANDING regression-guard suite that runs on EVERY build+deploy and BLOCKS the release tag on any failure.
  - Every closed defect (stable ticket id e.g. ATM-NNN) MUST, in the SAME commit as its fix (extending the §11.4.43 DOCUMENT step), register a permanent §11.4.115 RED-on-broken-artifact regression test: `RED_MODE=1` captures the historical defect on a pre-fix artifact (proof the guard is real), `RED_MODE=0` is the standing GREEN guard asserting the defect is ABSENT.
  - A closure without a registered guard is a §11.4.123 violation.
  - The suite runs FIRST in the post-deploy cycle (highest-risk set per §11.4.132) and is a §11.4.40 release-gate blocker.
  - VERDICT COVERAGE (all hold): (1) suite exit semantics MUST incorporate COVERAGE, never only the FAIL count; PENDING/never-run is not a pass and not ignorable at shipping seams.
  - (2) The release seam blocks on verdict coverage of the candidate artifact: tag refused unless, for the candidate's artifact fingerprint, every registered guard whose required topology is present on at least one release-validation target has a real PASS-or-FAIL verdict and zero FAILs: `uncovered = registered AND topology-present AND no-verdict-for-this-fingerprint`; refuse while `uncovered != empty OR N_FAIL > 0`.
  - (3) Release-tag tooling MUST consult the suite/verdict store mechanically; a release path that never reads the guards is a bluff surface.
  - (4) REQUIRES-REBUILD PENDING is honest and non-blocking on intermediate artifacts but a contradiction on the release candidate: either re-run on the candidate or the item leaves the release's done-set; neither is a permanent exemption. Topology-absent guards are exempt ONLY via a checked-in target-pool topology map and MUST be enumerated in the release changelog as honest gaps (§11.4.3/§11.4.118), never silent. A naive "PENDING always blocks" rule is REJECTED as a §11.4.201 FAIL-bluff.
  - (5) Adoption ratchet: a pre-existing unguarded done-claiming backlog is snapshotted ONCE into a committed ratchet file and may only shrink (live unguarded set must be a subset of snapshot AND snapshot may not gain lines vs its committed version); every reopened/re-touched item exits the ratchet permanently.
  - CM-RELEASE-VERDICT-COVERAGE is self-tested per §11.4.205/§11.4.107(10): golden-bad = topology-present guard with no verdict for candidate fingerprint -> MUST FAIL; golden-good = complete verdict set -> MUST PASS; negative control = properly enumerated topology-absent guard -> MUST PASS. Paired §1.1 mutation: revert exit semantics to FAIL-count-only, or de-wire release-tag consultation -> gate FAILs. Gate code is a separate work item.
  - Universal (§11.4.17). Non-compliance is a release blocker.
- **Gates:** CM-REGRESSION-GUARD-REGISTERED, CM-REGRESSION-GUARD-SUITE-WIRED, CM-COVENANT-114-135-PROPAGATION, CM-RELEASE-VERDICT-COVERAGE
- **No escape hatch:** --skip-regression-guard, --no-guard-on-close, --guard-optional, --pending-does-not-block-the-candidate, --fail-count-only-exit, --release-without-consulting-guards, --silent-topology-exemption
- **Honest boundary:**
  - Topology exemptions must be enumerated as honest coverage gaps; gate code not shipped (contract only).
- **Composes:** §11.4.4, §11.4.40, §11.4.43, §11.4.46, §11.4.50, §11.4.107, §11.4.108, §11.4.115, §11.4.118, §11.4.123, §11.4.124, §11.4.130, §11.4.132, §11.4.3, §11.4.115(F), §11.4.146(D3), §11.4.201, §11.4.205, §11.4.17

#### §11.4.136 — Real-content end-to-end playback-test mandate
- **Source:** testing-and-tdd.md:1354-1360
- **Rules:**
  - Any test asserting media playback works MUST drive REAL content (catalog stream or offline reference clip) through the user's path (§11.4.48 UI-driven -> §11.4.117 CV/OCR fallback).
  - It MUST assert genuine playback via the §11.4.107 liveness battery PLUS a decoder-health census: a numeric drop-buffer budget, no buffer-timestamp re-order/discard, no codec-reject (Media3 ExoPlayer OEM mandate failure modes: "too many dropped buffers" >25, "unexpected presentation timestamp", "test timed out").
  - Metadata-only / launch-only / registration-only / single-frame / config-only PASS is forbidden.
  - A golden/reference clip corpus is the offline ground truth.
  - Universal (§11.4.17). Gates: CM-REAL-CONTENT-PLAYBACK-TEST, propagation literal `11.4.136`, paired §1.1 mutation (gate code separate work item).
  - Non-compliance is a release blocker.
- **Gates:** CM-REAL-CONTENT-PLAYBACK-TEST, CM-COVENANT-114-136-PROPAGATION
- **No escape hatch:** --launch-proves-playback, --skip-decoder-health, --metadata-playback-pass-suffices
- **Honest boundary:** none stated
- **Composes:** §11.4.5, §11.4.48, §11.4.50, §11.4.107, §11.4.117, §11.4.123, §11.4.13, §11.4.69, §11.4, §11.4.1, §11.4.17

#### §11.4.137 — Subtitle/caption content-correctness oracle + secure-display-proxy honesty
- **Source:** testing-and-tdd.md:1363-1375
- **Rules:**
  - A test asserting a subtitle/caption is correct MUST classify the content class of the rendered/forwarded cue; a present cue is NOT a correct cue.
  - A cue is CHROME (FAIL) if it is: a known control/menu label (closed multilingual deny-list MIRRORED from the source-side denylist, case-folded both sides incl. non-ASCII scripts); time-counter/numeric chrome; not prose; outside the lower safe-title position band where caption position is available (CEA-708 grid); OR static across the window (>=2 distinct prose cues required; dialogue cadence).
  - A cue is DIALOGUE (PASS) only when prose, not-denied, not-chrome, position-ok, AND cadence >=2 OR it fuzzy-matches the SOURCE-extracted expected cue via normalized edit distance (§11.4.123 host-side ground truth).
  - The content oracle MUST be self-validated golden-good/golden-bad (§11.4.107(10)); the test-side deny-list MUST be verified present in the SHIPPED artifact (§11.4.108); a source-green denylist with no test mirror and no artifact check is the forbidden recurrence pattern.
  - Secure-display proxy honesty (§11.4.112): where FLAG_SECURE makes pixel verification structurally impossible, the autonomous proof is the player's own caption telemetry (subdebug/Cue channel) + source-track presence + content-class oracle, NEVER a faked pixel "physical" pass; human-eye pixel confirmation is `operator_attended` (§11.4.52) with a tracked migration item.
  - App-agnostic: keys off content class, not per-app rule.
  - Universal (§11.4.17). Gates: CM-SUBTITLE-CONTENT-CORRECTNESS-ORACLE, propagation literal `11.4.137`; paired mutation strips denylist/position/cadence check -> golden-bad "Audio i subtitry" PASSes -> gate FAILs.
  - Non-compliance is a release blocker.
- **Gates:** CM-SUBTITLE-CONTENT-CORRECTNESS-ORACLE, CM-COVENANT-114-137-PROPAGATION
- **No escape hatch:** --present-cue-is-correct, --skip-chrome-oracle, --length-heuristic-suffices, --pixel-pass-on-secure-display, --skip-position-check, --skip-cadence-check
- **Honest boundary:**
  - Pixel verification on FLAG_SECURE surfaces is structurally impossible (§11.4.112); proxy proof only, human-eye confirmation stays operator_attended.
- **Composes:** §11.4.3, §11.4.5, §11.4.6, §11.4.107, §11.4.108, §11.4.112, §11.4.115, §11.4.117, §11.4.123, §11.4.13, §11.4.69, §11.4.52, §11.4.17

#### §11.4.138 — Operator-escape => mandatory bluff-audit + permanent guard
- **Source:** testing-and-tdd.md:1378-1384
- **Rules:**
  - When the operator (or any out-of-band channel) finds a defect the GREEN suite passed, it is a §11.4 PASS-bluff and MUST trigger, before the fix is closed: (1) a §11.4.102 systematic-debugging pass to FACT-root-cause.
  - (2) A bluff-audit identifying the EXACT assertion that should have caught it but didn't, cited to `file:line`.
  - (3) A permanent §11.4.135 regression guard registered in the SAME commit as the fix, with its §11.4.115 RED capturing the operator-found defect.
  - (4) The bluff-audit committed under `docs/research/<scope>/<defect>_bluff_audit/`.
  - Closing an operator-found defect WITHOUT the bluff-audit + permanent guard is itself a §11.4 violation.
  - Universal (§11.4.17). Gates: CM-OPERATOR-ESCAPE-BLUFF-AUDIT, propagation literal `11.4.138`, paired §1.1 mutation (gate code separate work item). Non-compliance is a release blocker.
- **Gates:** CM-OPERATOR-ESCAPE-BLUFF-AUDIT, CM-COVENANT-114-138-PROPAGATION
- **No escape hatch:** --close-without-bluff-audit, --operator-find-is-just-a-bug, --skip-permanent-guard
- **Honest boundary:** none stated
- **Composes:** §11.4, §11.4.1, §11.4.102, §11.4.108, §11.4.115, §11.4.118, §11.4.123, §11.4.135, §11.4.17

#### §11.4.143 — Real-user-journey mandate for video-streaming-app full-automation tests
- **Source:** testing-and-tdd.md:1387-1399
- **Rules:**
  - Any full-automation test asserting a video player/streaming app plays content MUST drive the REAL end-user journey through the app's OWN UI: launch -> BROWSE the actual catalog -> choose a SPECIFIC title -> press the real Play/Resume button -> confirm THAT chosen content plays with its correct subtitles on the intended routing target.
  - A test bypassing the journey with a sample/demo/built-in-loop clip, deep-link / `am start -a VIEW` / intent shortcut, synthetic or pre-staged stream is a §11.4 PASS-bluff at the user-journey layer (validates routing only).
  - (1) Real journey, not a shortcut (§11.4.48 UI-driven), never deep-link/intent/sample/loop-clip.
  - (2) Chosen-content confirmation: PASS proves the SPECIFIC selected title plays via the §11.4.107 liveness battery (live advancing frames + frame-advance counter + not-stale-from-previous) on the §11.4.136 real-content path, plus the §11.4.137 subtitle oracle for the chosen title.
  - (3) Non-introspectable UIs (blank/unreliable accessibility hierarchy; TV-Compose/leanback/canvas/GL) use the §11.4.117 CV/OCR pixel oracle (template-match Play control + ROI-OCR title/caption), never hierarchy-only.
  - (4) Login via the credential single source (§11.4.10), never hardcoded, never logged.
  - (5) Honest SKIP, never faked PASS: where the autonomous journey is genuinely infeasible (hard human-only login/CAPTCHA, geo-block per §11.4.3, secure-surface blanking per §11.4.112) the test is `operator_attended` SKIP-with-reason per §11.4.52 + §11.4.3 with a tracked migration item (§11.4.15/§11.4.16).
  - Universal (§11.4.17); consumer supplies app roster, credential source, routing target, harness per §11.4.35.
  - Gates: propagation literal `11.4.143` + CM-VIDEO-REAL-JOURNEY-TEST; paired mutation replaces browse-select-play with deep-link/sample shortcut -> gate FAILs; strip literal -> propagation FAILs; gate code separate work item.
  - Non-compliance is a release blocker.
- **Gates:** CM-COVENANT-114-143-PROPAGATION, CM-VIDEO-REAL-JOURNEY-TEST
- **No escape hatch:** --sample-playback-ok, --skip-real-journey, --deep-link-suffices, --routing-only-pass, --no-title-selection
- **Honest boundary:**
  - "The routing fired so the title is playing" is a guess; only chosen-content liveness + subtitle oracle on the real journey proves it. SKIP for genuine infeasibility is correct; a PASS without pressing the real Play on the real title is the forbidden bluff.
- **Composes:** §11.4.48, §11.4.107, §11.4.117, §11.4.136, §11.4.137, §11.4.52, §11.4.3, §11.4.10, §11.4.112, §11.4.15, §11.4.16, §107, §1.1, §11.4.17, §11.4.35, §11.4.6

#### §11.4.169 — Mandatory comprehensive test-type coverage with anti-bluff captured evidence
- **Source:** testing-and-tdd.md:1401-1433
- **Rules:**
  - Every project MUST be covered by the CLOSED enumerated test-type set, each driven to as close to 100% coverage as the domain permits, every PASS backed by rock-solid captured PHYSICAL evidence (§11.4.5/§11.4.69/§11.4.107), zero false results. A green result with no falsifiable captured evidence is a §11.4 PASS-bluff. Strict enumerated expansion of §11.4.27.
  - Each type REQUIRED where the domain warrants; the ONLY permitted absence is an honest §11.4.3 SKIP-with-reason (topology/hardware/credential genuinely absent), NEVER a silent gap.
  - Types: 1 Unit (only layer where mocks/stubs/fakes/placeholders permitted, §11.4.27(A)); 2 Integration (real wired components, real infra booted via containers submodule §11.4.76/§11.4.161 rootless); 3 End-to-end (full user journey, captured evidence); 4 Full-automation (autonomous, re-runnable, no manual intervention, deterministic across N iterations §11.4.50); 5 Challenges (challenges submodule `vasic-digital/challenges`, PASS only on positive captured evidence); 6 HelixQA (helix_qa submodule with test banks for every app/service/platform + fully autonomous QA sessions driving every bank with captured wire evidence); 7 DDoS/load-flood (refuses cleanly or degrades gracefully, never collapses; captured throughput/latency/error-rate); 8 Security (authn/authz, injection/taint, secret-leak §11.4.10, transport+crypto, dependency CVEs, default-deny; composes security submodule); 9 Stress+Chaos (sustained load, concurrent contention, boundary inputs, failure-injection incl. process-death/network-fault/input-corruption/resource-exhaustion/state-corruption, categorised recovery, §11.4.85); 10 Concurrency/atomicity (no lost updates, transactional atomicity, idempotency under replay); 11 Race-condition/deadlock (race detector + lock-order analysis; no blocking op inside shared-lock region; detector output is evidence); 12 Memory (leak census over soak, peak-RSS ceilings, allocation/fragmentation profile, no unbounded growth over 24h/N-iteration soak); 13 Benchmarking/performance (p50/p95/p99 latency, throughput, resource cost vs recorded baseline; regression is a finding).
  - Four-layer enforcement per §11.4.4(b) of the suite itself: pre-build gate (each required type present+executable+parseable), post-build, on-device/runtime where applicable, paired §1.1 mutation per type (strip type's evidence-capture or anti-bluff assertion -> gate FAILs).
  - The per-project coverage ledger (§11.4.25/§11.4.52) MUST classify every feature x test-type x evidence-state; a missing required type or an `OPERATOR_ATTENDED_ONLY` row is a release blocker until promoted or honestly SKIP-justified.
  - EXTENSION SUITE SHAPE (a): NO shape is mandated ("the shape is a consequence, not a goal"); pyramid or trophy selected by "where do I get the most confidence per second", from where the system's bugs live; "trophy always correct" is WRONG; no numeric layer ratios; a project's distribution is consumer DATA per §11.4.35.
  - (b) The generating rule IS mandated: push each test as far down as it will still catch the bug; if a high-level test fails with no lower-level test failing, add the lower-level one and consider deleting the redundant high-level one.
  - (c) Two named anti-patterns: ice-cream cone (lots of slow flaky e2e, still misses unit edges) is a violation at the top; mock-heavy unit theater (mocks encode drifting belief, test interaction not effect, couple tests to implementation; 100% coverage yet catches nothing) is a violation at the bottom (already forbidden by §11.4.27(A) and §11.4.224(C)).
  - Gate CM-SUITE-SHAPE-DECLARED-AND-PUSHED-DOWN: project declares chosen shape with the risk-location justification; a high-level test failing with no lower-level counterpart opens a tracked §11.4.197 item to add it. Mutation: remove shape declaration or record high-level-only failure with no tracked follow-up -> FAIL; golden-FALSE (§11.4.201(1)): declared trophy on genuinely I/O-heavy system MUST NOT fire merely for few unit tests.
  - Universal (§11.4.17); consumer supplies per-type harnesses, infra, calibrated thresholds per §11.4.35. Gate code separate work item, not shipped.
  - Non-compliance is a release blocker.
- **Gates:** CM-COVENANT-114-169-PROPAGATION, CM-MANDATORY-TEST-TYPES-COVERED, CM-SUITE-SHAPE-DECLARED-AND-PUSHED-DOWN
- **No escape hatch:** --skip-test-type, --partial-coverage-ok, --evidence-optional, --challenges-not-applicable, --skip-helixqa, --no-chaos, --no-ddos, --skip-memory-test, --skip-race-detector, --bench-optional
- **Honest boundary:**
  - Suite-shape extension mandates a DECLARED, JUSTIFIED shape and the push-down rule, NOT any particular shape, ratio or per-layer count; a project whose bugs live in the wiring is CORRECT to run a fat integration middle.
- **Composes:** §11.4.4, §11.4.5, §11.4.6, §11.4.25, §11.4.27, §11.4.50, §11.4.52, §11.4.69, §11.4.76, §11.4.85, §11.4.98, §11.4.107, §11.4.123, §11.4.135, §11.4.146, §11.4.3, §11.4.10, §11.4.161, §11.4.197, §11.4.201, §11.4.224, §11.4.227, §11.4.35, §1.1

#### §11.4.189 — Most-reopened cases get extra-depth live-testing scrutiny FIRST
- **Source:** testing-and-tdd.md:1449
- **Rules:**
  - All LIVE TESTING (on-device/on-target runtime validation, deploy-and-observe) MUST give EXTRA-DEPTH retest + in-depth investigation + FULL validation/verification with REAL PHYSICAL captured evidence (§11.4.5/§11.4.69/§11.4.107: captured audio/video/sysfs/dumpsys/sink-side/runtime-signature) and NO bluff to the cases REOPENED THE MOST TIMES (highest §11.4.55 reopens-count).
  - (1) WHAT: not a single pass: re-run at extra depth (more iterations per §11.4.50, wider edge-case + regression coverage), RE-INVESTIGATE the defect per §11.4.102 + §11.4.146 reproduce-first, CONFIRM with rock-solid captured physical evidence per §11.4.123; never metadata-only/config-only/absence-of-error/grep-without-runtime.
  - (2) ORDER: the most-reopened set is scrutinised FIRST, ahead of the rest of the live-test suite (§11.4.132 risk-descending, most-reopened the load-bearing key).
  - (3) KEY: priority keyed off the §11.4.55 reopens-count; consumer supplies the source per §11.4.35 (e.g. §11.4.93 workable-items DB `reopens_count`).
  - (4) PROOF: each most-reopened case's live PASS cites its captured-evidence artefact path on a CLEAN/fresh deployment (§11.4.108 runtime-signature), with the §11.4.115 RED->GREEN polarity flip captured where a permanent regression guard exists (§11.4.135).
  - Universal (§11.4.17). Gates: propagation literal `11.4.189` + CM-MOST-REOPENED-EXTRA-DEPTH-LIVE-TEST; mutation: drop the extra-depth pass, run it AFTER rest of suite, or PASS on metadata-only evidence -> FAILs; strip literal -> propagation FAILs; gate code separate work item.
  - Non-compliance is a release blocker.
- **Gates:** CM-COVENANT-114-189-PROPAGATION, CM-MOST-REOPENED-EXTRA-DEPTH-LIVE-TEST
- **No escape hatch:** --skip-most-reopened-depth, --reopened-same-as-any, --live-test-any-order, --metadata-pass-for-reopened-OK, --defer-reopened-scrutiny
- **Honest boundary:** none stated
- **Composes:** §11.4.5, §11.4.6, §11.4.55, §11.4.69, §11.4.107, §11.4.108, §11.4.115, §11.4.129, §11.4.130, §11.4.132, §11.4.135, §11.4.146, §11.4.50, §11.4.102, §11.4.123, §11.4.93, §11.4.17, §11.4.35, §11.4.1

#### §11.4.199 — Exact-reproduction-sequence mandate
- **Source:** testing-and-tdd.md:1451-1469
- **Rules:**
  - (1) When a working reproduction ALREADY EXISTS (test/harness/script/recorded sequence demonstrably reaching the defect or code path), the investigation MUST drive the target with THAT EXACT sequence: same inputs, order, timing, preconditions, environment/topology (§11.4.3). A hand-rolled approximation is NOT a substitute.
  - (2) A deviating/simplified/alternative sequence MUST FIRST be proven with captured evidence to reach the SAME precondition (the entry-state the mechanism/defect keys off) before ANY conclusion is drawn from it.
  - (3) A repro that misses the precondition proves NOTHING and is not evidence of absence (§11.4.6); concluding "defect present/absent/mechanism never engages" from it is a §11.4/§11.4.1 investigation-layer bluff (FAIL-bluff when it condemns working code, PASS-bluff when it clears broken code).
  - (4) Record the exact driving sequence (commands/input events/order/timing) as captured evidence so it is replayable and auditable; any deviation MUST be explicit, justified, and precondition-proven.
  - Strengthens §11.4.102 Phase-2, §11.4.146, §11.4.115: they mandate THAT you reproduce; §11.4.199 mandates HOW.
  - Reason clause: a hand-rolled repro pressed HOME where the test sent media-pause, never reached the precondition, and wrongly concluded a mechanism never engages.
  - Universal (§11.4.17); consumer supplies input/driving mechanism per §11.4.35.
  - Gates: propagation literal `11.4.199` + CM-EXACT-REPRO-SEQUENCE (conclusion cites exact driving sequence and, where an existing reproduction exists, that the same sequence was used or the deviating one reached the precondition with captured proof); mutation: conclusion from deviating sequence with no precondition proof -> FAILs; strip literal -> FAILs; gate code separate work item.
  - Non-compliance is a release blocker.
- **Gates:** CM-COVENANT-114-199-PROPAGATION, CM-EXACT-REPRO-SEQUENCE
- **No escape hatch:** --approximate-repro-OK, --skip-precondition-proof, --hand-rolled-repro-suffices, --absence-proves-absence, --deviating-sequence-conclusion-OK
- **Honest boundary:**
  - Absence of the observation is not observation of absence (§11.4.6).
- **Composes:** §11.4.1, §11.4.3, §11.4.5, §11.4.6, §11.4.7, §11.4.102, §11.4.107, §11.4.115, §11.4.123, §11.4.135, §11.4.146, §11.4.17, §11.4.35

#### §11.4.224 — Test-first (TDD) for ALL work + minimum code-coverage floor (necessary, never sufficient)
- **Source:** testing-and-tdd.md:1471-1497
- **Rules:**
  - Closes two gaps: §11.4.43 binds only fixes (new features/wiring/gates/Challenges/bash scripts had no test-first obligation); §11.4.27/§11.4.169 "100%" is test-TYPE breadth and states no CODE-coverage figure.
  - (A) TEST-FIRST BINDS ALL WORK with an executable surface (change, feature, implementation, wiring, refactor, pre-build gate, §1.1 mutation, Challenge, test-harness code, AND bash/shell scripts): the test is WRITTEN FIRST, RUN FIRST, and OBSERVED TO FAIL for the right reason before the implementation exists. Where a broken artifact exists the RED baseline is taken ON it per §11.4.115 (polarity switch converts it to the permanent §11.4.135 guard); for genuinely new work the RED is the test failing against absent behaviour, captured before implementation lands. A test authored AFTER implementation shows only agreement, never catching the defect.
  - Per-work-class "the test": behaviour code -> executing test asserting the behaviour; bash/shell script -> executing test invoking it through its REAL invocation path asserting exit status + emitted output + state delta, NEVER `bash -n` alone (parse-cleanliness is §11.4.67's separate obligation); pre-build GATE -> its paired §1.1 mutation IS the test-first artifact, observed to make the gate FAIL BEFORE the gate is trusted (observation-before-trust per §11.4.115(F), NOT authorship order; same-commit gate+mutation is compliant); Challenge -> scored assertion against captured evidence (§11.4.5/§11.4.69); behaviour-bearing config/data change (init-script line, package-set manifest, action-registry row, any committed DATA a consumer reads to decide behaviour) -> executing test driving that CONSUMER through the changed value and asserting the changed observable behaviour (never parked under the prose-exempt class).
  - (B) CODE-COVERAGE FLOOR >= 85% MINIMUM, ~100% TARGET, applying to the executable codebase INCLUDING bash/shell.
  - (B.1) SEVEN-TYPE BREADTH: the 85% floor is a LINE-COVERAGE proxy; the 100% AIM is across the seven canonical types x executable surface: (1) UNIT, (2) INTEGRATION, (3) END-TO-END, (4) FULL AUTOMATION, (5) SECURITY, (6) PERFORMANCE AND BENCHMARK, (7) ANTI-BLUFF, each carrying its §11.4.27 mandatory-breadth obligation. 100% line coverage on UNIT alone while omitting an applicable type is a violation regardless of the number (§11.4.201(8)). A genuinely inapplicable type is marked as honest §11.4.3 SKIP-with-reason, never silently omitted; applicability is consumer §11.4.35 DATA. CM-COVERAGE-FLOOR also FAILs on missing type-breadth coverage (e.g. 90% line coverage but zero ANTI-BLUFF tests); paired mutation stripping one enumerated type from the breadth check -> gate FAILs.
  - (C) COVERAGE IS NECESSARY, NEVER SUFFICIENT: (1) real bar is §11.4 anti-bluff + §1.1: every test MUST catch its own negation, PROVEN by a paired mutation making it FAIL; a line executed by an assertion-free test is NOT covered in the sense that matters; (2) the floor is a MINIMUM on a proxy, never a correctness certificate; citing ">= 85% covered" as proof a change works is a §11.4 PASS-bluff at the metric layer; (3) the floor NEVER stands alone: composes with §1.1 mutation pair, §11.4.5/§11.4.69/§11.4.107 captured evidence, §11.4.108 runtime signature. Measured fact: a line-granular instrument reported an if/else line COVERED while else was never taken.
  - (D) METRIC VALIDATION (§11.4.201(8)): directional validation performed (correct end-state moves metric to target, so floor is VALID as a NECESSARY condition); converse REFUTED by (C). OWED not claimed: empirical calibration of the 85% threshold on a project's real corpus MUST be tracked as a §11.4.197 item by every consuming project enforcing the floor. Interim precedence: the >= 85% floor KEEPS GATING until calibration lands; calibration is never a licence to switch it off.
  - (E) MEASUREMENT per language: consumer supplies the per-language instrument as DATA per §11.4.35; an instrument MUST exist and MUST actually be RUN; an unmeasurable floor is itself a §11.4.201 bluff and an unmeasured percentage a §11.4.6 fabrication. Go: `go test -coverprofile` + `go tool cover`; C/C++: `gcov`; bash: no dedicated tool installed (kcov, bashcov, bats, shellspec, shunit2 probed ABSENT; shellcheck is a linter and satisfies nothing). Proven-feasible bash mechanism: `PS4='+COV:${BASH_SOURCE##*/}:${LINENO}:' bash -x <script>` emits executed line numbers; executed lines / executable (non-blank, non-comment) lines = line coverage; subshell bodies ARE traced. Limits: LINE not BRANCH coverage; `set +x` regions and traps unaccounted; so branch-level assurance needs a real tool (e.g. kcov) or an honestly recorded shortfall. Where NO instrument exists: INSTALL one, or record §11.4.3/§11.4.69 SKIP-with-reason plus a tracked §11.4.197 item, NEVER an invented percentage or silently dropped floor.
  - EXCLUSION-LIST FENCE: a corpus exclusion is legal ONLY via a CHECKED-IN exclusion list, each entry justified from the CLOSED class set {generated-code (committed generator per §11.4.77), vendored-third-party, non-shipping-fixtures-and-golden-assets}, enumerated as honest gaps in the coverage report, never silent. Excluding FIRST-PARTY executable code additionally REQUIRES a tracked §11.4.197 item naming the plan to bring it into scope. An unlisted, unjustified or un-tracked-first-party exclusion VOIDS the measured figure.
  - (F) SCOPE: "all work" = work products with an EXECUTABLE surface; pure prose/governance/documentation edits are NOT coverage-scoped (disciplines §11.4.44/§11.4.65/§11.4.106/§11.4.212 + §11.4.142 review; demanding a percentage would be a §11.4.201(1) false-positive refusal), BUT a governance change SHIPPING an executable artifact (gate, hook, script, mutation) is FULLY in scope for (A) and (B). Test-first does NOT replace §11.4.108 four-layer verification, §11.4.40 full-suite retest, §11.4.185 manual-QA; it PRECEDES them. The CODE-coverage axis is DISTINCT from §11.4.27/§11.4.169 TEST-TYPE breadth: both apply, neither substitutes.
  - Gates: CM-TEST-FIRST-ALL-WORK (every commit adding an executable artifact carries its test and that test's failing-first observation is recorded; a new script/gate/feature with no test or with an uncaptured RED FAILs). CM-COVERAGE-FLOOR (a measured figure exists per declared language, produced by a real instrument run, >= declared floor; a declared language with NO instrument FAILs; the measured numerator counts ONLY lines covered by RED-CAPABLE tests: every contributing test carries a recorded failing-first run OR a paired mutation observed to make it FAIL, sampling-based mutation verification acceptable, zero-assertion contributors rejected by construction, so one real RED test plus assertion-free padding to 85% FAILs; also FAILs on any exclusion absent from the checked-in list, outside the closed class set, or first-party without its tracked item). Paired mutations: executable artifact with no test -> TEST-FIRST FAILs; percentage with no instrument run, dropped language, assertion-free padding, or unjustified exclusion -> COVERAGE-FLOOR FAILs; strip literal -> propagation FAILs.
  - Brownfield adoption is DELIBERATELY UNDEFINED (§11.4.66): when CM-COVERAGE-FLOOR first lands on a project below 85%, the gate-code work item MUST surface the adoption question to the OPERATOR BEFORE first enforcement; options: immediate hard floor / one-time monotone-decrease ratchet per §11.4.135 precedent / per-corpus phase-in / floor-on-changed-code-only with scheduled full-corpus deadline; record answer as consumer DATA; do NOT autonomously invent a ratchet (a §11.4.122-class operator decision). Gate code is a separate work item, contract only.
  - Universal (§11.4.17); consumer supplies instruments, corpus scope, checked-in fenced exclusion list, threshold calibration per §11.4.35. Non-compliance is a release blocker.
- **Gates:** CM-COVENANT-114-224-PROPAGATION, CM-TEST-FIRST-ALL-WORK, CM-COVERAGE-FLOOR
- **No escape hatch:** --test-after-OK, --skip-red-first, --bash-exempt-from-tests, --coverage-not-applicable, --below-floor-OK, --coverage-proves-correct, --unmeasured-percentage-OK, --assertion-free-test-counts
- **Honest boundary:**
  - Coverage is a minimum on a gameable proxy, never proof of correctness; bash instrument is line-only (no branch coverage). Threshold calibration owed; gate code not shipped.
  - Test-first precedes, never replaces, §11.4.108/§11.4.40/§11.4.185; prose-only edits are out of coverage scope.
- **Composes:** §11.4, §11.4.1, §11.4.5, §11.4.6, §11.4.27, §11.4.35, §11.4.43, §11.4.50, §11.4.66, §11.4.67, §11.4.69, §11.4.77, §11.4.85, §11.4.107, §11.4.108, §11.4.110, §11.4.115, §11.4.122, §11.4.135, §11.4.142, §11.4.146, §11.4.169, §11.4.185, §11.4.197, §11.4.201(8), §11.4.202, §11.4.3, §11.4.17, §11.4.44, §11.4.65, §11.4.106, §11.4.212, §1.1

#### §11.4.238 — Automated QA must be the DISCOVERER: manual QA finds nothing new
- **Source:** testing-and-tdd.md:1499-1525
- **Rules:**
  - (A) The automated QA system (HelixQA per §11.4.27 or consumer's equivalent per §11.4.35) MUST be the mechanism that FINDS defects. Discovery by a human, operator manual pass, agent reading code, or end-user report is a FAILURE of the QA system; the finding is still fixed, but the QA gap is a defect of equal standing and closing only the reported defect while leaving the gap is the violation.
  - (B) By the time manual QA runs (§11.4.185) the automated regime MUST already have surfaced everything; manual QA is a CONFIRMATION and sufficiency gate, never the discovery mechanism. Target: a manual pass discovering zero previously-unknown defects.
  - (C) Every defect discovered OUTSIDE the automated QA system (manual QA, operator, end-user, agent code-reading, incidental) triggers before the fix may close: (1) §11.4.102 systematic-debugging to FACT-root-cause; (2) a coverage-escape audit identifying WHY the regime did not find it, cited to the specific missing check/unexercised path/absent assertion/untested surface, never "we didn't think of it"; (3) a new or strengthened automated check that WOULD have found it, registered into the standing regime (§11.4.135) with its §11.4.115 RED capturing the escaped defect; (4) the audit committed as captured evidence. Widens the §11.4.138 trigger to EVERY out-of-band channel.
  - (D) Coverage is measured by what the regime can CATCH, not what it runs: every automated surface MUST be falsifiable per §1.1 (a check whose paired mutation does not make it fail is decoration) and MUST exercise real user-reachable paths end-to-end (§11.4.98, §11.4.143, §11.4.136, §11.4.158/.159/.160).
  - (E) Projects MUST track the discovery-channel split (automated vs out-of-band) and drive the out-of-band share toward zero over successive cycles; MUST NOT close an escape by weakening the definition of "defect".
  - EXTENSION (discovery-channel record schema + escape ratchet): (1) every recorded defect MUST carry a discovery channel from the CLOSED SET {automated_seam, manual_qa, operator, end_user, agent_inspection} (or consumer's declared equivalent per §11.4.35) AND a `should_have_been_caught_by` value naming a specific seam or gate, OR the literal `none` with a WRITTEN justification; a record missing either field is REFUSED; the record MUST be WRITTEN BY THE VERIFIER SEAM, never by the producer of the defect's fix (producer-authored record refused, §11.4.240).
  - (2) Escape count is monotone-decreasing from a recorded baseline: a cycle whose count EXCEEDS the baseline is REFUSED at the release seam; a lower count moves the baseline down.
  - (3) A cycle in which manual QA did not run contributes NO DATA POINT and MUST NOT lower the baseline (§11.4.201(6) false-null; only a `manual_qa_ran` flag distinguishes unmeasured from clean).
  - (4) Records tagged `should_have_been_caught_by: none` are counted and reported SEPARATELY so narrowing the escape definition is visible.
  - Gates: propagation literal `11.4.238`; CM-QA-IS-THE-DISCOVERER (every defect closed in a cycle records its discovery channel; out-of-band channel requires committed coverage-escape audit + registered automated check); CM-MANUAL-QA-FINDS-NOTHING-NEW (a manual pass reporting new defects blocks the release tag until each has its audit and new check); CM-DISCOVERY-CHANNEL-RECORD-COMPLETE; CM-ESCAPE-RATCHET-NO-DATA-POINT-HONEST. Mutations: strip literal -> propagation FAILs; close out-of-band defect with no audit -> QA-IS-THE-DISCOVERER FAILs; record with no channel / `none` without justification / producer-authored -> schema gate FAILs; `manual_qa_ran` false cycle lowering baseline -> ratchet gate FAILs; golden-FALSE (§11.4.201(1)): a genuine manual-QA cycle with a real zero-escape result MUST be allowed to lower the baseline. Gate code separate work item, not shipped.
  - Universal (§11.4.17); consumer supplies QA system, surface inventory, discovery-channel ledger per §11.4.35. Non-compliance is a release blocker.
- **Gates:** CM-COVENANT-114-238-PROPAGATION, CM-QA-IS-THE-DISCOVERER, CM-MANUAL-QA-FINDS-NOTHING-NEW, CM-DISCOVERY-CHANNEL-RECORD-COMPLETE, CM-ESCAPE-RATCHET-NO-DATA-POINT-HONEST
- **No escape hatch:** --manual-qa-may-discover, --skip-coverage-escape-audit, --found-by-human-is-fine, --close-escape-without-new-check, --qa-green-is-enough, --discovery-channel-not-tracked
- **Honest boundary:**
  - Does NOT claim a QA regime can be provably complete (§11.4.118) nor license closing an escape by redefining "defect".
  - Ratchet is a valid NECESSARY condition (count reaches 0 at the correct end-state) but not sufficient (zero also results from nobody looking), which the no-data-point rule and separate `none` tally expose.
- **Composes:** §11.4.27, §11.4.138, §11.4.185, §11.4.118, §11.4.135, §11.4.115, §11.4.98, §11.4.136, §11.4.143, §11.4.158, §11.4.159, §11.4.160, §11.4.102, §11.4.6, §1.1, §11.4.240, §11.4.201, §11.4.261, §11.4.227, §11.4.17, §11.4.35

#### §11.4.239 — Critical-invariant work-class Definition of Done: failure-path scenarios as gates
- **Source:** testing-and-tdd.md:1530-1546
- **Rules:**
  - Every project's DoD (§11.4.15/§11.4.16 lifecycle + §11.4.33 closure vocabulary) MUST identify a closed CRITICAL-INVARIANT WORK CLASS (code where a single incorrect outcome is unrecoverable between failure and remediation) and MUST require that a change touching it carry EXPLICIT FAILURE-PATH SCENARIOS as passing tests BEFORE closure. A DoD stopping at "compiles + happy-path green" for such a change is forbidden.
  - (A) Consumer MUST declare as DATA (§11.4.35) its instantiation of four categories: (i) MONEY (credits, debits, transfers, holds, releases, refunds, reconciles); (ii) SAFETY (outputs actuating physical hardware, medical devices, transport, industrial controls); (iii) AVAILABILITY (code on the critical path of the primary user-facing capability: login, primary action, load-bearing data read); (iv) INTEGRITY (mutates the persistent record whose corruption cannot be silently repaired: append-only ledgers, audit logs, cryptographic anchors, source-of-truth writes per §11.4.93/§11.4.95). A region is IN the class when at least one category applies; consumer extensions (regulatory outputs, privacy-critical PII, legal-hold) carry the same discipline. Categories are not claimed exhaustive.
  - (B) For every change touching the class, the acceptance-criteria set MUST enumerate domain-specific failure paths BEFORE code is authored, each as a Given/When/Then scenario whose "Then" observes a real user-observable outcome (ledger row, settled charge, state delta), not "no error" (§11.4/§11.4.69). Reference minimum for MONEY: (1) FRESH happy path; (2) IDEMPOTENT RETRY (same key + payload, no new side effect); (3) SAME-KEY-DIFFERENT-PAYLOAD (rejected, not quietly served); (4) CRASH-IN-THE-MIDDLE (killed between external commit and local persist, re-driven, converges exactly-once). Analogous minimum sets for SAFETY (nominal + fault-injected upstream + degraded actuator + power-loss mid-actuation), AVAILABILITY (nominal + dependency degraded + dependency down + retry storm), INTEGRITY (nominal write + concurrent conflicting write + mid-write crash + corruption-detected-on-read) are consumer-supplied per §11.4.35. Every scenario becomes a passing test BEFORE closure; an omitted scenario is a §11.4/§11.4.1 finding, not a deferral.
  - (C) MECHANICAL PRECONDITION at the status-write seam via the §11.4.146(D3) status-custody chain: a done/ready/closed write against an item whose diff touches the class is REFUSED unless the registry row cites acceptance-criteria coverage of the declared failure-path set, each scenario mapped to a §11.4.115(F) machine-written verdict pair with class-matched evidence per §11.4.226. Refusal is at the SEAM (workable-items engine per §11.4.93), not prose (§11.4.205). An "N/A" scenario MUST cite a §11.4.6-honest reason; bare "N/A" is treated as omission.
  - (D) §11.4.108 four-layer verification stays in force per scenario (closes on runtime-class evidence per §11.4.226, not source-green); §11.4.129 huge-blocker STOP-fix-all-full-RESTART governs response when a scenario surfaces a defect during release validation; §11.4.185 manual QA remains un-weakened terminal sufficiency gate; §11.4.238: a manual-QA-discovered critical-invariant failure-path defect is both a §11.4.238 coverage-escape audit AND a §11.4.239 acceptance-criteria audit.
  - (E) Every escape becomes a permanent addition to the scenario set (§11.4.135 applied to acceptance criteria); minimum sets are the starting point, not the ceiling.
  - Citation note: "extraction file" offsets cited in §11.4.239-§11.4.254 are un-resolvable provenance pointers (untracked consolidated artifact); verified `module_NN:LINE` locators against `docs/research/ai_curriculum_2026_08/source_corpus/` are the only resolvable ones (e.g. module_27:30, :211, :231, :312; module_28:139, :141).
  - Gates: propagation literal `11.4.239`; CM-CRITICAL-INVARIANT-FAILURE-PATH-DOD (change touching the class carries an acceptance-criteria map naming each required failure-path scenario; "N/A" carries a honest reason; closure against an incomplete map or tests lacking §11.4.115(F) verdicts refused at the status-write seam). Mutations: MONEY change with happy-path-only criteria -> FAILs; strip same-key-different-payload scenario -> FAILs; scenario whose "Then" observes only "no error" -> composed §11.4.69 gate FAILs; strip literal -> propagation FAILs. Gate code separate work item.
  - Universal (§11.4.17). Non-compliance is a release blocker.
- **Gates:** CM-COVENANT-114-239-PROPAGATION, CM-CRITICAL-INVARIANT-FAILURE-PATH-DOD
- **No escape hatch:** --happy-path-suffices-for-money, --skip-failure-scenarios, --defer-failure-path-tests, --criticality-not-applicable-without-reason, --n/a-without-justification, --closure-without-scenario-map
- **Honest boundary:**
  - Failure-path coverage is DIRECTIONAL (forbids happy-path-only, mandates a domain minimum), NOT exhaustive; exhaustive enumeration is formal-methods/§11.4.118 territory.
- **Composes:** §11.4.15, §11.4.16, §11.4.33, §11.4.35, §11.4.43, §11.4.69, §11.4.108, §11.4.115(F), §11.4.135, §11.4.146(D3), §11.4.185, §11.4.205, §11.4.226, §11.4.238, §11.4.93, §11.4.95, §11.4.129, §11.4.6, §11.4.17

#### §11.4.242 — Bisection-not-blame regression cause-finding + delta debugging
- **Source:** testing-and-tdd.md:1550-1556
- **Rules:**
  - When a previously-working behaviour regresses, the FIRST-choice localisation is BISECTION (`git bisect` or equivalent monotone search, O(log N)) over the ordered commit range between the last known-good tag per §11.4.114 and HEAD, NOT blame-log inspection nor speculative root-cause hunting.
  - MONOTONE-SEARCH INVARIANT: bisection valid only when the observable is monotone (broken stays broken); non-monotone (flaky, environment-dependent, timing-race) MUST be stabilised first; bisecting over a flaky signal yields a WRONG "guilty" commit with equal confidence (a §11.4/§11.4.1 localisation-layer bluff).
  - FAILURE-MODE CATALOGUE (closed 6-class set): (1) flaky/non-monotone observable; (2) build-broken commits mistaken for "bad" (use `bisect skip`, exit 125); (3) merge-commit introductions (defect in conflict resolution not either parent); (4) external/environmental changes; (5) delayed-fuse introductions (latent commit + later trigger); (6) test-infra regressions masquerading as product regressions.
  - `git bisect run` script MUST use exit-code discipline: 0=good, 1-124=bad, 125=skip, 128+=abort; mapping every non-zero to "bad" collapses the taxonomy.
  - The bisection RESULT is captured evidence (§11.4.5/§11.4.69) feeding §11.4.102 root-cause phase.
  - EXTENSION DELTA DEBUGGING: `git bisect` is delta debugging over commits. When a failure is not a monotone commit-range regression, or commit-bisection returns a change too large to explain it, the investigation MUST narrow along the discriminating axis (input, config, data, dependency, or flag) to a MINIMAL failing case (1-minimal: removing any remaining piece makes the failure disappear) before a fix is designed; the minimal case becomes the §11.4.115 RED test's input. Enumerated axes: bisect a config, the data, the change set, dependencies (feature flags also named; STATE is NOT an enumerated axis).
  - The predicate MUST be "stable, fast, unambiguous" (does THIS input still trigger THIS failure); for a non-deterministic failure run the predicate multiple times per step or accept a probabilistic minimum (composes §11.4.50, §11.4.248).
  - Gates: propagation literal `11.4.242`; CM-BISECTION-BEFORE-BLAME; CM-DELTA-DEBUG-MINIMAL-CASE (an investigation of a non-monotone or non-commit-discriminated failure records the narrowed axis and minimal case, which is the RED test's input; a fix designed against an un-narrowed failing input -> FAIL). Mutation: strip the minimal-case record -> gate FAILs; golden-FALSE (§11.4.201(1)): a genuine monotone commit-range regression localised by `git bisect` alone MUST NOT fire it. Gate code separate work item.
  - Universal (§11.4.17). Non-compliance is a release blocker.
- **Gates:** CM-COVENANT-114-242-PROPAGATION, CM-BISECTION-BEFORE-BLAME, CM-DELTA-DEBUG-MINIMAL-CASE
- **No escape hatch:** --blame-log-suffices, --skip-bisection, --flaky-observable-bisect-anyway, --run-script-exit-code-collapse-OK, --regression-guess-without-localisation
- **Honest boundary:**
  - Bisection localises the INTRODUCING COMMIT of a MONOTONE regression; it does NOT prove that commit's change is the root cause.
  - Minimisation yields the smallest input that still triggers the failure ("usually is the diagnosis"), not the root cause itself (§11.4.102's phase).
- **Composes:** §11.4.5, §11.4.6, §11.4.69, §11.4.102, §11.4.114, §11.4.115, §11.4.201, §11.4.224, §11.4.50, §11.4.248, §11.4.227, §1.1, §11.4.17

#### §11.4.243 — Characterization / golden-master safety net before behaviour-changing legacy modification
- **Source:** testing-and-tdd.md:1560-1564
- **Rules:**
  - Before ANY behaviour-changing modification to legacy code lacking characterization tests, the modifier MUST FIRST author CHARACTERIZATION TESTS asserting CURRENT observable behaviour as GROUND TRUTH (correct or not) and land them as a green baseline; only AFTER may the modification proceed.
  - LEGACY SCOPE (any of): (i) lacks tests asserting observable behaviour; (ii) written spec diverges from measured actual behaviour; (iii) predates the constitution's TDD discipline (§11.4.224); (iv) modifier cannot describe exact behaviour from reading source in the time budget.
  - AUTHORING LOOP: (1) identify observable surface; (2) generate representative input space; (3) run and record actual outputs as ground-truth baseline; (4) assert recorded values in tests; (5) commit characterization tests as a SEPARATE commit BEFORE the behaviour-changing modification.
  - Characterization is DESCRIPTIVE not prescriptive (captures WHAT IS, not WHAT SHOULD BE); if current behaviour is subtly wrong the modifier MUST notice and ASK the operator per §11.4.66 whether to preserve or correct it, never silently.
  - Pattern: Feathers / golden-master (record outputs across representative input space; assert future runs match).
